name: exists_of_schnirelmannDensity_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_of_schnirelmannDensity_eq_zero {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hA : schnirelmannDensity A = 0) :
    ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ #{a ∈ Ioc 0 n | a ∈ A} / n < ε
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  rw [← le_schnirelmannDensity_iff] at h
  linarith

name: schnirelmannDensity_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma schnirelmannDensity_empty : schnirelmannDensity ∅ = 0

name: schnirelmannDensity_finset
statement: lemma schnirelmannDensity_finset (A : Finset ℕ) : schnirelmannDensity A = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ schnirelmannDensity_nonneg
  simp only [schnirelmannDensity_le_iff_forall, zero_add]
  intro ε hε
  wlog hε₁ : ε ≤ 1 generalizing ε
  · obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := this 1 zero_lt_one le_rfl
    exact ⟨n, hn, hn'.trans_le (le_of_not_ge hε₁)⟩
  let n : ℕ := ⌊#A / ε⌋₊ + 1
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.succ_pos _
  use n, hn
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.2 hn), ← div_lt_iff₀' hε, Nat.cast_add_one]
  exact (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _).trans_le' <| by gcongr; simp [subset_iff]

name: schnirelmannDensity_finite
statement:
lemma schnirelmannDensity_finite {A : Set ℕ} [DecidablePred (· ∈ A)] (hA : A.Finite) :
    schnirelmannDensity A = 0

name: schnirelmannDensity_univ
statement: @[simp] lemma schnirelmannDensity_univ : schnirelmannDensity Set.univ = 1

name: schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_even
statement: lemma schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_even : schnirelmannDensity (Set.ofPred Even) = 0

name: schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_prime
statement: lemma schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_prime : schnirelmannDensity (Set.ofPred Nat.Prime) = 0

name: schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_mod_eq_one
statement:
lemma schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_mod_eq_one {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 1) :
    schnirelmannDensity {n | n % m = 1} = (m⁻¹ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases m.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hm'
  · simp only [Nat.cast_zero, inv_zero]
    refine schnirelmannDensity_finite ?_
    simp
  apply le_antisymm (schnirelmannDensity_le_of_le m hm'.ne' _) _
  · rw [← one_div, ← @Nat.cast_one ℝ]
    gcongr
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, card_le_one_iff_subset_singleton, subset_iff,
      mem_filter, mem_Ioc, mem_singleton, and_imp]
    use 1
    intro x _ hxm h
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxm with rfl | hxm'
    · simp at h
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hxm'] at h
  rw [le_schnirelmannDensity_iff]
  intro n hn
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  have : (Icc 0 ((n - 1) / m)).image (· * m + 1) ⊆ {x ∈ Ioc 0 n | x % m = 1} := by
    simp only [subset_iff, mem_image, forall_exists_index, mem_filter, mem_Ioc, mem_Icc, and_imp]
    rintro _ y _ hy' rfl
    have hm : 2 ≤ m := hm.lt_of_le' hm'
    simp only [Nat.mul_add_mod', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm, add_pos_iff, or_true, and_true, true_and,
      ← Nat.le_sub_iff_add_le hn, zero_lt_one]
    exact Nat.mul_le_of_le_div _ _ _ hy'
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.2 hn), mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  apply (Nat.cast_le.2 (card_le_card this)).trans'
  rw [card_image_of_injective, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.sub_zero, div_le_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.2 hm'),
    ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_le, add_one_mul (α := ℕ)]
  · have := @Nat.lt_div_mul_add n.pred m hm'
    rwa [← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.succ_pred hn.ne'] at this
  intro a b
  simp [hm'.ne']

name: schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_modeq_one
statement:
lemma schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_modeq_one {m : ℕ} :
    schnirelmannDensity {n | n ≡ 1 [MOD m]} = (m⁻¹ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 1 with rfl | hm
  · simp [Nat.modEq_one]
  rw [← schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_mod_eq_one hm]
  simp [Nat.ModEq, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr hm]

name: schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_Odd
statement: lemma schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_Odd : schnirelmannDensity (Set.ofPred Odd) = 2⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h : Set.ofPred Odd = {n | n % 2 = 1} := Set.ext fun _ => Nat.odd_iff
  simp only [h]
  rw [schnirelmannDensity_setOfPred_mod_eq_one (by norm_num1), Nat.cast_two]

name: add_eq_univ_of_one_le_schirelmannDensity_add_schnirelmannDensity
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
  rintro (_ | m)
  · exact ⟨0, hA, 0, ⟨hB, rfl⟩⟩
  set n := m + 1
  by_cases hnA : n ∈ A
  · exact ⟨n, by simp [hnA], 0, ⟨hB, rfl⟩⟩
  by_cases hnB : n ∈ B
  · exact ⟨0, hA, n, ⟨hnB, by simp⟩⟩
  let f : ℕ ⊕ ℕ → ℕ
    | .inl x => x
    | .inr y => n - y
  let sA := {a ∈ Ioc 0 n | a ∈ A}
  let sB := {b ∈ Ioc 0 n | b ∈ B}
  have hc : #(image f (disjSum sA sB)) < #(disjSum sA sB) := calc
    #(image f (disjSum sA sB)) ≤ #(Ioo 0 n) := by gcongr; grind [mem_disjSum]
    _ < n := by simp [Nat.card_Ioo, n]
    _ ≤ #(disjSum sA sB) := by
      rw [card_disjSum]
      rify
      nlinarith [@schnirelmannDensity_mul_le_card_filter A _ n,
        @schnirelmannDensity_mul_le_card_filter B _ n]
  obtain ⟨a | b, ha, a | b, hb, _, hxy⟩ := exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_image_lt hc <;>
  simp only [sA, sB, inl_mem_disjSum, mem_filter, mem_Ioc, inr_mem_disjSum] at ha hb <;>
  first | grind [inr_mem_disjSum] | exact ⟨a, by simp [*], b, by simp [*], by grind⟩

name: bipartiteBelow_swap
statement: theorem bipartiteBelow_swap : t.bipartiteBelow (swap r) a = t.bipartiteAbove r a

name: bipartiteAbove_swap
statement: theorem bipartiteAbove_swap : s.bipartiteAbove (swap r) b = s.bipartiteBelow r b

name: coe_bipartiteBelow
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_bipartiteBelow : s.bipartiteBelow r b = ({a ∈ s | r a b} : Set α)

name: coe_bipartiteAbove
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_bipartiteAbove : t.bipartiteAbove r a = ({b ∈ t | r a b} : Set β)

name: mem_bipartiteBelow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bipartiteBelow {a : α} : a ∈ s.bipartiteBelow r b ↔ a ∈ s ∧ r a b

name: mem_bipartiteAbove
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bipartiteAbove {b : β} : b ∈ t.bipartiteAbove r a ↔ b ∈ t ∧ r a b

name: prod_prod_bipartiteAbove_eq_prod_prod_bipartiteBelow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_prod_bipartiteAbove_eq_prod_prod_bipartiteBelow
    [CommMonoid R] (f : α → β → R) [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)] :
    ∏ a ∈ s, ∏ b ∈ t.bipartiteAbove r a, f a b = ∏ b ∈ t, ∏ a ∈ s.bipartiteBelow r b, f a b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [bipartiteAbove, bipartiteBelow, prod_filter]
  exact prod_comm

name: sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow
statement:
theorem sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)] :
    (∑ a ∈ s, #(t.bipartiteAbove r a)) = ∑ b ∈ t, #(s.bipartiteBelow r b)

name: card_nsmul_le_card_nsmul
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_le_card_nsmul [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)]
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, m ≤ #(t.bipartiteAbove r a))
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, #(s.bipartiteBelow r b) ≤ n) : #s • m ≤ #t • n
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, (#(t.bipartiteAbove r a) : R) := s.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ hm
    _ = ∑ b ∈ t, (#(s.bipartiteBelow r b) : R) := by
      norm_cast; rw [sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow]
    _ ≤ _ := t.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ hn

name: card_nsmul_le_card_nsmul'
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_le_card_nsmul' [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)]
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, n ≤ #(s.bipartiteBelow r b))
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, #(t.bipartiteAbove r a) ≤ m) : #t • n ≤ #s • m

name: card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_lt_of_le [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)] (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, m < #(t.bipartiteAbove r a))
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, #(s.bipartiteBelow r b) ≤ n) : #s • m < #t • n
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = ∑ _a ∈ s, m := by rw [sum_const]
    _ < ∑ a ∈ s, (#(t.bipartiteAbove r a) : R) := sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hs hm
    _ = ∑ b ∈ t, (#(s.bipartiteBelow r b) : R) := by
      norm_cast; rw [sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow]
    _ ≤ _ := t.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ hn

name: card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_le_of_lt [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)] (ht : t.Nonempty)
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, m ≤ #(t.bipartiteAbove r a))
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, #(s.bipartiteBelow r b) < n) : #s • m < #t • n
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, (#(t.bipartiteAbove r a) : R) := s.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ hm
    _ = ∑ b ∈ t, (#(s.bipartiteBelow r b) : R) := by
      norm_cast; rw [sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow]
    _ < ∑ _b ∈ t, n := sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty ht hn
    _ = _ := sum_const _

name: card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_lt_of_le'
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_lt_of_le' [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)] (ht : t.Nonempty)
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, n < #(s.bipartiteBelow r b))
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, #(t.bipartiteAbove r a) ≤ m) : #t • n < #s • m

name: card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_le_of_lt'
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_lt_card_nsmul_of_le_of_lt' [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)] (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, n ≤ #(s.bipartiteBelow r b))
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, #(t.bipartiteAbove r a) < m) : #t • n < #s • m

name: card_mul_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem card_mul_le_card_mul [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)]
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, m ≤ #(t.bipartiteAbove r a))
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, #(s.bipartiteBelow r b) ≤ n) : #s * m ≤ #t * n

name: card_mul_le_card_mul'
statement:
theorem card_mul_le_card_mul' [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)]
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, n ≤ #(s.bipartiteBelow r b))
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, #(t.bipartiteAbove r a) ≤ m) : #t * n ≤ #s * m

name: card_mul_eq_card_mul
statement:
theorem card_mul_eq_card_mul [∀ a b, Decidable (r a b)]
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ s, #(t.bipartiteAbove r a) = m)
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, #(s.bipartiteBelow r b) = n) : #s * m = #t * n
proof:
:=
  (card_mul_le_card_mul _ (fun a ha ↦ (hm a ha).ge) fun b hb ↦ (hn b hb).le).antisymm <|
    card_mul_le_card_mul' _ (fun a ha ↦ (hn a ha).ge) fun b hb ↦ (hm b hb).le

name: card_le_card_of_forall_subsingleton
statement:
theorem card_le_card_of_forall_subsingleton (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, ∃ b, b ∈ t ∧ r a b)
    (ht : ∀ b ∈ t, ({ a ∈ s | r a b } : Set α).Subsingleton) : #s ≤ #t
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [← mul_one #s, ← mul_one #t]
    exact card_mul_le_card_mul r
      (fun a h ↦ card_pos.2 (by
        rw [← coe_nonempty, coe_bipartiteAbove]
        exact hs _ h : (t.bipartiteAbove r a).Nonempty))
      (fun b h ↦ card_le_one.2 (by
        simp_rw [mem_bipartiteBelow]
        exact ht _ h))

name: card_le_card_of_forall_subsingleton'
statement:
theorem card_le_card_of_forall_subsingleton' (ht : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ r a b)
    (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, ({ b ∈ t | r a b } : Set β).Subsingleton) : #t ≤ #s

name: sum_card_eq_sum_biUnion_card
proof:
:= by
  convert sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow (fun j x => x ∈ B j)
  · grind [bipartiteAbove]
  · grind [bipartiteBelow]

name: card_le_card_of_leftTotal_unique
statement:
theorem card_le_card_of_leftTotal_unique (h₁ : LeftTotal r) (h₂ : LeftUnique r) :
    Fintype.card α ≤ Fintype.card β
proof:
:=
  card_le_card_of_forall_subsingleton r (by simpa using! h₁) fun _ _ _ ha₁ _ ha₂ ↦ h₂ ha₁.2 ha₂.2

name: card_le_card_of_rightTotal_unique
statement:
theorem card_le_card_of_rightTotal_unique (h₁ : RightTotal r) (h₂ : RightUnique r) :
    Fintype.card β ≤ Fintype.card α
proof:
:=
  card_le_card_of_forall_subsingleton' r (by simpa using! h₁) fun _ _ _ ha₁ _ ha₂ ↦ h₂ ha₁.2 ha₂.2

name: prod_indicator_biUnion_sub_indicator
statement:
lemma prod_indicator_biUnion_sub_indicator (hs : s.Nonempty) (S : ι → Set α) (a : α) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (Set.indicator (⋃ i ∈ s, S i) 1 a - Set.indicator (S i) 1 a) = (0 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, S i
  · have ha' := ha
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at ha
    obtain ⟨i, hi, ha⟩ := ha
    apply prod_eq_zero hi (by simp [ha, ha'])
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs
    have ha : a ∉ S i := by aesop
    exact prod_eq_zero hi <| by simp [*, -coe_biUnion]

name: indicator_biUnion_eq_sum_powerset
statement:
lemma indicator_biUnion_eq_sum_powerset (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set α) (f : α → G) (a : α) :
    Set.indicator (⋃ i ∈ s, S i) f a = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset with t.Nonempty,
      (-1) ^ (#t + 1) • Set.indicator (⋂ i ∈ t, S i) f a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ha : a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, S i; swap
  · simp only [ha, not_false_eq_true, Set.indicator_of_notMem, Int.reduceNeg, pow_succ, mul_neg,
      mul_one, neg_smul]
    symm
    apply sum_eq_zero
    simp only [Int.reduceNeg, neg_eq_zero, mem_filter, mem_powerset, and_imp]
    intro t hts ht
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem]
    · simp
    · contrapose ha
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at ha
      rcases ht with ⟨i, hi⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
      exact ⟨i, hts hi, ha _ hi⟩
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  calc
    Set.indicator (⋃ i ∈ s, S i) f a - ∑ t ∈ s.powerset with t.Nonempty,
      (-1) ^ (#t + 1) • Set.indicator (⋂ i ∈ t.1, S i) f a
    _ = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset with t.Nonempty, (-1) ^ #t • Set.indicator (⋂ i ∈ t, S i) f a +
        ∑ t ∈ s.powerset with ¬ t.Nonempty, (-1) ^ #t • Set.indicator (⋂ i ∈ t, S i) f a := by
      simp [sub_eq_neg_add, ← sum_neg_distrib, filter_eq', pow_succ, ha]
    _ = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, (-1) ^ #t • Set.indicator (⋂ i ∈ t, S i) f a := by
      rw [sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not]
    _ = (∏ i ∈ s, (1 - Set.indicator (S i) 1 a : ℤ)) • f a := by
      simp only [Int.reduceNeg, prod_sub, prod_const_one, mul_one, sum_smul]
      congr! 1 with t
      simp only [prod_const_one, prod_indicator_apply]
      simp [Set.indicator]
    _ = 0 := by
      have : Set.indicator (⋃ i ∈ s, S i) 1 a = (1 : ℤ) := Set.indicator_of_mem ha 1
      rw [← this, prod_indicator_biUnion_sub_indicator, zero_smul]
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at ha
      rcases ha with ⟨i, hi, -⟩
      exact ⟨i, hi⟩

name: prod_indicator_biUnion_finset_sub_indicator
statement:
lemma prod_indicator_biUnion_finset_sub_indicator (hs : s.Nonempty) (S : ι → Finset α) (a : α) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (Set.indicator (s.biUnion S) 1 a - Set.indicator (S i) 1 a) = (0 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  convert! prod_indicator_biUnion_sub_indicator hs (fun i ↦ S i) a
  simp

name: inclusion_exclusion_sum_biUnion
statement:
theorem inclusion_exclusion_sum_biUnion (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Finset α) (f : α → G) :
    ∑ a ∈ s.biUnion S, f a = ∑ t : s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty),
      (-1) ^ (#t.1 + 1) • ∑ a ∈ t.1.inf' (mem_filter.1 t.2).2 S, f a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  calc
    ∑ a ∈ s.biUnion S, f a - ∑ t : s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty),
      (-1) ^ (#t.1 + 1) • ∑ a ∈ t.1.inf' (mem_filter.1 t.2).2 S, f a
      = ∑ t : s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty),
          (-1) ^ #t.1 • ∑ a ∈ t.1.inf' (mem_filter.1 t.2).2 S, f a +
          ∑ t ∈ s.powerset.filter (¬ ·.Nonempty), (-1) ^ #t • ∑ a ∈ s.biUnion S, f a := by
      simp [sub_eq_neg_add, ← sum_neg_distrib, filter_eq', pow_succ]
    _ = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, (-1) ^ #t •
          if ht : t.Nonempty then ∑ a ∈ t.inf' ht S, f a else ∑ a ∈ s.biUnion S, f a := by
      rw [← sum_attach (filter ..)]; simp [sum_dite]
    _ = ∑ a ∈ s.biUnion S, (∏ i ∈ s, (1 - Set.indicator (S i) 1 a : ℤ)) • f a := by
      simp only [Int.reduceNeg, prod_sub, sum_comm (s := s.biUnion S), sum_smul, mul_assoc]
      congr! with t
      split_ifs with ht
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ht
        simp only [prod_const_one, prod_indicator_apply]
        simp only [smul_sum, Set.indicator, Set.mem_iInter, mem_coe, Pi.one_apply, mul_ite, mul_one,
          mul_zero, ite_smul, zero_smul, sum_ite, not_forall, sum_const_zero, add_zero]
        congr
        aesop
      · obtain rfl := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 ht
        simp
    _ = ∑ a ∈ s.biUnion S, (∏ i ∈ s,
          (Set.indicator (s.biUnion S) 1 a - Set.indicator (S i) 1 a) : ℤ) • f a := by
      congr! with t; rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ‹_›, Pi.one_apply]
    _ = 0 := by
      obtain rfl | hs := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty <;>
        simp [-coe_biUnion, prod_indicator_biUnion_finset_sub_indicator, *]

name: inclusion_exclusion_card_biUnion
statement:
theorem inclusion_exclusion_card_biUnion (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Finset α) :
    #(s.biUnion S) = ∑ t : s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty),
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (#t.1 + 1) * #(t.1.inf' (mem_filter.1 t.2).2 S)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inclusion_exclusion_sum_biUnion (G := ℤ) s S (f := 1)

name: inclusion_exclusion_sum_inf_compl
statement:
theorem inclusion_exclusion_sum_inf_compl (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Finset α) (f : α → G) :
    ∑ a ∈ s.inf fun i ↦ (S i)ᶜ, f a = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, (-1) ^ #t • ∑ a ∈ t.inf S, f a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∑ a ∈ s.inf fun i ↦ (S i)ᶜ, f a
      = ∑ a, f a - ∑ a ∈ s.biUnion S, f a := by
      rw [← Finset.compl_sup, sup_eq_biUnion, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, sum_compl_add_sum]
    _ = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset.filter (¬ ·.Nonempty), (-1) ^ #t • ∑ a ∈ t.inf S, f a
          + ∑ t ∈ s.powerset.filter (·.Nonempty), (-1) ^ #t • ∑ a ∈ t.inf S, f a := by
      simp [← sum_attach (filter ..), inclusion_exclusion_sum_biUnion, inf'_eq_inf, filter_eq',
        sub_eq_add_neg, pow_succ]
    _ = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, (-1) ^ #t • ∑ a ∈ t.inf S, f a := sum_filter_not_add_sum_filter ..

name: inclusion_exclusion_card_inf_compl
statement:
theorem inclusion_exclusion_card_inf_compl (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Finset α) :
    #(s.inf fun i ↦ (S i)ᶜ) = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ #t * #(t.inf S)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inclusion_exclusion_sum_inf_compl (G := ℤ) s S (f := 1)

name: DyckStep.dichotomy
statement: lemma DyckStep.dichotomy (s : DyckStep) : s = U ∨ s = D

name: toList_eq_nil
statement: lemma toList_eq_nil : p.toList = [] ↔ p = 0

name: toList_ne_nil
statement: lemma toList_ne_nil : p.toList ≠ [] ↔ p ≠ 0

name: head_eq_U
statement: lemma head_eq_U (p : DyckWord) (h) : p.toList.head h = U
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with - | s; · tauto
  rw [head_cons]
  by_contra f
  rename_i _ nonneg
  simpa [s.dichotomy.resolve_left f] using nonneg 1

name: getLast_eq_D
statement: lemma getLast_eq_D (p : DyckWord) (h) : p.toList.getLast h = D
proof:
:= by
  by_contra f; have s := p.count_U_eq_count_D
  rw [← dropLast_append_getLast h, (dichotomy _).resolve_right f] at s
  simp_rw [dropLast_eq_take, count_append, count_singleton', ite_true, reduceCtorEq, ite_false] at s
  have := p.count_D_le_count_U (p.toList.length - 1); lia

name: cons_tail_dropLast_concat
statement: lemma cons_tail_dropLast_concat : U :: p.toList.dropLast.tail ++ [D] = p
proof:
:= by
  have h' := toList_ne_nil.mpr h
  have : p.toList.dropLast.take 1 = [p.toList.head h'] := by
    rcases p with - | ⟨s, ⟨- | ⟨t, r⟩⟩⟩
    · tauto
    · rename_i bal _
      cases s <;> simp at bal
    · tauto
  nth_rw 2 [← p.toList.dropLast_append_getLast h', ← p.toList.dropLast.take_append_drop 1]
  rw [getLast_eq_D, drop_one, this, head_eq_U]
  rfl

name: nest_ne_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma nest_ne_zero : p.nest ≠ 0

name: IsNested.nest
statement: protected lemma IsNested.nest : p.nest.IsNested
proof:
:= ⟨nest_ne_zero, fun i lb ub ↦ by
  simp_rw [nest, length_append, length_singleton] at ub ⊢
  rw [take_append_of_le_length (by rw [singleton_append, length_cons]; lia),
    take_append, take_of_length_le (by rw [length_singleton]; lia),
    length_singleton, singleton_append, count_cons_of_ne (by simp), count_cons_self,
    Nat.lt_add_one_iff]
  exact p.count_D_le_count_U _⟩

name: nest_denest
statement: lemma nest_denest (hn) : (p.denest hn).nest = p

name: denest_nest
statement: lemma denest_nest : p.nest.denest .nest = p
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [nest, denest, DyckWord.ext_iff, dropLast_concat]; rfl

name: semilength_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma semilength_zero : semilength 0 = 0

name: semilength_add
statement: @[simp] lemma semilength_add : (p + q).semilength = p.semilength + q.semilength

name: semilength_nest
statement: @[simp] lemma semilength_nest : p.nest.semilength = p.semilength + 1

name: semilength_eq_count_D
statement: lemma semilength_eq_count_D : p.semilength = p.toList.count D

name: two_mul_semilength_eq_length
statement:
@[simp]
lemma two_mul_semilength_eq_length : 2 * p.semilength = p.toList.length
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [two_mul, semilength, p.count_U_eq_count_D, semilength]
  convert! (p.toList.length_eq_countP_add_countP (· == D)).symm
  rw [count]; congr!; rename_i s; cases s <;> tauto

name: firstReturn_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma firstReturn_zero : firstReturn 0 = 0

name: firstReturn_pos
statement: lemma firstReturn_pos : 0 < p.firstReturn
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_le, Nat.le_zero, firstReturn, findIdx_eq, getElem_range]
  · rw! [← p.cons_tail_dropLast_concat h]
    simp
  · rw [length_range, length_pos_iff]
    exact toList_ne_nil.mpr h

name: firstReturn_lt_length
statement: lemma firstReturn_lt_length : p.firstReturn < p.toList.length
proof:
:= by
  have lp := length_pos_of_ne_nil (toList_ne_nil.mpr h)
  rw [← length_range (n := p.toList.length)]
  apply findIdx_lt_length_of_exists
  simp only [mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  use p.toList.length - 1
  exact ⟨by lia, by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel lp, take_of_length_le (le_refl _),
    p.count_U_eq_count_D]⟩

name: count_take_firstReturn_add_one
statement:
lemma count_take_firstReturn_add_one :
    (p.toList.take (p.firstReturn + 1)).count U = (p.toList.take (p.firstReturn + 1)).count D
proof:
:= by
  have := findIdx_getElem
    (w := (length_range (n := p.toList.length)).symm ▸ firstReturn_lt_length h)
  simpa using! this

name: count_D_lt_count_U_of_lt_firstReturn
statement:
lemma count_D_lt_count_U_of_lt_firstReturn {i : ℕ} (hi : i < p.firstReturn) :
    (p.toList.take (i + 1)).count D < (p.toList.take (i + 1)).count U
proof:
:= by
  have ne := not_of_lt_findIdx hi
  rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not, ← ne_eq, getElem_range] at ne
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne (p.count_D_le_count_U (i + 1)) ne.symm

name: firstReturn_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma firstReturn_add : (p + q).firstReturn = if p = 0 then q.firstReturn else p.firstReturn
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h; · simp [h]
  have u : (p + q).toList = p.toList ++ q.toList := rfl
  rw [firstReturn, findIdx_eq]
  · simp_rw [u, decide_eq_true_eq, getElem_range]
    have v := firstReturn_lt_length h
    constructor
    · rw [take_append, show p.firstReturn + 1 - p.toList.length = 0 by lia,
        take_zero, append_nil, count_take_firstReturn_add_one h]
    · intro j hj
      rw [take_append, show j + 1 - p.toList.length = 0 by lia,
        take_zero, append_nil]
      simpa using (count_D_lt_count_U_of_lt_firstReturn hj).ne'
  · rw [length_range, u, length_append]
    exact Nat.lt_add_right _ (firstReturn_lt_length h)

name: firstReturn_nest
statement:
@[simp]
lemma firstReturn_nest : p.nest.firstReturn = p.toList.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  have u : p.nest.toList = U :: p.toList ++ [D] := rfl
  rw [firstReturn, findIdx_eq]
  · simp_rw [u, decide_eq_true_eq, getElem_range]
    constructor
    · rw [take_of_length_le (by simp), ← u, p.nest.count_U_eq_count_D]
    · intro j hj
      simp_rw [cons_append, take_succ_cons, count_cons, beq_self_eq_true, ite_true,
        beq_iff_eq, reduceCtorEq, ite_false, take_append,
        show j - p.toList.length = 0 by lia, take_zero, append_nil]
      have := p.count_D_le_count_U j
      simp only [add_zero, decide_eq_false_iff_not, ne_eq]
      lia
  · simp_rw [length_range, u, length_append, length_cons]
    exact Nat.lt_add_one _

name: insidePart_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma insidePart_zero : insidePart 0 = 0

name: outsidePart_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma outsidePart_zero : outsidePart 0 = 0

name: insidePart_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma insidePart_add : (p + q).insidePart = p.insidePart
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [insidePart, firstReturn_add, add_eq_zero, h, false_and, dite_false, ite_false,
    DyckWord.ext_iff, take]
  congr 3
  exact take_append_of_le_length (firstReturn_lt_length h)

name: outsidePart_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma outsidePart_add : (p + q).outsidePart = p.outsidePart + q
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [outsidePart, firstReturn_add, add_eq_zero, h, false_and, dite_false, ite_false,
    DyckWord.ext_iff, drop]
  exact drop_append_of_le_length (firstReturn_lt_length h)

name: insidePart_nest
statement:
@[simp]
lemma insidePart_nest : p.nest.insidePart = p
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [insidePart, nest_ne_zero, dite_false, firstReturn_nest]
  convert! p.denest_nest; rw [DyckWord.ext_iff]; apply take_of_length_le
  simp_rw [nest, length_append, length_singleton]; lia

name: outsidePart_nest
statement:
@[simp]
lemma outsidePart_nest : p.nest.outsidePart = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [outsidePart, nest_ne_zero, dite_false, firstReturn_nest]
  rw [DyckWord.ext_iff]; apply drop_of_length_le
  simp_rw [nest, length_append, length_singleton]; lia

name: nest_insidePart_add_outsidePart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nest_insidePart_add_outsidePart : p.insidePart.nest + p.outsidePart = p
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [insidePart, outsidePart, h, dite_false, nest_denest, DyckWord.ext_iff]
  apply take_append_drop

name: semilength_insidePart_add_semilength_outsidePart_add_one
statement:
lemma semilength_insidePart_add_semilength_outsidePart_add_one :
    p.insidePart.semilength + p.outsidePart.semilength + 1 = p.semilength
proof:
:= by
  rw [← congrArg semilength (nest_insidePart_add_outsidePart h), semilength_add, semilength_nest,
    add_right_comm]

name: semilength_insidePart_lt
statement: theorem semilength_insidePart_lt : p.insidePart.semilength < p.semilength

name: semilength_outsidePart_lt
statement: theorem semilength_outsidePart_lt : p.outsidePart.semilength < p.semilength

name: le_add_self
statement: lemma le_add_self (p q : DyckWord) : q ≤ p + q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : p = 0
  · simp [h]
  · have := semilength_outsidePart_lt h
    exact (le_add_self p.outsidePart q).trans
      (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (Or.inr (outsidePart_add h).symm))

name: infix_of_le
statement: lemma infix_of_le (h : p ≤ q) : p.toList <:+: q.toList
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact infix_refl _
  | tail _pm mq ih =>
    rename_i m r
    rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with rfl | hr
    · rw [insidePart_zero, outsidePart_zero, or_self] at mq
      rwa [mq] at ih
    · have : [U] ++ r.insidePart ++ [D] ++ r.outsidePart = r :=
        DyckWord.ext_iff.mp (nest_insidePart_add_outsidePart hr)
      grind

name: le_of_suffix
statement: lemma le_of_suffix (h : p.toList <:+ q.toList) : p ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r', h⟩ := h
  have hc : (q.toList.take (q.toList.length - p.toList.length)).count U =
      (q.toList.take (q.toList.length - p.toList.length)).count D := by
    have hq := q.count_U_eq_count_D
    rw [← h] at hq ⊢
    rw [count_append, count_append, p.count_U_eq_count_D, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hq
    simp [hq]
  let r : DyckWord := q.take _ hc
  have e : r' = r := by
    simp_rw [r, take, ← h, length_append, add_tsub_cancel_right, take_left']
  rw [e] at h; replace h : r + p = q := DyckWord.ext h; rw [← h]; exact le_add_self ..

name: pos_iff_ne_zero
statement: protected lemma pos_iff_ne_zero : 0 < p ↔ p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_comm, iff_comm, ne_iff_lt_iff_le]
  exact DyckWord.zero_le p

name: monotone_semilength
statement: lemma monotone_semilength : Monotone semilength
proof:
:= fun p q pq ↦ by
  induction pq with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ mq ih =>
    rename_i m r _
    rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with rfl | hr
    · rw [insidePart_zero, outsidePart_zero, or_self] at mq
      rwa [mq] at ih
    · rcases mq with hm | hm
      · exact ih.trans (hm ▸ semilength_insidePart_lt hr).le
      · exact ih.trans (hm ▸ semilength_outsidePart_lt hr).le

name: strictMono_semilength
statement: lemma strictMono_semilength : StrictMono semilength
proof:
:= fun p q pq ↦ by
  obtain ⟨plq, pnq⟩ := lt_iff_le_and_ne.mp pq
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (monotone_semilength plq)
  contrapose pnq
  replace pnq := congr(2 * $(pnq))
  simp_rw [two_mul_semilength_eq_length] at pnq
  exact DyckWord.ext ((infix_of_le plq).eq_of_length pnq)

name: ofTree_toTree
statement: lemma ofTree_toTree (p) : ofTree p.toTree = p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : p = 0
  · simp [h, toTree, ofTree]
  · rw [toTree]
    simp_rw [h, ite_false, ofTree]
    rw [ofTree_toTree p.insidePart, ofTree_toTree p.outsidePart]
    exact nest_insidePart_add_outsidePart h

name: toTree_ofTree
statement:
lemma toTree_ofTree : ∀ t, (ofTree t).toTree = t
  | BinaryTree.nil => by simp [ofTree, toTree]
  | BinaryTree.node _ _ _ => by simp [ofTree, toTree, toTree_ofTree]

/
@[simps] def equivTree : DyckWord ≃ BinaryTree Unit where
  toFun
proof:
:= toTree
  invFun := ofTree
  left_inv := ofTree_toTree
  right_inv := toTree_ofTree

name: numNodes_toTree
statement:
@[simp]
lemma numNodes_toTree (p : DyckWord) : p.toTree.numNodes = p.semilength
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : p = 0
  · simp [h, toTree]
  · rw [toTree]
    simp_rw [h, ite_false, numNodes]
    rw [← semilength_insidePart_add_semilength_outsidePart_add_one h,
      numNodes_toTree p.insidePart, numNodes_toTree p.outsidePart]

name: card_dyckWord_semilength_eq_catalan
statement:
theorem card_dyckWord_semilength_eq_catalan (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card { p : DyckWord // p.semilength = n } = catalan n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.ofEquiv_card (equivTreesOfNumNodesEq n), ← treesOfNumNodesEq_card_eq_catalan]
  convert! Fintype.card_coe _

:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← c.blocks_sum, ← ofFn_blocksFun, sum_ofFn]

name: blocksFun_mem_blocks

@[simp]
theorem blocksFun_mem_blocks (i : Fin c.length) : c.blocksFun i ∈ c.blocks

statement: theorem one_le_blocks {i : ℕ} (h : i ∈ c.blocks) : 1 ≤ i

name: length_le

theorem length_le : c.length ≤ n

name: blocks_eq_nil

theorem blocks_eq_nil : c.blocks = [] ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using congr(List.sum $h)
  · rintro rfl
    rw [← length_eq_zero_iff, ← nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
    exact c.length_le

name: length_eq_zero
statement: protected theorem length_eq_zero : c.length = 0 ↔ n = 0

name: length_pos_iff

name: sizeUpTo_ofLength_le

proof:
:= by
  dsimp [sizeUpTo]
  convert! c.blocks_sum
  exact take_of_length_le h

name: sizeUpTo_le

name: coe_embedding
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_embedding (i : Fin c.length) (j : Fin (c.blocksFun i)) :
    (c.embedding i j : ℕ) = c.sizeUpTo i + j

name: index_exists
statement: theorem index_exists {j : ℕ} (h : j < n) : ∃ i : ℕ, j < c.sizeUpTo (i + 1) ∧ i < c.length
proof:
:= by
  have length_pos := length_pos_of_sum_pos (blocks c) (h.pos.trans_eq c.blocks_sum.symm)
  refine ⟨_, ?_, Nat.pred_lt length_pos.ne'⟩
  have : c.length - 1 + 1 = c.length := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos length_pos
  simp [this, h]

name: lt_sizeUpTo_index_succ
statement: theorem lt_sizeUpTo_index_succ (j : Fin n) : (j : ℕ) < c.sizeUpTo (c.index j).succ

name: sizeUpTo_index_le
statement: theorem sizeUpTo_index_le (j : Fin n) : c.sizeUpTo (c.index j) ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! H
  set i := c.index j
  have i_pos : (0 : ℕ) < i := by
    by_contra! i_pos
    revert H
    simp [nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 i_pos, c.sizeUpTo_zero]
  let i₁ := (i : ℕ).pred
  have i₁_lt_i : i₁ < i := Nat.pred_lt (ne_of_gt i_pos)
  have i₁_succ : i₁ + 1 = i := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos i_pos
  have := Nat.find_min (c.index_exists j.2) i₁_lt_i
  simp_all [lt_trans i₁_lt_i (c.index j).2]

name: coe_invEmbedding
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_invEmbedding (j : Fin n) : (c.invEmbedding j : ℕ) = j - c.sizeUpTo (c.index j)

name: embedding_comp_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embedding_comp_inv (j : Fin n) : c.embedding (c.index j) (c.invEmbedding j) = j

name: mem_range_embedding_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_embedding_iff {j : Fin n} {i : Fin c.length} :
    j ∈ Set.range (c.embedding i) ↔ c.sizeUpTo i ≤ j ∧ (j : ℕ) < c.sizeUpTo (i : ℕ).succ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases Set.mem_range.2 h with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at hk
    dsimp at hk
    rw [← hk]
    simp [sizeUpTo_succ', k.is_lt]
  · intro h
    apply Set.mem_range.2
    refine ⟨⟨j - c.sizeUpTo i, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [tsub_lt_iff_left, ← sizeUpTo_succ']
      · exact h.2
      · exact h.1
    · rw [Fin.ext_iff]
      exact add_tsub_cancel_of_le h.1

name: disjoint_range
statement:
theorem disjoint_range {i₁ i₂ : Fin c.length} (h : i₁ ≠ i₂) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (c.embedding i₁)) (Set.range (c.embedding i₂))
proof:
:= by
  wlog h' : i₁ < i₂
  · exact (this c h.symm (h.lt_or_gt.resolve_left h')).symm
  by_contra d
  obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ :
    ∃ x : Fin n, x ∈ Set.range (c.embedding i₁) ∧ x ∈ Set.range (c.embedding i₂) :=
    Set.not_disjoint_iff.1 d
  have A : (i₁ : ℕ).succ ≤ i₂ := Nat.succ_le_of_lt h'
  apply lt_irrefl (x : ℕ)
  calc
    (x : ℕ) < c.sizeUpTo (i₁ : ℕ).succ := (c.mem_range_embedding_iff.1 hx₁).2
    _ ≤ c.sizeUpTo (i₂ : ℕ) := monotone_sum_take _ A
    _ ≤ x := (c.mem_range_embedding_iff.1 hx₂).1

name: mem_range_embedding
statement: theorem mem_range_embedding (j : Fin n) : j ∈ Set.range (c.embedding (c.index j))
proof:
:= by
  have : c.embedding (c.index j) (c.invEmbedding j) ∈ Set.range (c.embedding (c.index j)) :=
    Set.mem_range_self _
  rwa [c.embedding_comp_inv j] at this

name: mem_range_embedding_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_range_embedding_iff' {j : Fin n} {i : Fin c.length} :
    j ∈ Set.range (c.embedding i) ↔ i = c.index j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [← not_imp_not]
    intro h
    exact Set.disjoint_right.1 (c.disjoint_range h) (c.mem_range_embedding j)
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact c.mem_range_embedding j

name: index_embedding
statement:
@[simp]
theorem index_embedding (i : Fin c.length) (j : Fin (c.blocksFun i)) :
    c.index (c.embedding i j) = i
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [← mem_range_embedding_iff']
  apply Set.mem_range_self

name: invEmbedding_comp
statement:
theorem invEmbedding_comp (i : Fin c.length) (j : Fin (c.blocksFun i)) :
    (c.invEmbedding (c.embedding i j) : ℕ) = j

name: blocksFun_congr
statement:
theorem blocksFun_congr {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (c₁ : Composition n₁) (c₂ : Composition n₂) (i₁ : Fin c₁.length)
    (i₂ : Fin c₂.length) (hn : n₁ = n₂) (hc : c₁.blocks = c₂.blocks) (hi : (i₁ : ℕ) = i₂) :
    c₁.blocksFun i₁ = c₂.blocksFun i₂
proof:
:= by
  cases hn
  rw [← Composition.ext_iff] at hc
  cases hc
  congr
  rwa [Fin.ext_iff]

name: sigma_eq_iff_blocks_eq
statement:
theorem sigma_eq_iff_blocks_eq {c : Σ n, Composition n} {c' : Σ n, Composition n} :
    c = c' ↔ c.2.blocks = c'.2.blocks
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H => by rw [H], fun H => ?_⟩
  rcases c with ⟨n, c⟩
  rcases c' with ⟨n', c'⟩
  have : n = n' := by rw [← c.blocks_sum, ← c'.blocks_sum, H]
  induction this
  congr
  ext1
  exact H

name: prod_prod_apply_embedding
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_prod_apply_embedding {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] (a : Fin n → A) (x : Composition n) :
    ∏ i, ∏ j, a (x.embedding i j) = ∏ i, a i
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Finset.prod_sigma', Finset.univ_sigma_univ] using! x.blocksFinEquiv.prod_comp a

name: ones_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ones_length (n : ℕ) : (ones n).length = n

name: ones_blocks
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ones_blocks (n : ℕ) : (ones n).blocks = replicate n (1 : ℕ)

name: ones_blocksFun
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ones_blocksFun (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (ones n).length) : (ones n).blocksFun i = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blocksFun, ones, get_eq_getElem, getElem_replicate]

name: ones_sizeUpTo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ones_sizeUpTo (n : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : (ones n).sizeUpTo i = min i n

name: ones_embedding
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ones_embedding (i : Fin (ones n).length) (h : 0 < (ones n).blocksFun i) :
    (ones n).embedding i ⟨0, h⟩ = ⟨i, lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 (ones n).length_le⟩

name: eq_ones_iff
statement: theorem eq_ones_iff {c : Composition n} : c = ones n ↔ ∀ i ∈ c.blocks, i = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact fun i => eq_of_mem_replicate
  · intro H
    ext1
    have A : c.blocks = replicate c.blocks.length 1 := eq_replicate_of_mem H
    have : c.blocks.length = n := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← c.blocks_sum, A]
      simp
    rw [A, this, ones_blocks]

name: ne_ones_iff
statement: theorem ne_ones_iff {c : Composition n} : c ≠ ones n ↔ ∃ i ∈ c.blocks, 1 < i
proof:
:= by
  refine (not_congr eq_ones_iff).trans ?_
  have : ∀ j ∈ c.blocks, j = 1 ↔ j ≤ 1 := fun j hj => by simp [le_antisymm_iff, c.one_le_blocks hj]
  simp +contextual [this]

name: eq_ones_iff_length
statement: theorem eq_ones_iff_length {c : Composition n} : c = ones n ↔ c.length = n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ones_length n
  · contrapose
    intro H length_n
    apply lt_irrefl n
    calc
      n = ∑ i : Fin c.length, 1 := by simp [length_n]
      _ < ∑ i : Fin c.length, c.blocksFun i := by
        {
        obtain ⟨i, hi, i_blocks⟩ : ∃ i ∈ c.blocks, 1 < i := ne_ones_iff.1 H
        rw [← ofFn_blocksFun, mem_ofFn' c.blocksFun, Set.mem_range] at hi
        obtain ⟨j : Fin c.length, hj : c.blocksFun j = i⟩ := hi
        rw [← hj] at i_blocks
        exact Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun i _ => one_le_blocksFun c i) ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, i_blocks⟩
        }
      _ = n := c.sum_blocksFun

name: eq_ones_iff_le_length
statement: theorem eq_ones_iff_le_length {c : Composition n} : c = ones n ↔ n ≤ c.length

name: single_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_length {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) : (single n h).length = 1

name: single_blocks
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_blocks {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) : (single n h).blocks = [n]

name: single_blocksFun
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_blocksFun {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) (i : Fin (single n h).length) :
    (single n h).blocksFun i = n

name: single_embedding
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_embedding {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) :
    ((single n h).embedding (0 : Fin 1)) i = i

name: eq_single_iff_length
statement:
theorem eq_single_iff_length {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) {c : Composition n} :
    c = single n h ↔ c.length = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    rw [H]
    exact single_length h
  · intro H
    ext1
    have A : c.blocks.length = 1 := H ▸ c.blocks_length
    have B : c.blocks.sum = n := c.blocks_sum
    rw [eq_cons_of_length_one A] at B ⊢
    simpa [single_blocks] using B

name: ne_single_iff
statement:
theorem ne_single_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {c : Composition n} :
    c ≠ single n hn ↔ ∀ i, c.blocksFun i < n
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [eq_single_iff_length]
    have : ∀ j : Fin c.length, j = i := by
      intro j
      by_contra ji
      apply lt_irrefl (∑ k, c.blocksFun k)
      calc
        ∑ k, c.blocksFun k ≤ c.blocksFun i := by simp only [c.sum_blocksFun, hi]
        _ < ∑ k, c.blocksFun k :=
          Finset.single_lt_sum ji (Finset.mem_univ _) (Finset.mem_univ _) (c.one_le_blocksFun j)
            fun _ _ _ => zero_le
    simpa using Fintype.card_eq_one_of_forall_eq this

name: cast_rfl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cast_rfl (c : Composition n) : c.cast rfl = c

name: cast_heq
statement: theorem cast_heq (c : Composition m) (hmn : m = n) : c.cast hmn ≍ c

name: cast_eq_cast
statement:
theorem cast_eq_cast (c : Composition m) (hmn : m = n) :
    c.cast hmn = cast (hmn ▸ rfl) c

name: reverse_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reverse_reverse (c : Composition n) : c.reverse.reverse = c

name: reverse_involutive

name: reverse_bijective

lemma reverse_inj {c₁ c₂ : Composition n} : c₁.reverse = c₂.reverse ↔ c₁ = c₂

name: reverse_ones
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reverse_ones : (ones n).reverse = ones n

statement:
@[simp]
lemma reverse_single (hn : 0 < n) : (single n hn).reverse = single n hn

name: reverse_eq_ones

lemma reverse_eq_single {hn : 0 < n} {c : Composition n} :

statement:
lemma reverse_append (c₁ : Composition m) (c₂ : Composition n) :
    reverse (append c₁ c₂) = (append c₂.reverse c₁.reverse).cast (add_comm _ _)

name: splitWrtCompositionAux_cons
statement:
@[local simp]
theorem splitWrtCompositionAux_cons (l : List α) (n ns) :
    l.splitWrtCompositionAux (n::ns) = take n l::(drop n l).splitWrtCompositionAux ns

name: length_splitWrtCompositionAux
statement:
theorem length_splitWrtCompositionAux (l : List α) (ns) :
    length (l.splitWrtCompositionAux ns) = ns.length
proof:
:= by
    induction ns generalizing l
    · simp [splitWrtCompositionAux, *]
    · simp [*]

name: length_splitWrtComposition
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_splitWrtComposition (l : List α) (c : Composition n) :
    length (l.splitWrtComposition c) = c.length

name: map_length_splitWrtCompositionAux
statement:
theorem map_length_splitWrtCompositionAux {ns : List ℕ} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, ns.sum ≤ l.length → map length (l.splitWrtCompositionAux ns) = ns
proof:
:= by
  induction ns with
  | nil => simp [splitWrtCompositionAux]
  | cons n ns IH => grind [splitWrtCompositionAux_cons]

name: map_length_splitWrtComposition
statement:
theorem map_length_splitWrtComposition (l : List α) (c : Composition l.length) :
    map length (l.splitWrtComposition c) = c.blocks

name: length_pos_of_mem_splitWrtComposition
statement:
theorem length_pos_of_mem_splitWrtComposition {l l' : List α} {c : Composition l.length}
    (h : l' ∈ l.splitWrtComposition c) : 0 < length l'
proof:
:= by
  have : l'.length ∈ (l.splitWrtComposition c).map List.length :=
    List.mem_map_of_mem h
  rw [map_length_splitWrtComposition] at this
  exact c.blocks_pos this

name: sum_take_map_length_splitWrtComposition
statement:
theorem sum_take_map_length_splitWrtComposition (l : List α) (c : Composition l.length) (i : ℕ) :
    (((l.splitWrtComposition c).map length).take i).sum = c.sizeUpTo i
proof:
:= by
  congr
  exact map_length_splitWrtComposition l c

name: getElem_splitWrtCompositionAux
statement:
theorem getElem_splitWrtCompositionAux (l : List α) (ns : List ℕ) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < (l.splitWrtCompositionAux ns).length) :
    (l.splitWrtCompositionAux ns)[i] =
      (l.take (ns.take (i + 1)).sum).drop (ns.take i).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction ns generalizing l i with
  | nil => cases hi
  | cons n ns IH =>
    rcases i with - | i
    · simp
    · simp only [splitWrtCompositionAux, getElem_cons_succ, IH, take,
          sum_cons, splitAt_eq, drop_take, drop_drop]
      rw [Nat.add_sub_add_left]

name: getElem_splitWrtComposition'
getElem_splitWrtComposition
statement:
theorem getElem_splitWrtComposition (l : List α) (c : Composition n)
    (i : Nat) (h : i < (l.splitWrtComposition c).length) :
    (l.splitWrtComposition c)[i] = (l.take (c.sizeUpTo (i + 1))).drop (c.sizeUpTo i)

name: flatten_splitWrtCompositionAux
statement:
theorem flatten_splitWrtCompositionAux {ns : List ℕ} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, ns.sum = l.length → (l.splitWrtCompositionAux ns).flatten = l
proof:
:= by
  induction ns with
  | nil => exact fun h ↦ (length_eq_zero_iff.1 h.symm).symm
  | cons n ns IH =>
    intro l h; rw [sum_cons] at h
    simp only [splitWrtCompositionAux_cons]; dsimp
    rw [IH]
    · simp
    · rw [length_drop, ← h, add_tsub_cancel_left]

name: flatten_splitWrtComposition
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flatten_splitWrtComposition (l : List α) (c : Composition l.length) :
    (l.splitWrtComposition c).flatten = l

name: splitWrtComposition_flatten
statement:
@[simp]
theorem splitWrtComposition_flatten (L : List (List α)) (c : Composition L.flatten.length)
    (h : map length L = c.blocks) : splitWrtComposition (flatten L) c = L
proof:
:= by
  simp only [and_self_iff, eq_iff_flatten_eq, flatten_splitWrtComposition,
    map_length_splitWrtComposition, h]

name: compositionAsSet_card
statement: theorem compositionAsSet_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (CompositionAsSet n) = 2 ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype.card (Finset (Fin (n - 1))) = 2 ^ (n - 1) := by simp
  rw [← this]
  exact Fintype.card_congr (compositionAsSetEquiv n)

name: boundaries_nonempty
statement: theorem boundaries_nonempty : c.boundaries.Nonempty

name: card_boundaries_pos
statement: theorem card_boundaries_pos : 0 < Finset.card c.boundaries

name: card_boundaries_eq_succ_length
statement: theorem card_boundaries_eq_succ_length : c.boundaries.card = c.length + 1

name: length_lt_card_boundaries
statement: theorem length_lt_card_boundaries : c.length < c.boundaries.card

name: lt_length
statement: theorem lt_length (i : Fin c.length) : (i : ℕ) + 1 < c.boundaries.card

name: lt_length'
statement: theorem lt_length' (i : Fin c.length) : (i : ℕ) < c.boundaries.card

name: boundary_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundary_zero : (c.boundary ⟨0, c.card_boundaries_pos⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundary, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_zero rfl c.card_boundaries_pos]
  exact le_antisymm (Finset.min'_le _ _ c.zero_mem) (Fin.zero_le _)

name: boundary_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundary_length : c.boundary ⟨c.length, c.length_lt_card_boundaries⟩ = Fin.last n
proof:
:= by
  convert! Finset.orderEmbOfFin_last rfl c.card_boundaries_pos
  exact le_antisymm (Finset.le_max' _ _ c.getLast_mem) (Fin.le_last _)

name: blocksFun_pos
statement: theorem blocksFun_pos (i : Fin c.length) : 0 < c.blocksFun i
proof:
:=
  haveI : (⟨i, c.lt_length' i⟩ : Fin c.boundaries.card) < ⟨i + 1, c.lt_length i⟩ :=
    Nat.lt_succ_self _
  lt_tsub_iff_left.mpr ((c.boundaries.orderEmbOfFin rfl).strictMono this)

name: blocks_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blocks_length : c.blocks.length = c.length

name: blocks_partial_sum
statement:
theorem blocks_partial_sum {i : ℕ} (h : i < c.boundaries.card) :
    (c.blocks.take i).sum = c.boundary ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i IH =>
    have A : i < c.blocks.length := by
      rw [c.card_boundaries_eq_succ_length] at h
      simp [blocks, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h]
    have B : i < c.boundaries.card := lt_of_lt_of_le A (by simp [blocks, length])
    rw [sum_take_succ _ _ A, IH B]
    simp [blocks, blocksFun]

name: mem_boundaries_iff_exists_blocks_sum_take_eq
statement:
theorem mem_boundaries_iff_exists_blocks_sum_take_eq {j : Fin (n + 1)} :
    j ∈ c.boundaries ↔ ∃ i < c.boundaries.card, (c.blocks.take i).sum = j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hj
    rcases (c.boundaries.orderIsoOfFin rfl).surjective ⟨j, hj⟩ with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [Subtype.ext_iff, Subtype.coe_mk] at hi
    refine ⟨i.1, i.2, ?_⟩
    dsimp at hi
    rw [← hi, c.blocks_partial_sum i.2]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, H⟩
    convert! (c.boundaries.orderIsoOfFin rfl ⟨i, hi⟩).2
    have : c.boundary ⟨i, hi⟩ = j := by rwa [Fin.ext_iff, ← c.blocks_partial_sum hi]
    exact this.symm

name: blocks_sum
statement: theorem blocks_sum : c.blocks.sum = n
proof:
:= by
  have : c.blocks.take c.length = c.blocks := take_of_length_le (by simp [blocks])
  rw [← this, c.blocks_partial_sum c.length_lt_card_boundaries, c.boundary_length]
  rfl

name: Composition.toCompositionAsSet_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Composition.toCompositionAsSet_length (c : Composition n) :
    c.toCompositionAsSet.length = c.length

name: CompositionAsSet.toComposition_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CompositionAsSet.toComposition_length (c : CompositionAsSet n) :
    c.toComposition.length = c.length

name: Composition.toCompositionAsSet_blocks
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Composition.toCompositionAsSet_blocks (c : Composition n) :
    c.toCompositionAsSet.blocks = c.blocks
proof:
:= by
  let d := c.toCompositionAsSet
  change d.blocks = c.blocks
  have length_eq : d.blocks.length = c.blocks.length := by simp [d, blocks_length]
  suffices H : ∀ i ≤ d.blocks.length, (d.blocks.take i).sum = (c.blocks.take i).sum from
    eq_of_sum_take_eq length_eq H
  intro i hi
  have i_lt : i < d.boundaries.card := by
    simpa [CompositionAsSet.blocks, length_ofFn,
      d.card_boundaries_eq_succ_length] using Nat.lt_succ_iff.2 hi
  have i_lt' : i < c.boundaries.card := i_lt
  have i_lt'' : i < c.length + 1 := by rwa [c.card_boundaries_eq_succ_length] at i_lt'
  have A :
    d.boundaries.orderEmbOfFin rfl ⟨i, i_lt⟩ =
      c.boundaries.orderEmbOfFin c.card_boundaries_eq_succ_length ⟨i, i_lt''⟩ :=
    rfl
  have B : c.sizeUpTo i = c.boundary ⟨i, i_lt''⟩ := rfl
  rw [d.blocks_partial_sum i_lt, CompositionAsSet.boundary, ← Composition.sizeUpTo, B, A,
    c.orderEmbOfFin_boundaries]

name: CompositionAsSet.toComposition_blocks
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CompositionAsSet.toComposition_blocks (c : CompositionAsSet n) :
    c.toComposition.blocks = c.blocks

name: CompositionAsSet.toComposition_boundaries
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CompositionAsSet.toComposition_boundaries (c : CompositionAsSet n) :
    c.toComposition.boundaries = c.boundaries
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨j, hj⟩
  simp [c.mem_boundaries_iff_exists_blocks_sum_take_eq, Composition.boundaries,
    c.card_boundaries_eq_succ_length, Composition.boundary, Composition.sizeUpTo, Fin.exists_iff]

name: Composition.toCompositionAsSet_boundaries
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Composition.toCompositionAsSet_boundaries (c : Composition n) :
    c.toCompositionAsSet.boundaries = c.boundaries

name: composition_card
statement: theorem composition_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Composition n) = 2 ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← compositionAsSet_card n]
  exact Fintype.card_congr (compositionEquiv n)

name: largeSchroder_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem largeSchroder_zero : largeSchroder 0 = 1

name: largeSchroder_one
statement: @[simp] theorem largeSchroder_one : largeSchroder 1 = 2

name: largeSchroder_two
statement: @[simp] theorem largeSchroder_two : largeSchroder 2 = 6

name: largeSchroder_succ
statement:
theorem largeSchroder_succ (n : ℕ) :
    largeSchroder (n + 1) = largeSchroder n + ∑ i ≤ n, largeSchroder i * largeSchroder (n - i)

name: even_largeSchroder
statement:
theorem even_largeSchroder : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → Even (largeSchroder n)
  | 1, _ => by simp
  | n + 2, _ => by
    rw [largeSchroder_succ]
    refine .add (even_largeSchroder n.succ_ne_zero) <| even_sum _ fun k hk ↦ ?_
    obtain _ | k
proof:
:= k
    · simpa using even_largeSchroder n.succ_ne_zero
    have : k < n + 1 := by simp at hk; lia
    exact .mul_right (even_largeSchroder k.succ_ne_zero) _

name: smallSchroder_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma smallSchroder_zero : smallSchroder 0 = 1

name: smallSchroder_one
statement: @[simp] lemma smallSchroder_one : smallSchroder 1 = 1

name: smallSchroder_succ_eq_largeSchroder_div_two
statement:
lemma smallSchroder_succ_eq_largeSchroder_div_two (h : n ≠ 0) :
    smallSchroder (n + 1) = largeSchroder n / 2

name: two_mul_smallSchroder_succ
statement: lemma two_mul_smallSchroder_succ (hn : n ≠ 0) : 2 * smallSchroder (n + 1) = largeSchroder n

name: smallSchroder_succ
statement:
theorem smallSchroder_succ (hn : 1 < n) :
    smallSchroder (n + 1) =
      3 * n.smallSchroder +
          2 * ∑ i ∈ Ioo 0 (n - 1), (i + 1).smallSchroder * (n - i).smallSchroder
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ | n := n
  · simp at hn
  · simp at hn
  refine Nat.mul_left_cancel zero_lt_two ?_
  calc
        2 * (n + 3).smallSchroder
    _ = 3 * (n + 1).largeSchroder +
          ∑ i ∈ Ioo 0 (n + 1), i.largeSchroder * (n + 1 - i).largeSchroder := by
      rw [two_mul_smallSchroder_succ, largeSchroder_succ, ← Icc_bot, ← sum_Ioc_add_eq_sum_Icc,
        ← sum_Ioo_add_eq_sum_Ioc] <;> simp; lia
    _ = 3 * (n + 1).largeSchroder +
          ∑ i ∈ Ioo 0 (n + 1), (2 * (i + 1).smallSchroder) * (2 * (n + 2 - i).smallSchroder) := by
      congr! 2 with i hi
      simp at hi
      rw [← two_mul_smallSchroder_succ, ← two_mul_smallSchroder_succ] <;>
      · #adaptation_note /
        we need to re-enable model-based theory combination in `lia` for this to go through. -/
        lia +mbtc
    _ = 6 * (n + 2).smallSchroder +
          4 * ∑ i ∈ Ioo 0 (n + 1), (i + 1).smallSchroder * (n + 2 - i).smallSchroder := by
      rw [← two_mul_smallSchroder_succ (by lia)]
      simp [mul_mul_mul_comm _ _ 2, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      lia
    _ = _ := by lia

name: bell_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bell_zero : bell 0 = 1

name: bell_mul_eq_lemma
statement:
private theorem bell_mul_eq_lemma {x : ℕ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∀ c, x ! ^ c * c ! * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range c, (j * x + x - 1).choose (x - 1) = (x * c)!
  | 0 => by simp
  | c + 1 => calc
      x ! ^ (c + 1) * (c + 1)! * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), (j * x + x - 1).choose (x - 1)
        = x ! * (c + 1) * x ! ^ c * c ! *
            ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), (j * x + x - 1).choose (x - 1)
proof:
:= by
        rw [factorial_succ, pow_succ]; ring
      _ = (x ! ^ c * c ! * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range c, (j * x + x - 1).choose (x - 1)) *
            (c * x + x - 1).choose (x - 1) * x ! * (c + 1) := by
        rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]; ring
      _ = (c + 1) * (c * x + x - 1).choose (x - 1) * (x * c)! * x ! := by
        rw [bell_mul_eq_lemma hx]; ring
      _ = (x * (c + 1))! := by
        rw [← Nat.choose_mul_add hx, mul_comm c x, Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial]
        ring_nf

name: bell_mul_eq
statement:
theorem bell_mul_eq (m : Multiset ℕ) :
    m.bell * (m.map (fun j ↦ j !)).prod * ∏ j ∈ (m.toFinset.erase 0), (m.count j)! = m.sum !
proof:
:= by
  unfold bell
  rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj (a := ∏ i ∈ m.toFinset, (i * count i m)!) (by positivity)]
  simp only [← mul_assoc, Nat.multinomial_spec]
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
  congr
  · rw [mul_comm, mul_assoc, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_multiset_map_count]
    suffices this : _ by
      by_cases hm : 0 ∈ m.toFinset
      · rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ hm]
        rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ hm]
        simp only [factorial_zero, one_pow, mul_one, zero_mul]
        exact this
      · nth_rewrite 1 [← Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hm]
        nth_rewrite 3 [← Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hm]
        exact this
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    congr! 1 with x hx
    rw [← mul_assoc, bell_mul_eq_lemma]
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase, ne_eq, mem_toFinset] at hx
    simp only [ne_eq, hx.1, not_false_eq_true]
  · rw [Finset.sum_multiset_count]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: bell_eq
statement:
theorem bell_eq (m : Multiset ℕ) :
    m.bell = m.sum ! / ((m.map fun j ↦ j !).prod * ∏ j ∈ m.toFinset.erase 0, (m.count j)!)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.mul_left_inj, Nat.div_mul_cancel _]
  · rw [← mul_assoc]
    exact bell_mul_eq m
  · rw [← bell_mul_eq, mul_assoc]
    apply Nat.dvd_mul_left
  · rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Nat.mul_pos (by simp [Nat.factorial_pos]) (by positivity)

name: bell_cons_mul_count
statement:
private theorem bell_cons_mul_count (m : Multiset ℕ) {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (a ::ₘ m).bell * (a ::ₘ m).count a = (m.sum + a).choose a * m.bell
proof:
:= by
  let rest := ∏ j ∈ (m.toFinset.erase 0).erase a, (m.count j)!
  have hrest : rest = ∏ j ∈ ((a ::ₘ m).toFinset.erase 0).erase a, ((a ::ₘ m).count j)! := by
    unfold rest
    congr! 1 with j hj
    · grind [Multiset.toFinset_cons]
    · simp [Finset.mem_erase.mp hj]
  let c := (m.map (· !)).prod * (m.count a)! * rest
  have hm0 : m.bell * c = m.sum ! := by
    have hsplit : (m.count a)! * rest = ∏ j ∈ m.toFinset.erase 0, (m.count j)! := by
      by_cases hmem : a ∈ m.toFinset.erase 0
      · rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ hmem]
      · have hcount : m.count a = 0 := by grind [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem]
        simp [rest, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hmem, hcount]
    simpa [c, hsplit, mul_assoc] using Multiset.bell_mul_eq m
  have hm : m.sum ! * a ! = m.bell * a ! * c := by grind
  have hc : 0 < a ! * c := Nat.mul_pos (by positivity) <|
    Nat.mul_pos (by simp [Nat.factorial_pos]) (by positivity)
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hc
  calc
    _ = (m.sum + a)! := by
      have hq := Multiset.bell_mul_eq (a ::ₘ m)
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (a := a) (by simp [*]), ← hrest] at hq
      simpa [c, Nat.factorial_succ, add_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using hq
    _ = ((m.sum + a).choose a * m.bell) * (a ! * c) := by
      simp [← Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial, mul_assoc, hm]

name: uniformBell_eq
statement:
theorem uniformBell_eq (m n : ℕ) : m.uniformBell n =
    ∏ p ∈ (Finset.range m), choose (p * n + n - 1) (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold uniformBell bell
  rw [toFinset_replicate]
  split_ifs with hm
  · simp [hm]
  · by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn]
    · rw [show ({n} : Finset ℕ).erase 0 = {n} by simp [Ne.symm hn]]
      simp [count_replicate]

name: uniformBell_zero_left
statement: theorem uniformBell_zero_left (n : ℕ) : uniformBell 0 n = 1

name: uniformBell_zero_right
statement: theorem uniformBell_zero_right (m : ℕ) : uniformBell m 0 = 1

name: uniformBell_succ_left
statement:
theorem uniformBell_succ_left (m n : ℕ) :
    uniformBell (m + 1) n = choose (m * n + n - 1) (n - 1) * uniformBell m n

name: uniformBell_one_left
statement: theorem uniformBell_one_left (n : ℕ) : uniformBell 1 n = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uniformBell_eq, Finset.range_one, Finset.prod_singleton, zero_mul,
    zero_add, choose_self]

name: uniformBell_one_right
statement: theorem uniformBell_one_right (m : ℕ) : uniformBell m 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uniformBell_eq, mul_one, add_tsub_cancel_right, le_refl,
    tsub_eq_zero_of_le, choose_zero_right, Finset.prod_const_one]

name: uniformBell_mul_eq
statement:
theorem uniformBell_mul_eq (m : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    uniformBell m n * n ! ^ m * m ! = (m * n)!
proof:
:= by
  convert! bell_mul_eq (replicate m n)
  · simp only [map_replicate, prod_replicate]
  · simp only [toFinset_replicate]
    split_ifs with hm
    · rw [hm, factorial_zero, eq_comm]
      rw [show (∅ : Finset ℕ).erase 0 = ∅ from rfl, Finset.prod_empty]
    · rw [show ({n} : Finset ℕ).erase 0 = {n} by simp [Ne.symm hn]]
      simp only [Finset.prod_singleton, count_replicate_self]
  · simp

name: uniformBell_eq_div
statement:
theorem uniformBell_eq_div (m : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    uniformBell m n = (m * n)! / (n ! ^ m * m !)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm]
  apply Nat.div_eq_of_eq_mul_left
  · exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pow_pos n.factorial_pos) m.factorial_pos
  · rw [← mul_assoc, ← uniformBell_mul_eq _ hn]

name: bell_succ
statement:
theorem bell_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1).bell = ∑ i ≤ n, choose n i * (n - i).bell

name: bell_succ'
statement:
theorem bell_succ' (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1).bell = ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, choose n ij.1 * ij.2.bell
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.bell_succ,
    ← Nat.range_succ_eq_Iic,
    ← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ (fun x y ↦ choose n x * y.bell) n]

name: bell_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bell_zero : Nat.bell 0 = 1

name: bell_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bell_one : Nat.bell 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Finset.Iic 0 = {0} := Eq.symm (Finset.eq_of_veq rfl)
  simp [Nat.bell, this]

name: bell_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bell_two : Nat.bell 2 = 2
proof:
:= by
  have : Finset.Iic 1 = {0, 1} := Finset.eq_of_veq rfl
  simp [Nat.bell, this]

name: bell_eq_sum_erase
statement:
theorem bell_eq_sum_erase {n : ℕ} (p : (n + 1).Partition) :
    p.parts.bell = ∑ a ∈ p.parts.toFinset, n.choose (a - 1) * (p.parts.erase a).bell
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left n.succ_pos
  calc
  _ = (∑ a ∈ p.parts.toFinset, p.parts.count a * a) * p.parts.bell := by
    rw [succ_eq_add_one, mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
    left
    simpa [smul_eq_mul, p.parts_sum] using Finset.sum_multiset_count p.parts
  _ = ∑ a ∈ p.parts.toFinset, a * (p.parts.count a * p.parts.bell) := by grind [Finset.sum_mul]
  _ = ∑ a ∈ p.parts.toFinset, (n + 1) * (n.choose (a - 1) * (p.parts.erase a).bell) := by
    congr! 1 with a ha
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by grind
    have hsum : (p.parts.erase a).sum + a = n + 1 := by
      simpa [p.parts_sum, add_comm] using congrArg Multiset.sum (cons_erase (mem_dedup.mp ha))
    grind [Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq, cons_erase, bell_cons_mul_count]
  _ = _ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: bell_eq_sum_partition
statement: theorem bell_eq_sum_partition (n : ℕ) : n.bell = ∑ p : n.Partition, p.parts.bell
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strong_induction_on n ?_
  rintro (_ | n) ih
  · simp
  rw [Nat.bell_succ]
  calc
  _ = ∑ i ≤ n, ∑ q : (n - i).Partition, n.choose i * q.parts.bell := by
    congr! with i
    simp [ih (n - i) _, Finset.mul_sum]
  _ = ∑ i ≤ n, ∑ p : {p : (n + 1).Partition // (i + 1 : ℕ) ∈ p.parts},
      choose n i * (p.1.parts.erase (i + 1)).bell := by
    congr! with i hi
    have : i ≤ n := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hi
    have h1 : 1 ≤ (i + 1 : ℕ) := by lia
    have h2 : (i + 1 : ℕ) ≤ n + 1 := by lia
    have hsub : n + 1 - (i + 1 : ℕ) = n - i := by lia
    exact hsub ▸ (Fintype.sum_equiv (Partition.partitionWithPartEquiv h1 h2) _ _ (fun _ ↦ rfl)).symm
  _ = ∑ x : Σ p : (n + 1).Partition, p.parts.toFinset,
      choose n (x.2.1 - 1) * (x.1.parts.erase x.2.1).bell := by
    rw [← Nat.range_succ_eq_Iic, Finset.sum_range, ← Fintype.sum_sigma']
    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (sigmaPartitionWithPartEquiv n) _ _ ?_
    simp [sigmaPartitionWithPartEquiv]
  _ = ∑ p : (n + 1).Partition, ∑ a : p.parts.toFinset, choose n (a - 1) * (p.parts.erase a).bell :=
    Fintype.sum_sigma' fun (p : (n + 1).Partition) (a : p.parts.toFinset) ↦
      choose n (a - 1) * (p.parts.erase a.1).bell
  _ = _ := by
    congr! with p
    rw [bell_eq_sum_erase p]
    exact p.parts.toFinset.sum_coe_sort (fun a ↦ choose n (a - 1) * (p.parts.erase a).bell)

name: apply_eq_zero_of_not_le
statement: lemma apply_eq_zero_of_not_le (h : ¬a ≤ b) (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) : f a b = 0

name: le_of_ne_zero
statement: lemma le_of_ne_zero {f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α} : f a b ≠ 0 → a ≤ b

name: toFun_eq_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma toFun_eq_coe (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) : f.toFun = f

name: coe_mk
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_mk (f : α → α → 𝕜) (h) : (mk f h : α → α → 𝕜) = f

name: coe_inj
statement: lemma coe_inj {f g : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α} : (f : α → α → 𝕜) = g ↔ f = g

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma ext ⦃f g : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α⦄ (h : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → f a b = g a b) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine DFunLike.coe_injective (funext₂ fun a b ↦ ?_)
  by_cases hab : a ≤ b
  · exact h _ _ hab
  · rw [apply_eq_zero_of_not_le hab, apply_eq_zero_of_not_le hab]

name: mk_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma mk_coe (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) (h) : mk f h = f

name: coe_zero
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_zero : ⇑(0 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) = 0

statement: lemma zero_apply (a b : α) : (0 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) a b = 0

statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_add (f g : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) : ⇑(f + g) = f + g

statement: lemma add_apply (f g : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) (a b : α) : (f + g) a b = f a b + g a b

statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_constSMul (c : M) (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) : ⇑(c • f) = c • ⇑f

statement: lemma constSMul_apply (c : M) (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) (a b : α) : (c • f) a b = c • f a b

statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_neg (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) : ⇑(-f) = -f

statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_sub (f g : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) : ⇑(f - g) = f - g

statement: lemma neg_apply (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) (a b : α) : (-f) a b = -f a b

name: one_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma one_apply (a b : α) : (1 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) a b = if a = b then 1 else 0

name: mul_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mul_apply (f g : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) (a b : α) :
    (f * g) a b = ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, f a x * g x b

name: smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma smul_apply (f : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) (g : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕝 α) (a b : α) :
    (f • g) a b = ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, f a x • g x b

name: zeta_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma zeta_apply (a b : α) : zeta 𝕜 a b = if a ≤ b then 1 else 0

name: zeta_of_le
statement: lemma zeta_of_le (h : a ≤ b) : zeta 𝕜 a b = 1

name: zeta_mul_zeta
statement:
lemma zeta_mul_zeta [NonAssocSemiring 𝕜] [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [DecidableLE α]
    (a b : α) : (zeta 𝕜 * zeta 𝕜 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) a b = (Icc a b).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_apply, card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_one]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rw [mem_Icc] at hx
  rw [zeta_of_le hx.1, zeta_of_le hx.2, one_mul]

name: muFun_apply
statement:
private lemma muFun_apply (a b : α) :
    muFun 𝕜 a b = if a = b then 1 else -∑ x ∈ (Ico a b).attach, muFun 𝕜 a x

name: mu_apply
statement: lemma mu_apply (a b : α) : mu 𝕜 a b = if a = b then 1 else -∑ x ∈ Ico a b, mu 𝕜 a x

name: mu_self
statement: @[simp] lemma mu_self (a : α) : mu 𝕜 a a = 1

name: mu_eq_neg_sum_Ico_of_ne
statement:
lemma mu_eq_neg_sum_Ico_of_ne (hab : a ≠ b) :
    mu 𝕜 a b = -∑ x ∈ Ico a b, mu 𝕜 a x

name: sum_Icc_mu_right
statement: lemma sum_Icc_mu_right (a b : α) : ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, mu 𝕜 a x = if a = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hab
  · simp [hab]
  by_cases hab : a ≤ b
  · simp [Icc_eq_cons_Ico hab, mu_eq_neg_sum_Ico_of_ne ‹_›]
  · exact sum_eq_zero fun x hx ↦ apply_eq_zero_of_not_le
      (fun hax ↦ hab <| hax.trans (mem_Icc.1 hx).2) _

name: muFun'_apply
statement:
private lemma muFun'_apply (a b : α) :
    muFun' 𝕜 b a = if a = b then 1 else -∑ x ∈ (Ioc a b).attach, muFun' 𝕜 b x

name: mu'_apply
statement: private lemma mu'_apply (a b : α) : mu' 𝕜 a b = if a = b then 1 else -∑ x ∈ Ioc a b, mu' 𝕜 x b

name: mu'_apply_self
statement: @[simp] private lemma mu'_apply_self (a : α) : mu' 𝕜 a a = 1

name: mu'_eq_sum_Ioc_of_ne
statement: private lemma mu'_eq_sum_Ioc_of_ne (h : a ≠ b) : mu' 𝕜 a b = -∑ x ∈ Ioc a b, mu' 𝕜 x b

name: sum_Icc_mu'_left
statement: private lemma sum_Icc_mu'_left (a b : α) : ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, mu' 𝕜 x b = if a = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hab
  · simp [hab]
  by_cases hab : a ≤ b
  · simp [Icc_eq_cons_Ioc hab, mu'_eq_sum_Ioc_of_ne ‹_›]
  · exact sum_eq_zero fun x hx ↦ apply_eq_zero_of_not_le
      (fun hxb ↦ hab <| (mem_Icc.1 hx).1.trans hxb) _

name: mu_mul_zeta
statement: lemma mu_mul_zeta : (mu 𝕜 * zeta 𝕜 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, mu 𝕜 a x := by rw [mul_apply]; congr! with x hx; simp [(mem_Icc.1 hx).2]
    _ = (1 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) a b := sum_Icc_mu_right ..

name: zeta_mul_mu'
statement: private lemma zeta_mul_mu' : (zeta 𝕜 * mu' 𝕜 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, mu' 𝕜 x b := by rw [mul_apply]; congr! with x hx; simp [(mem_Icc.1 hx).1]
    _ = (1 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) a b := sum_Icc_mu'_left ..

name: mu_toDual
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mu_toDual (a b : α) : mu 𝕜 (toDual a) (toDual b) = mu 𝕜 b a
proof:
:= by
  let : DecidableLE α := Classical.decRel _
  let mud : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 αᵒᵈ :=
    { toFun := fun a b ↦ mu 𝕜 (ofDual b) (ofDual a)
      eq_zero_of_not_le' := fun a b hab ↦ apply_eq_zero_of_not_le (by exact hab) _ }
  suffices mu 𝕜 = mud by simp_rw [this, mud, coe_mk, ofDual_toDual]
  suffices mud * zeta 𝕜 = 1 by
    rw [← mu_mul_zeta] at this
    apply_fun (· * mu 𝕜) at this
    symm
    simpa [mul_assoc, zeta_mul_mu] using this
  clear a b
  ext a b
  simp only [mul_boole, one_apply, mul_apply, zeta_apply]
  calc
    ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, (if x ≤ b then mud a x else 0) = ∑ x ∈ Icc a b, mud a x := by
      congr! with x hx; exact ite_eq_left (mem_Icc.1 hx).2
    _ = ∑ x ∈ Icc (ofDual b) (ofDual a), mu 𝕜 x (ofDual a) := by simp [Icc_orderDual_def, mud]
    _ = if ofDual b = ofDual a then 1 else 0 := sum_Icc_mu_left ..
    _ = if a = b then 1 else 0 := by simp [eq_comm]

name: moebius_inversion_top
statement:
lemma moebius_inversion_top (f g : α → 𝕜) (h : ∀ x, g x = ∑ y ∈ Ici x, f y) (x : α) :
    f x = ∑ y ∈ Ici x, mu 𝕜 x y * g y
proof:
:= by
  let : DecidableLE α := Classical.decRel _
  symm
  calc
    ∑ y ∈ Ici x, mu 𝕜 x y * g y = ∑ y ∈ Ici x, mu 𝕜 x y * ∑ z ∈ Ici y, f z := by simp_rw [h]
    _ = ∑ y ∈ Ici x, mu 𝕜 x y * ∑ z ∈ Ici y, zeta 𝕜 y z * f z := by
      congr with y
      rw [sum_congr rfl fun z hz ↦ ?_]
      rw [zeta_apply, ite_eq_left (mem_Ici.mp ‹_›), one_mul]
    _ = ∑ y ∈ Ici x, ∑ z ∈ Ici y, mu 𝕜 x y * zeta 𝕜 y z * f z := by simp [mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ z ∈ Ici x, ∑ y ∈ Icc x z, mu 𝕜 x y * zeta 𝕜 y z * f z := by
      rw [sum_sigma' (Ici x) fun y ↦ Ici y]
      rw [sum_sigma' (Ici x) fun z ↦ Icc x z]
      simp only [mul_boole, zero_mul, ite_mul, zeta_apply]
      apply sum_nbij' (fun ⟨a, b⟩ ↦ ⟨b, a⟩) (fun ⟨a, b⟩ ↦ ⟨b, a⟩) <;>
        aesop (add simp mul_assoc) (add unsafe le_trans)
    _ = ∑ z ∈ Ici x, (mu 𝕜 * zeta 𝕜 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) x z * f z := by
      simp_rw [mul_apply, sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ y ∈ Ici x, ∑ z ∈ Ici y, (1 : IncidenceAlgebra 𝕜 α) x z * f z := by
      simp only [mu_mul_zeta 𝕜, one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, sum_ite_eq, mem_Ici, le_refl,
        ↓reduceIte, ← add_sum_Ioi_eq_sum_Ici, left_eq_add]
      exact sum_eq_zero fun y hy ↦ ite_eq_right (mem_Ioi.mp hy).not_ge
    _ = f x := by
      simp only [one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, sum_ite_eq, mem_Ici,
        ← add_sum_Ioi_eq_sum_Ici, le_refl, ↓reduceIte, add_eq_left]
      exact sum_eq_zero fun y hy ↦ ite_eq_right (mem_Ioi.mp hy).not_ge

name: moebius_inversion_bot
statement:
lemma moebius_inversion_bot (f g : α → 𝕜) (h : ∀ x, g x = ∑ y ∈ Iic x, f y) (x : α) :
    f x = ∑ y ∈ Iic x, mu 𝕜 y x * g y
proof:
:= by
  convert! moebius_inversion_top (α := αᵒᵈ) f g h x using 3
  rw [← mu_toDual]; rfl

name: stirlingFirst_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem stirlingFirst_eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, n < k → stirlingFirst n k = 0
  | _, 0, hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => by rw [stirlingFirst]
  | n + 1, k + 1, hk => by
    rw [stirlingFirst_succ_succ, stirlingFirst_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk),
      stirlingFirst_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk), mul_zero]

name: stirlingFirst_self
statement: theorem stirlingFirst_self (n : ℕ) : stirlingFirst n n = 1
proof:

  induction n <;> simp only [*, stirlingFirst, stirlingFirst_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self _),
    mul_zero]

name: stirlingFirst_succ_self_left
statement: theorem stirlingFirst_succ_self_left (n : ℕ) : stirlingFirst (n + 1) n = (n + 1).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [zero_add, stirlingFirst_succ_zero, choose_succ_self]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [stirlingFirst_succ_succ, ih, stirlingFirst_self, mul_one, Nat.choose_succ_succ (n + 1),
      Nat.choose_one_right]

name: stirlingFirst_one_right

proof:
:= by

  | zero => rfl
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [stirlingFirst_succ_succ, zero_add, hn, stirlingFirst_succ_zero]
    simp [Nat.factorial_succ]

statement:
theorem stirlingSecond_eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, n < k → stirlingSecond n k = 0
  | _, 0, hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => by rw [stirlingSecond]
  | n + 1, k + 1, hk => by
    simp only [stirlingSecond_succ_succ, stirlingSecond_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk),
      stirlingSecond_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk), mul_zero]

name: pow_eq_sum_stirlingSecond_mul_descFactorial
statement:
theorem pow_eq_sum_stirlingSecond_mul_descFactorial (n k : ℕ) :
    n ^ k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), stirlingSecond k j * n.descFactorial j
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), stirlingSecond k j * (j * n.descFactorial j)
        = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
            (j + 1) * (stirlingSecond k (j + 1) * n.descFactorial (j + 1)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun j ↦ stirlingSecond k j * (j * n.descFactorial j)) k,
        Finset.sum_range_succ (fun j ↦ (j + 1) * (stirlingSecond k (j + 1) *
          n.descFactorial (j + 1))) k,
        stirlingSecond_eq_zero_of_lt k.lt_add_one]
      simp [mul_left_comm]
    rw [pow_succ, ih, Finset.sum_mul,
      Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun j ↦ stirlingSecond (k + 1) j * n.descFactorial j) (k + 1)]
    simp only [mul_assoc, descFactorial_mul_self, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, this,
      stirlingSecond_succ_succ, add_mul, stirlingSecond_succ_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact add_comm _ _

name: Function.HasMaxCutPropertyAt.rows_lt_aux
statement:
lemma Function.HasMaxCutPropertyAt.rows_lt_aux {C : Type*} [PartialOrder C]
    {f : (Fin 2 → D) → C} {a b : D} (mcf : f.HasMaxCutPropertyAt a b) (hab : a ≠ b)
    {ω : FractionalOperation D 2} (symmega : ω.IsSymmetric)
    {r : Fin 2 → D} (rin : r ∈ (ω.tt ![![a, b], ![b, a]])) :
    f ![a, b] < f r
proof:
:= by
  rw [FractionalOperation.tt, Multiset.mem_map] at rin
  rw [show r = ![r 0, r 1] by simp [← List.ofFn_inj]]
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (mcf.right (r 0) (r 1)).left
  intro equ
  have asymm : r 0 ≠ r 1 := by
    rcases (mcf.right (r 0) (r 1)).right equ with ⟨ha0, hb1⟩ | ⟨ha1, hb0⟩
    · rw [ha0, hb1] at hab
      exact hab
    · rw [ha1, hb0] at hab
      exact hab.symm
  apply asymm
  obtain ⟨o, in_omega, rfl⟩ := rin
  change o (fun j => ![![a, b], ![b, a]] j 0) = o (fun j => ![![a, b], ![b, a]] j 1)
  convert! symmega ![a, b] ![b, a] (by simp [List.Perm.swap]) o in_omega using 2 <;>
    simp [Matrix.const_fin1_eq]

name: Function.HasMaxCutProperty.forbids_commutativeFractionalPolymorphism
statement:
lemma Function.HasMaxCutProperty.forbids_commutativeFractionalPolymorphism
    {f : (Fin 2 → D) → C} (mcf : f.HasMaxCutProperty)
    {ω : FractionalOperation D 2} (valid : ω.IsValid) (symmega : ω.IsSymmetric) :
    ¬ f.AdmitsFractional ω
proof:
:= by
  intro contr
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, mcfab⟩ := mcf
  specialize contr ![![a, b], ![b, a]]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two', ← mcfab.left, ← two_nsmul] at contr
  have sharp :
    2 • ((ω.tt ![![a, b], ![b, a]]).map (fun _ => f ![a, b])).sum <
    2 • ((ω.tt ![![a, b], ![b, a]]).map f).sum := by
    have half_sharp :
      ((ω.tt ![![a, b], ![b, a]]).map (fun _ => f ![a, b])).sum <
      ((ω.tt ![![a, b], ![b, a]]).map f).sum := by
      apply Multiset.sum_lt_sum
      · intro r rin
        exact le_of_lt (mcfab.rows_lt_aux hab symmega rin)
      · obtain ⟨g, _⟩ := valid.contains
        have : (fun i => g ((Function.swap ![![a, b], ![b, a]]) i)) ∈ ω.tt ![![a, b], ![b, a]] := by
          simp only [FractionalOperation.tt, Multiset.mem_map]
          use g
        exact ⟨_, this, mcfab.rows_lt_aux hab symmega this⟩
    rw [two_nsmul, two_nsmul]
    exact add_lt_add half_sharp half_sharp
  have impos : 2 • (ω.map (fun _ => f ![a, b])).sum < ω.size • 2 • f ![a, b] := by
    convert! lt_of_lt_of_le sharp contr
    simp [FractionalOperation.tt, Multiset.map_map]
  have rhs_swap : ω.size • 2 • f ![a, b] = 2 • ω.size • f ![a, b] := nsmul_left_comm ..
  have distrib : (ω.map (fun _ => f ![a, b])).sum = ω.size • f ![a, b] := by simp
  rw [rhs_swap, distrib] at impos
  exact ne_of_lt impos rfl

statement: lemma eq_bot_or_isNonempty : H = ⊥ ∨ H.IsNonempty

    obtain ⟨_, _, hxy⟩ := G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet he

proof:
:= by
  contrapose!; symm
  exact ⟨fun hnind ↦ ⟨hHG, fun e x y hxy hx hy => hxy.anti_of_mem hHG (hnind e x y hxy hx hy)⟩,
    fun hind _ _ _ hexy hx hy ↦ hind.isLink_of_mem_mem hexy hx hy |>.edge_mem⟩

lemma mk' (hHG : H ≤ G) (hclosed : ∀ ⦃e x⦄, G.Inc e x → x ∈ V(H) → e ∈ E(H)) : H ≤c G where
  le
proof:
:= hHG
  isLink_of_mem_mem _ _ _ he hx _ := he.anti_of_mem hHG (hclosed he.inc_left hx)
  closed _ _ he hx := hclosed he hx

statement: lemma mem_iff_of_isLink (he : G.IsLink e x y) (hHG : H ≤c G) : x ∈ V(H) ↔ y ∈ V(H)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hin ↦ ?_, fun hin ↦ ?_⟩
  on_goal 2 => rw [isLink_comm] at he
  all_goals rw [← hHG.isLink_congr hin] at he; exact he.right_mem

name: mem_tfae_of_isLink
statement:
lemma mem_tfae_of_isLink (he : G.IsLink e x y) (hHG : H ≤c G) :
    List.TFAE [x ∈ V(H), y ∈ V(H), e ∈ E(H)]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := (hHG.mem_iff_of_isLink he).mp
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := (hHG.isLink_congr · |>.mpr he.symm |>.edge_mem)
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := (he.anti_of_mem hHG.le · |>.left_mem)
  tfae_finish

statement:
@[simp]

name: Prefunctor.pathStar_injective
statement:
theorem Prefunctor.pathStar_injective (hφ : ∀ u, Injective (φ.star u)) (u : U) :
    Injective (φ.pathStar u)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp +unfoldPartialApp [Prefunctor.pathStar, Quiver.PathStar.mk]
  rintro ⟨v₁, p₁⟩
  induction p₁ with
  | nil =>
    rintro ⟨y₂, p₂⟩
    rcases p₂ with - | ⟨p₂, e₂⟩
    · intro; rfl 
    · intro h
      simp only [mapPath_cons, Sigma.mk.inj_iff] at h
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨h, h'⟩ := h
      rw [← Path.eq_cast_iff_heq rfl h.symm, Path.cast_cons] at h'
      exact (Path.nil_ne_cons _ _) h'
  | cons p₁ e₁ ih =>
    rename_i x₁ y₁
    rintro ⟨y₂, p₂⟩
    rcases p₂ with - | ⟨p₂, e₂⟩
    · intro h
      simp only [mapPath_cons, Sigma.mk.inj_iff] at h
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨h, h'⟩ := h
      rw [← Path.cast_eq_iff_heq rfl h, Path.cast_cons] at h'
      exact (Path.cons_ne_nil _ _) h'
    · rename_i x₂
      intro h
      simp only [mapPath_cons, Sigma.mk.inj_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨hφy, h'⟩ := h
      rw [← Path.cast_eq_iff_heq rfl hφy, Path.cast_cons, Path.cast_rfl_rfl] at h'
      have hφx := Path.obj_eq_of_cons_eq_cons h'
      have hφp := Path.heq_of_cons_eq_cons h'
      have hφe := HEq.trans (Hom.cast_heq rfl hφy _).symm (Path.hom_heq_of_cons_eq_cons h')
      have h_path_star : φ.pathStar u ⟨x₁, p₁⟩ = φ.pathStar u ⟨x₂, p₂⟩ := by
        simp only [Prefunctor.pathStar_apply, Sigma.mk.inj_iff]; exact ⟨hφx, hφp⟩
      cases ih h_path_star
      have h_star : φ.star x₁ ⟨y₁, e₁⟩ = φ.star x₁ ⟨y₂, e₂⟩ := by
        simp only [Prefunctor.star_apply, Sigma.mk.inj_iff]; exact ⟨hφy, hφe⟩
      cases hφ x₁ h_star
      rfl

name: Prefunctor.pathStar_surjective
statement:
theorem Prefunctor.pathStar_surjective (hφ : ∀ u, Surjective (φ.star u)) (u : U) :
    Surjective (φ.pathStar u)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp +unfoldPartialApp [Prefunctor.pathStar, Quiver.PathStar.mk]
  rintro ⟨v, p⟩
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    use ⟨u, Path.nil⟩
    simp only [Prefunctor.mapPath_nil]
  | cons p' ev ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨u', q'⟩, h⟩ := ih
    simp only at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨⟨u'', eu⟩, k⟩ := hφ u' ⟨_, ev⟩
    simp only [star_apply, Sigma.mk.inj_iff] at k
    
    obtain ⟨rfl, k⟩ := k
    simp only [heq_eq_eq] at k
    subst k
    use ⟨_, q'.cons eu⟩
    simp only [Prefunctor.mapPath_cons]

name: ext
statement:
theorem ext {V : Type u} [ReflQuiver.{v₁} V] {W : Type u₂} [ReflQuiver.{v₂} W]
    {F G : ReflPrefunctor V W}
    (h_obj : ∀ X, F.obj X = G.obj X)
    (h_map : ∀ (X Y : V) (f : X ⟶ Y),
      F.map f = Eq.recOn (h_obj Y).symm (Eq.recOn (h_obj X).symm (G.map f))) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨F_obj⟩⟩ := F
  obtain ⟨⟨G_obj⟩⟩ := G
  obtain rfl : F_obj = G_obj := (Set.eqOn_univ F_obj G_obj).mp fun _ _ ↦ h_obj _
  congr
  funext X Y f
  simpa using h_map X Y f

    (h_map : ∀ (X Y : V) (f : X ⟶ Y),
      F.map f = Quiver.homOfEq (G.map f) (h_obj _).symm (h_obj _).symm) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Fpre, Fid⟩ := F
  obtain ⟨Gpre, Gid⟩ := G
  obtain rfl : Fpre = Gpre := Prefunctor.ext' (V := V) (W := W) h_obj h_map
  rfl

name: comp_inj
statement:
theorem comp_inj {p₁ p₂ : Path a b} {q₁ q₂ : Path b c} (hq : q₁.length = q₂.length) :
    p₁.comp q₁ = p₂.comp q₂ ↔ p₁ = p₂ ∧ q₁ = q₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩
  induction q₁ with
  | nil =>
    rcases q₂ with _ | ⟨q₂, f₂⟩
    · exact ⟨h, rfl⟩
    · cases hq
  | cons q₁ f₁ ih =>
    rcases q₂ with _ | ⟨q₂, f₂⟩
    · cases hq
    · simp only [comp_cons, cons.injEq] at h
      obtain rfl := h.1
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := ih (Nat.succ.inj hq) h.2.1.eq
      rw [h.2.2.eq]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: comp_inj'
statement:
theorem comp_inj' {p₁ p₂ : Path a b} {q₁ q₂ : Path b c} (h : p₁.length = p₂.length) :
    p₁.comp q₁ = p₂.comp q₂ ↔ p₁ = p₂ ∧ q₁ = q₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h_eq => (comp_inj <| Nat.add_left_cancel (n := p₂.length) <|
    by simpa [h] using congr_arg length h_eq).1 h_eq,
   by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩

name: eq_toPath_comp_of_length_eq_succ
statement:
lemma eq_toPath_comp_of_length_eq_succ (p : Path a b) {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.length = n + 1) :
    ∃ (c : V) (f : a ⟶ c) (q : Quiver.Path c b) (_ : q.length = n),
      p = f.toPath.comp q
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing n with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | @cons c d p q h =>
    cases n
    · rw [length_cons, Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_eq_right] at hp
      obtain rfl := eq_of_length_zero p hp
      obtain rfl := eq_nil_of_length_zero p hp
      exact ⟨d, q, nil, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hp
      obtain ⟨x, q'', p'', hl, rfl⟩ := h hp
      exact ⟨x, q'', p''.cons q, by simpa, rfl⟩

name: length_ne_zero_iff_eq_comp
statement:
lemma length_ne_zero_iff_eq_comp (p : Path a b) :
    p.length ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ (c : V) (e : a ⟶ c) (p' : Path c b),
      p = e.toPath.comp p' ∧ p.length = p'.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h_len : p.length = (p.length - 1) + 1 := by lia
    obtain ⟨c, e, p', hp', rfl⟩ := Path.eq_toPath_comp_of_length_eq_succ p h_len
    exact ⟨c, e, p', rfl, by lia⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, p', e, rfl, h⟩
    simp [h]

name: length_ne_zero_iff_eq_cons
statement:
lemma length_ne_zero_iff_eq_cons :
    p.length ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ (c : V) (p' : Path a c) (e : c ⟶ b), p = p'.cons e
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases p with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons p' e => exact ⟨_, p', e, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, p', e, rfl⟩
    simp
