name: IsBridge.not_isHamiltonian
statement: theorem IsBridge.not_isHamiltonian {e : Sym2 α} (he : G.IsBridge e) : ¬G.IsHamiltonian
proof:
:= by
  induction e with | h u v
  have := he.nontrivial
  intro hG
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hG.exists_isHamiltonianCycle u
  refine hp.isHamiltonian_tail.isPath.isTrail.not_mem_support_of_not_reachable
    (fun huv ↦ he <| .trans ?_ huv) he (hp.isHamiltonian_tail.mem_support v)
  apply hp.isTrail.isEdgeReachable_two <;> simp

name: mulCayley_adj'
statement:
lemma mulCayley_adj' (u v : M) :
    (mulCayley s).Adj u v ↔ u ≠ v ∧ ∃ g ∈ s, u * g = v ∨ u = v * g

name: mulCayley_le_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mulCayley_le_iff (G : SimpleGraph M) :
    mulCayley s ≤ G ↔ ∀ g ∈ s, ∀ a, a * g ≠ a → G.Adj (a * g) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.le_iff_adj]
  simp only [mulCayley_adj', ne_eq, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
  constructor
  · intro h g hg a ha
    exact h (a * g) a ha g hg (Or.inr rfl)
  · rintro h v w hvw g hg (rfl | rfl)
    · exact (h g hg v (hvw ·.symm)).symm
    · exact h g hg w hvw

name: mulCayley_gc
statement:
lemma mulCayley_gc :
    GaloisConnection (mulCayley ·) ({g : M | ∀ a, a * g ≠ a → ·.Adj (a * g) a})
proof:
:= by
  intro S G
  simp [mulCayley_le_iff, Set.subset_def]

theorem mulCayley_mono {U V : Set M} (hUV : U ⊆ V) : mulCayley U ≤ mulCayley V

theorem mulCayley_union (s₁ s₂ : Set M) : mulCayley (s₁ ∪ s₂) = mulCayley s₁ ⊔ mulCayley s₂

theorem mulCayley_adj_mul_iff_right [IsLeftCancelMul M] {s : Set M} {u v d : M} :

statement:

theorem mulCayley_erase_one : mulCayley (s \ {1}) = mulCayley s
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← Set.sdiff_union_inter s {1}]
  rw [mulCayley_union]
  ext u v
  simp +contextual [mulCayley_adj']

statement:

lemma mulCayley_adj (u v : M) :
    (mulCayley s).Adj u v ↔ u ≠ v ∧ (u⁻¹ * v ∈ s ∨ v⁻¹ * u ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mulCayley_adj', ← eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq (b := u), ← inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul (a := v),
    and_or_left, exists_or]

statement:

    .range (toSubgraph (H := H)) = {G' : G.Subgraph | Nonempty (H ≃g G'.coe)}

  ext H'
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩

  · rintro ⟨e⟩

  convert!

        Adj := ⊥
        adj_sub := False.elim

  simp only [eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem, mem_filter_univ, Nonempty.forall]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨(Equiv.Set.univ _).symm, by simp⟩⟩, fun H' e ↦
    Subgraph.ext ((set_fintype_card_eq_univ_iff _).1 <| Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv.symm) ?_⟩

  simp only [Prop.bot_eq_false, Pi.bot_apply, iff_false]

name: killCopies_of_ne_bot
killCopies_eq_left
statement: lemma killCopies_eq_left (hH : H ≠ ⊥) : G.killCopies H = G ↔ H.Free G
proof:
:= by
  simp only [killCopies_of_ne_bot hH, Set.disjoint_left, isContained_iff_exists_iso_subgraph,
    @forall_comm _ G.Subgraph, deleteEdges_eq_self, Set.mem_iUnion,
    not_exists, not_nonempty_iff, Nonempty.forall, Free]
  exact forall_congr' fun G' ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun f ↦ h _
    (Subgraph.edgeSet_subset _ <| (aux hH ⟨f⟩).choose_spec) f rfl⟩, fun h _ _ ↦ h.elim⟩

:= by
  obtain rfl | hH := eq_or_ne H ⊥
  · exact killCopies_bot _
  · exact (killCopies_eq_left hH).2 hHG

name: free_killCopies
statement: lemma free_killCopies (hH : H ≠ ⊥) : H.Free (G.killCopies H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [killCopies_of_ne_bot hH, deleteEdges, Free, isContained_iff_exists_iso_subgraph]
  rintro ⟨G', hHG'⟩
  have hG' : (G'.map <| .ofLE (sdiff_le : G \ _ ≤ G)).edgeSet.Nonempty := by
    rw [Subgraph.edgeSet_map]
    exact (aux hH hHG').image _
  set e := hG'.some with he
  have : e ∈ _ := hG'.some_mem
  clear_value e
  rw [← Subgraph.image_coe_edgeSet_coe] at this
  subst he
  obtain ⟨e, he₀, he₁⟩ := this
  let e' : Sym2 G'.verts := Sym2.map (Copy.isoSubgraphMap (.ofLE _ _ _) _).symm e
  have he' : e' ∈ G'.coe.edgeSet := (Iso.map_mem_edgeSet_iff _).2 he₀
  rw [Subgraph.edgeSet_coe] at he'
  have := Subgraph.edgeSet_subset _ he'
  simp only [edgeSet_sdiff, edgeSet_fromEdgeSet, edgeSet_sdiff_sdiff_isDiag, Set.mem_sdiff,
    Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists] at this
  refine this.2 (G'.map <| .ofLE sdiff_le) ⟨((Copy.ofLE _ _ _).isoSubgraphMap _).comp hHG'.some⟩ ?_
  rw [Sym2.map_map, Set.mem_singleton_iff, ← he₁]
  congr 1 with x
  exact congr_arg _ (Equiv.Set.image_symm_apply _ _ injective_id _ _)

name: le_card_edgeFinset_killCopies
statement:
lemma le_card_edgeFinset_killCopies [Fintype V] :
    #G.edgeFinset - G.copyCount H ≤ #(G.killCopies H).edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain rfl | hH := eq_or_ne H ⊥
  · simp [← card_edgeSet]
  let f (G' : {G' : G.Subgraph // Nonempty (H ≃g G'.coe)}) := (aux hH G'.2).some
  calc
    _ = #G.edgeFinset - card {G' : G.Subgraph // Nonempty (H ≃g G'.coe)} := ?_
    _ ≤ #G.edgeFinset - #(univ.image f) := Nat.sub_le_sub_left card_image_le _
    _ = #G.edgeFinset - #(Set.range f).toFinset := by rw [Set.toFinset_range]
    _ ≤ #(G.edgeFinset \ (Set.range f).toFinset) := le_card_sdiff ..
    _ = #(G.killCopies H).edgeFinset := ?_
  · simp only [edgeFinset, Set.toFinset_card]
    rw [← Set.toFinset_card, ← edgeFinset, copyCount, ← card_subtype, subtype_univ, card_univ]
  congr 1
  ext e
  induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with | hf v w
  simp [mem_edgeSet, killCopies_of_ne_bot hH, f, eq_comm]

name: cycleGraph_isContained_iff
statement:
lemma cycleGraph_isContained_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) :
    cycleGraph n ⊑ G ↔ ∃ (v : V) (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsCycle ∧ p.length = n
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : n - 3 + 3 = n := by lia
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ ⟨_, _, cycleGraph.isCycle_cycle.map (hn' ▸ h).injective, by simp [hn']⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ⟨a, p, hp₁, hp₂⟩
  refine ⟨⟨fun n ↦ p.support[n.succ]'(by grind [not_nil_iff_lt_length]), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hab
    wlog hle : x > y
    · have hne : x ≠ y := by simpa using hab.ne
      exact this hn hn' a p hp₁ hp₂ y hy x hx hab.symm (by lia) |>.symm
    rcases cycleGraph_adj'.mp hab with hab | hab
    · simp_rw [show x = y + 1 by grind [Fin.sub_val_of_le]]
      exact p.isChain_adj_support.getElem _ _ |>.symm
    · rw [Fin.coe_sub_iff_lt.mpr hle] at hab
      simp_rw [show x = n - 1 by lia, show y = 0 by lia, Fin.succ_mk, show n - 1 + 1 = n by lia]
      simp [← hp₂, hp₁.not_nil]
  · have hlen : p.tail.support.length = n := by grind [length_tail_add_one]
    have (m : Fin n) : p.support[m.succ]'(by grind) = p.tail.support[m] := by simp [hp₁.not_nil]
    simp_rw [this]
    exact hlen ▸ (isPath_iff_injective_get_support _).mp hp₁.isPath_tail

name: dart_fst_fiber
statement:
theorem dart_fst_fiber [DecidableEq V] (v : V) :
    ({d : G.Dart | d.fst = v} : Finset _) = univ.image (G.dartOfNeighborSet v)
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp only [mem_image, true_and, mem_filter, SetCoe.exists, mem_univ]
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨_, d.adj, by ext <;> rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: dart_fst_fiber_card_eq_degree
statement:
theorem dart_fst_fiber_card_eq_degree [DecidableEq V] (v : V) :
    #{d : G.Dart | d.fst = v} = G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [dart_fst_fiber, Finset.card_univ, card_neighborSet_eq_degree] using
    card_image_of_injective univ (G.dartOfNeighborSet_injective v)

name: dart_card_eq_sum_degrees
statement: theorem dart_card_eq_sum_degrees : Fintype.card G.Dart = ∑ v, G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq V
  simp only [← card_univ, ← dart_fst_fiber_card_eq_degree]
  exact card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by simp)

name: Dart.edge_fiber

theorem Dart.edge_fiber [DecidableEq V] (d : G.Dart) :

proof:

  Finset.ext fun d' => by simpa using dart_edge_eq_iff d' d

name: dart_edge_fiber_card
statement:
theorem dart_edge_fiber_card [DecidableEq V] (e : Sym2 V) (h : e ∈ G.edgeSet) :
    #{d : G.Dart | d.edge = e} = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w⟩ := e
  let d : G.Dart := ⟨(v, w), h⟩
  convert! congr_arg card d.edge_fiber
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem, card_singleton]
  rw [mem_singleton]
  exact d.symm_ne.symm

name: dart_card_eq_twice_card_edges
statement: theorem dart_card_eq_twice_card_edges : Fintype.card G.Dart = 2 * #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← card_univ]
  rw [@card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise _ _ _ Dart.edge _ G.edgeFinset fun d _h =>
      by rw [mem_coe, mem_edgeFinset]; apply Dart.edge_mem]
  rw [← mul_comm, sum_const_nat]
  intro e h
  apply G.dart_edge_fiber_card e
  rwa [← mem_edgeFinset]

name: sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
statement: theorem sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges : ∑ v, G.degree v = 2 * #G.edgeFinset

name: two_mul_card_edgeFinset
statement: lemma two_mul_card_edgeFinset : 2 * #G.edgeFinset = #(univ.filter fun (x, y) ↦ G.Adj x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dart_card_eq_twice_card_edges, ← card_univ]
  refine card_bij' (fun d _ ↦ (d.fst, d.snd)) (fun xy h ↦ ⟨xy, (mem_filter.1 h).2⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    <;> simp

name: sum_degrees_support_eq_twice_card_edges
statement:
theorem sum_degrees_support_eq_twice_card_edges :
    ∑ v ∈ G.support, G.degree v = 2 * #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [← sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges,
    ← sum_add_sum_compl G.support.toFinset, left_eq_add]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro v hv
  rw [degree_eq_zero_iff_notMem_support]
  rwa [mem_compl, Set.mem_toFinset] at hv

name: even_card_odd_degree_vertices
statement:
theorem even_card_odd_degree_vertices [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    Even #{v | Odd (G.degree v)}
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg (fun n => ↑n : ℕ → ZMod 2) G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  simp only [ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul, Nat.cast_mul] at h
  rw [Nat.cast_sum, ← sum_filter_ne_zero] at h
  rw [sum_congr (g := fun _v ↦ (1 : ZMod 2)) rfl] at h
  · simp only [mul_one, nsmul_eq_mul, sum_const, Ne] at h
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even]
    convert! h
    exact ZMod.natCast_ne_zero_iff_odd.symm
  · intro v
    rw [mem_filter_univ, Ne, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even, ZMod.natCast_eq_one_iff_odd,
      ← Nat.not_even_iff_odd]
    tauto

name: odd_card_odd_degree_vertices_ne
statement:
theorem odd_card_odd_degree_vertices_ne [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : V)
    (h : Odd (G.degree v)) : Odd #{w | w ≠ v ∧ Odd (G.degree w)}
proof:
:= by
  rcases G.even_card_odd_degree_vertices with ⟨k, hg⟩
  have hk : 0 < k := by
    have hh : Finset.Nonempty {v : V | Odd (G.degree v)} := by
      use v
      rw [mem_filter_univ]
      exact h
    rwa [← card_pos, hg, ← two_mul, mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left] at hh
    exact zero_lt_two
  have hc : (fun w : V => w ≠ v ∧ Odd (G.degree w)) = fun w : V => Odd (G.degree w) ∧ w ≠ v := by
    ext w
    rw [and_comm]
  simp only [hc]
  rw [← filter_filter, filter_ne', card_erase_of_mem]
  · refine ⟨k - 1, tsub_eq_of_eq_add <| hg.trans ?_⟩
    lia
  · rwa [mem_filter_univ]

name: exists_ne_odd_degree_of_exists_odd_degree
statement:
theorem exists_ne_odd_degree_of_exists_odd_degree [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : V)
    (h : Odd (G.degree v)) : ∃ w : V, w ≠ v ∧ Odd (G.degree w)
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq V
  rcases G.odd_card_odd_degree_vertices_ne v h with ⟨k, hg⟩
  have hg' : 0 < #{w | w ≠ v ∧ Odd (G.degree w)} := by
    rw [hg]
    apply Nat.succ_pos
  rcases card_pos.mp hg' with ⟨w, hw⟩
  rw [mem_filter_univ] at hw
  exact ⟨w, hw⟩

name: partitionable_iff_colorable
statement: theorem partitionable_iff_colorable {n : ℕ} : G.Partitionable n ↔ G.Colorable n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hf, hc⟩
    have : Fintype P.parts := hf.fintype
    rw [Set.Finite.card_toFinset hf] at hc
    apply P.colorable.mono hc
  · rintro ⟨C⟩
    refine ⟨C.toPartition, C.colorClasses_finite, le_trans ?_ (Fintype.card_fin n).le⟩
    generalize_proofs h
    change Set.Finite (Coloring.colorClasses C) at h
    have : Fintype C.colorClasses := C.colorClasses_finite.fintype
    rw [h.card_toFinset]
    exact C.card_colorClasses_le

:= by
  constructor
  · rintro hdisj M' ⟨hsub₀, _⟩ ⟨hsub₁, _⟩
    rw [le_bot_iff]
    ext
    · grind [verts_bot]
    · exact ⟨(hdisj hsub₀ hsub₁ <| M'.edge_vert · :), False.elim⟩
  · intro hdisj S h₀ h₁ v hvS
    let M' : Subgraph G := { verts := {v}, Adj := ⊥, adj_sub := by simp, edge_vert := by simp }
    have hle {M : Subgraph G} (h : v ∈ M.verts) : M' ≤ M := by constructor <;> simp [h, M']
    exact hdisj (hle <| h₀ hvS) (hle <| h₁ hvS) |>.left <| Set.mem_singleton v

name: map_id

name: map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp {U : Type*} {G'' : SimpleGraph U} (H : G.Subgraph) (f : G →g G') (g : G' →g G'') :

name: map_mono
statement: @[gcongr] lemma map_mono {H₁ H₂ : G.Subgraph} (hH : H₁ ≤ H₂) : H₁.map f ≤ H₂.map f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    simp only [map_verts, Set.mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    rintro v hv rfl
    exact ⟨_, hH.1 hv, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ _ ⟨u, v, ha, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, _, hH.2 ha, rfl, rfl⟩

name: map_monotone

name: map_sup

  ext <;> simp [Set.image_union, map_adj, sup_adj, Relation.Map, or_and_right, exists_or]

name: IsInduced.map
statement:
protected lemma IsInduced.map {H : G.Subgraph} (hH : H.IsInduced) (e : G ↪g G') :
    (H.map e.toHom).IsInduced
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ hAdj
  exact ⟨a, b, hH ha hb (e.map_adj_iff.mp hAdj), rfl, rfl⟩

name: isInduced_map_iso

  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa [← map_comp] using h.map e.symm.toEmbedding, fun h ↦ h.map e.toEmbedding⟩

name: comap_monotone
statement: theorem comap_monotone {G' : SimpleGraph W} (f : G →g G') : Monotone (Subgraph.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  intro H H' h
  constructor
  · intro
    simp only [comap_verts, Set.mem_preimage]
    apply h.1
  · intro v w
    simp +contextual only [comap_adj, and_imp, true_and]
    intro
    apply h.2

name: comap_equiv_top
statement: @[simp] lemma comap_equiv_top {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G →g H) : Subgraph.comap f ⊤ = ⊤

name: map_le_iff_le_comap
statement:
theorem map_le_iff_le_comap {G' : SimpleGraph W} (f : G →g G') (H : G.Subgraph) (H' : G'.Subgraph) :
    H.map f ≤ H' ↔ H ≤ H'.comap f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun v hv ↦ ?_, fun v w hvw ↦ ?_⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨fun v ↦ ?_, fun v w ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · simp only [comap_verts, Set.mem_preimage]
    exact h.1 ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  · simp only [H.adj_sub hvw, comap_adj, true_and]
    exact h.2 ⟨v, w, hvw, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simp only [map_verts, Set.mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    rintro w hw rfl
    exact h.1 hw
  · simp only [Relation.Map, map_adj, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    rintro u u' hu rfl rfl
    exact (h.2 hu).2

proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ G'.verts
  · rw [← G'.coe_degree ⟨v, hv⟩]
    have := (Set.subsingleton_coe _).mpr hG
    exact G'.coe.degree_eq_zero_of_subsingleton ⟨v, hv⟩
  · exact degree_of_notMem_verts hv

name: neighborSet_eq_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  lift H.neighborSet v to Finset V using h.set_finite_iff.mp hfin with s hs
  lift G.neighborSet v to Finset V using hfin with t ht
  refine congrArg _ <| Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le ?_ (Finset.card_eq_of_equiv h).le
  rw [← Finset.coe_subset, hs, ht]
  exact H.neighborSet_subset _

theorem singletonSubgraph_le_iff (v : V) (H : G.Subgraph) :

:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.1 (Set.mem_singleton v), ?_⟩
  intro h
  constructor
  · rwa [singletonSubgraph_verts, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  · exact fun _ _ ↦ False.elim

proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp only [Relation.Map, Subgraph.map_adj, singletonSubgraph_adj, Pi.bot_apply,
    exists_and_left, and_iff_left_iff_imp, Subgraph.map_verts,
    singletonSubgraph_verts, Set.image_singleton]

name: eq_singletonSubgraph_iff_verts_eq
statement:
theorem eq_singletonSubgraph_iff_verts_eq (H : G.Subgraph) {v : V} :
    H = G.singletonSubgraph v ↔ H.verts = {v}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [h, singletonSubgraph_verts], fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  ext
  · rw [h, singletonSubgraph_verts]
  · simp only [Prop.bot_eq_false, singletonSubgraph_adj, Pi.bot_apply, iff_false]
    intro ha
    have ha1 := ha.fst_mem
    have ha2 := ha.snd_mem
    rw [h, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha1 ha2
    subst_vars
    exact ha.ne rfl

:= by
  #adaptation_note /
  (replacing grind's canonicalizer with a type-directed normalizer), `grind` closed this goal.

name: IsInduced.induce_top_verts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsInduced.induce_top_verts (h : G'.IsInduced) : induce ⊤ G'.verts = G'
proof:
:=
  Subgraph.ext rfl <| funext₂ fun _ _ ↦ propext
    ⟨fun ⟨hu, hv, h'⟩ ↦ h hu hv h', fun h ↦ ⟨G'.edge_vert h, G'.edge_vert h.symm, h.adj_sub⟩⟩

name: isInduced_iff_exists_eq_induce_top
statement:
theorem isInduced_iff_exists_eq_induce_top (G' : G.Subgraph) :
    G'.IsInduced ↔ ∃ s, G' = induce ⊤ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨G'.verts, h.induce_top_verts.symm⟩, fun ⟨s, h⟩ _ hu _ hv hadj ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [h, (h ▸ rfl : s = G'.verts)]
  exact ⟨hu, hv, hadj⟩

name: induce_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem induce_mono (hg : G' ≤ G'') (hs : s ⊆ s') : G'.induce s ≤ G''.induce s'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [hs]
  · simp +contextual only [induce_adj, and_imp]
    intro v w hv hw ha
    exact ⟨hs hv, hs hw, hg.2 ha⟩

statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem induce_mono_left (hg : G' ≤ G'') : G'.induce s ≤ G''.induce s

@[gcongr, mono]
theorem induce_mono_right (hs : s ⊆ s') : G'.induce s ≤ G'.induce s'

name: induce_self_verts
statement:

theorem induce_self_verts : G'.induce G'.verts = G'
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp
  · constructor <;>
      simp +contextual only [induce_adj, imp_true_iff, and_true]
    exact fun ha ↦ ⟨G'.edge_vert ha, G'.edge_vert ha.symm⟩

name: le_induce_top_verts
statement: lemma le_induce_top_verts : G' ≤ (⊤ : G.Subgraph).induce G'.verts
proof:
:=
  calc G' = G'.induce G'.verts := Subgraph.induce_self_verts.symm
       _ ≤ (⊤ : G.Subgraph).induce G'.verts := Subgraph.induce_mono_left le_top

name: le_induce_union
statement: lemma le_induce_union : G'.induce s ⊔ G'.induce s' ≤ G'.induce (s ∪ s')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp
  · simp only [sup_adj, induce_adj, Set.mem_union]
    rintro v w (h | h) <;> simp [h]

theorem singletonSubgraph_eq_induce {v : V} :

name: subgraphOfAdj_eq_induce
statement:
theorem subgraphOfAdj_eq_induce {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w) :
    G.subgraphOfAdj hvw = (⊤ : G.Subgraph).induce {v, w}
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp
  · constructor
    · intro h
      simp only [subgraphOfAdj_adj, Sym2.eq, Sym2.rel_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h <;> simp [hvw, hvw.symm]
    · intro h
      simp only [induce_adj, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, top_adj] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl | rfl, rfl | rfl, ha⟩ := h <;> first | exact (ha.ne rfl).elim | simp

theorem IsRegularOfDegree.mem_spectrum_adjMatrix [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] [Nontrivial R]
    [CommRing R] {d : ℕ} (hd : G.IsRegularOfDegree d) : (d : R) ∈ spectrum R (G.adjMatrix R)
proof:

  apply End.HasEigenvalue.mem_spectrum

theorem lapMatrix_mulVec_apply [NonAssocRing R] (v : V) (vec : V → R) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_lapMatrix_eq_zero [Nonempty V] [CommRing R] : (G.lapMatrix R).det = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›
  apply det_eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors (i := v) <|

statement:

proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | h
  · simp [lapMatrix, Nat.cast_pred <| Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: dotProduct_mulVec_degMatrix
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_degMatrix [CommSemiring R] (x : V → R) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (G.degMatrix R *ᵥ x) = ∑ i : V, G.degree i * x i * x i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, degMatrix, mulVec_diagonal, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm]

name: lapMatrix_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem lapMatrix_toLinearMap₂' [Field R] [CharZero R] (x : V → R) :
    toLinearMap₂' R (G.lapMatrix R) x x =
    (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V, if G.Adj i j then (x i - x j) ^ 2 else 0) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [toLinearMap₂'_apply', lapMatrix, sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_mulVec_degMatrix,
    dotProduct_mulVec_adjMatrix, ← sum_sub_distrib, degree_eq_sum_if_adj, sum_mul, ite_mul, one_mul,
    zero_mul, ← sum_sub_distrib, ite_sub_ite, sub_zero]
  rw [← add_self_div_two (∑ x_1 : V, ∑ x_2 : V, _)]
  conv_lhs => enter [1, 2, 2, i, 2, j]; rw [if_congr (adj_comm G i j) rfl rfl]
  conv_lhs => enter [1, 2]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← sum_add_distrib, ite_add_ite]
  congr 2 with i
  congr 2 with j
  ring_nf

name: posSemidef_lapMatrix
statement:
theorem posSemidef_lapMatrix [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [StarRing R]
    [TrivialStar R] : PosSemidef (G.lapMatrix R)
proof:
:= by
  refine .of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg ?_ (fun x ↦ ?_)
  · rw [IsHermitian, conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, isSymm_lapMatrix]
  · rw [star_trivial, ← toLinearMap₂'_apply', lapMatrix_toLinearMap₂']
    positivity

name: lapMatrix_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem lapMatrix_toLinearMap₂'_apply'_eq_zero_iff_forall_adj
    [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (x : V → R) :
    Matrix.toLinearMap₂' R (G.lapMatrix R) x x = 0 ↔ ∀ i j : V, G.Adj i j → x i = x j
proof:
:= by
  simp (disch := intros; positivity)
    [lapMatrix_toLinearMap₂', sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg, sub_eq_zero]

name: lapMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_adj
statement:
theorem lapMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_adj {x : V → ℝ} :
    G.lapMatrix ℝ *ᵥ x = 0 ↔ ∀ i j : V, G.Adj i j → x i = x j

name: lapMatrix_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem lapMatrix_toLinearMap₂'_apply'_eq_zero_iff_forall_reachable [Field R] [LinearOrder R]
    [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (x : V → R) :
    (G.lapMatrix R).toLinearMap₂' R x x = 0 ↔ ∀ i j, G.Reachable i j → x i = x j
proof:
:= by
  rw [lapMatrix_toLinearMap₂'_apply'_eq_zero_iff_forall_adj]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h i j hA ↦ h i j hA.reachable⟩
  intro h i j ⟨w⟩
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hA _ h' => exact (h _ _ hA).trans h'

statement:
theorem lapMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_reachable {x : V → ℝ} :

name: mem_ker_toLin'_lapMatrix_of_connectedComponent
statement:
lemma mem_ker_toLin'_lapMatrix_of_connectedComponent {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [DecidableEq G.ConnectedComponent] (c : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    (fun i ↦ if connectedComponentMk G i = c then 1 else 0) ∈
      LinearMap.ker (toLin' (lapMatrix ℝ G))

name: linearIndependent_lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g h0
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff] at h0
  have h : ∑ c, g c • lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux G c = fun i ↦ g (connectedComponentMk G i) := by
    simp only [lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux, SetLike.mk_smul_mk]
    repeat rw [AddSubmonoid.coe_finsetSum]
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, sum_ite_eq,
      mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [h] at h0
  intro c
  obtain ⟨i, h'⟩ : ∃ i : V, G.connectedComponentMk i = c := Quot.exists_rep c
  exact h' ▸ congrFun h0 i

name: top_le_span_range_lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux
statement:
lemma top_le_span_range_lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux :
    ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux G))
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
  use Quot.lift x.val (by rw [← lapMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_reachable,
    ← toLin'_apply, LinearMap.map_coe_ker])
  ext j
  simp only [lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux]
  rw [AddSubmonoid.coe_finsetSum]
  simp only [SetLike.mk_smul_mk, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one,
    mul_zero, sum_ite_eq, mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  rfl

statement:
theorem IsBipartiteWith.symm (h : G.IsBipartiteWith s t) : G.IsBipartiteWith t s where
  disjoint
proof:
:= h.disjoint.symm
  mem_of_adj v w hadj := by
    rw [@and_comm (v ∈ t) (w ∈ s), @and_comm (v ∈ s) (w ∈ t)]

name: isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq
statement:
theorem isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq [G.LocallyFinite] (h : G.IsBipartiteWith s t) :
    ∑ v ∈ s, G.degree v = ∑ w ∈ t, G.degree w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [← sum_attach t, ← sum_attach s, ← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  conv_lhs =>
    rhs; intro v
    rw [isBipartiteWith_bipartiteAbove h v.prop]
  conv_rhs =>
    rhs; intro w
    rw [isBipartiteWith_bipartiteBelow h w.prop]
  simp_rw [sum_attach s fun w ↦ #(bipartiteAbove G.Adj t w),
    sum_attach t fun v ↦ #(bipartiteBelow G.Adj s v)]
  exact sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow G.Adj

name: isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
statement:
lemma isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges [DecidableEq V] (h : G.IsBipartiteWith s t) :
    ∑ v ∈ s ∪ t, G.degree v = 2 * #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : G.support ⊆ ↑s ∪ ↑t := isBipartiteWith_support_subset h
  rw [← coe_union, ← Set.toFinset_subset] at hsub
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub, ← sum_degrees_support_eq_twice_card_edges]
  intro v _ hv
  rwa [Set.mem_toFinset, ← degree_eq_zero_iff_notMem_support] at hv

name: isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges

    ∑ v ∈ s, G.degree v = #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Nat.mul_left_cancel_iff zero_lt_two, ← isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges h,
    sum_union (disjoint_coe.mp h.disjoint), two_mul, add_right_inj]
  exact isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq h

statement: lemma IsBipartite.exists_isBipartiteWith (h : G.IsBipartite) : ∃ s t, G.IsBipartiteWith s t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  refine ⟨{v | c v = 0}, {v | c v = 1}, by aesop (add simp [Set.disjoint_left]), ?_⟩
  rintro v w hvw
  apply hc at hvw
  simp [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hvw ⊢
  lia

  obtain (⟨hs, ht⟩ | ⟨ht, hs⟩) := h.2 hw <;>
    { replace ht : _ ∉ s := h.1.subset_compl_left ht; simp [hs, ht] }

  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨chromaticNumber_le_two_iff_isBipartite.mp (by simp [h]),
            two_le_chromaticNumber_iff_ne_bot.mp (by simp [h])⟩,
   fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ ENat.eq_of_forall_natCast_le_iff fun _ ↦
      ⟨fun h ↦ h.trans <| chromaticNumber_le_two_iff_isBipartite.mpr h₁,
       fun h ↦ h.trans <| two_le_chromaticNumber_iff_ne_bot.mpr h₂⟩⟩

name: completeBipartiteGraph_isContained_iff
statement:
theorem completeBipartiteGraph_isContained_iff :
    completeBipartiteGraph α β ⊑ G ↔
      ∃ (left right : Finset V), #left = card α ∧ #right = card β
        ∧ G.IsCompleteBetween left right where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    refine fun ⟨f⟩ ↦ ⟨univ.map ⟨f ∘ Sum.inl, f.injective.comp Sum.inl_injective⟩,
      univ.map ⟨f ∘ Sum.inr, f.injective.comp Sum.inr_injective⟩, by simp, by simp,
      fun _ hl _ hr ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [mem_coe, mem_map] at hl hr
    replace ⟨_, _, hl⟩ := hl
    replace ⟨_, _, hr⟩ := hr
    rw [← hl, ← hr]
    exact f.toHom.map_adj (by simp)
  mpr := fun ⟨left, right, card_left, card_right, h⟩ ↦
    ⟨.completeBipartiteGraph left right card_left card_right h⟩

statement:
theorem degree_le_between_add (hv : v ∈ s) :
    G.degree v ≤ (G.between s sᶜ).degree v + s.card
proof:
:= by
  have h_bipartite : (G.between s sᶜ).IsBipartiteWith s ↑(sᶜ) := by
    simpa using between_isBipartiteWith disjoint_compl_right
  simp_rw [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree,
    ← card_union_of_disjoint (isBipartiteWith_neighborFinset_disjoint h_bipartite hv)]
  exact card_le_card (neighborFinset_subset_between_union hv)

name: edgeSet_completeBipartiteGraph
statement:
theorem edgeSet_completeBipartiteGraph :
    (completeBipartiteGraph W₁ W₂).edgeSet =
    .range (fun x : W₁ × W₂ ↦ s(.inl x.1, .inr x.2))
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext <| Sym2.ind fun u v ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨⟨a, b⟩, z⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · cases u <;> cases v <;> simp_all
  · grind [mem_edgeSet]

name: encard_edgeSet_completeBipartiteGraph
statement:
theorem encard_edgeSet_completeBipartiteGraph :
    (completeBipartiteGraph W₁ W₂).edgeSet.encard = ENat.card W₁ * ENat.card W₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeSet_completeBipartiteGraph, ← ENat.card_prod, ← Set.encard_univ, ← Set.image_univ]
  exact Function.Injective.encard_image (by grind [Function.Injective]) Set.univ

name: IsBipartiteWith.encard_edgeSet_le

name: IsBipartite.four_mul_encard_edgeSet_le
statement:
theorem IsBipartite.four_mul_encard_edgeSet_le (h : G.IsBipartite) :
    4 * G.edgeSet.encard ≤ ENat.card V ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine finite_or_infinite V |>.elim (fun hv ↦ ?_) (fun _ ↦ by simp)
  have ⟨s, t, h⟩ := h.exists_isBipartiteWith
  grw [h.encard_edgeSet_le]
  have := Set.encard_union_eq h.disjoint ▸ Set.encard_le_card
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard, ← s.toFinite.cast_ncard_eq, ← t.toFinite.cast_ncard_eq] at this ⊢
  norm_cast at this ⊢
  grind [Nat.pow_le_pow_left this 2, four_mul_le_sq_add s.ncard t.ncard]

name: bipartiteDoubleCover_le
statement: theorem bipartiteDoubleCover_le : G.bipartiteDoubleCover ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V V
proof:
:=
  fun v w hadj ↦ match v, w with
  | .inl _, .inr _ | .inr _, .inl _ => by simp
  | .inl _, .inl _ | .inr _, .inr _ => by simp at hadj

name: card_edgeFinset_bipartiteDoubleCover
statement:
theorem card_edgeFinset_bipartiteDoubleCover [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    #G.bipartiteDoubleCover.edgeFinset = 2 * #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_mul_card_edgeFinset, eq_comm]
  apply card_bij (fun (v, w) _ ↦ s(.inl v, .inr w))
    (fun _ h ↦ by simpa using h) (by grind) (fun e he ↦ ?_)
  induction e with | _ v w
  rw [mem_edgeFinset, mem_edgeSet] at he
  match v, w with
  | .inl _, .inr _ => simpa using he
  | .inr _, .inl _ => simpa using he.symm
  | .inl _, .inl _ | .inr _, .inr _ => simp at he

name: completeBipartiteGraph_isContained_bipartiteDoubleCover
statement:
theorem completeBipartiteGraph_isContained_bipartiteDoubleCover
    {α β : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β] :
    completeBipartiteGraph α β ⊑ G.bipartiteDoubleCover ↔ completeBipartiteGraph α β ⊑ G
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype α := .ofFinite α
  have : Fintype β := .ofFinite β
  simp_rw [completeBipartiteGraph_isContained_iff]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨left, right, card_left, card_right, h⟩ ↦ ?_,
    fun ⟨left, right, card_left, card_right, h⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [← card_left, ← card_right]
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : left.Nonempty := card_pos.mp <| card_pos.trans_le card_left.ge
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : right.Nonempty := card_pos.mp <| card_pos.trans_le card_right.ge
    have hmem_left {l'} (hl' : l' ∈ left) :
        (l.isLeft → l'.isLeft) ∧ (l.isRight → l'.isRight) := by
      rcases l with l | l <;> rcases r with r | r <;> rcases l' with l' | l'
      all_goals solve | simp | simpa using h hl hr | simpa using h hl' hr
    have hmem_right {r'} (hr' : r' ∈ right) :
        (r.isLeft → r'.isLeft) ∧ (r.isRight → r'.isRight) := by
      rcases l with l | l <;> rcases r with r | r <;> rcases r' with r' | r'
      all_goals solve | simp | simpa using h hl hr | simpa using h hl hr'
    rcases l with l | l <;> rcases r with r | r
    · simpa using h hl hr
    · refine ⟨left.toLeft, right.toRight, ?_, ?_, fun i hi j hj ↦ ?_⟩
      · exact card_bij (fun i _ ↦ .inl i) (fun i hi ↦ by simpa using hi) (fun i hi j hj ↦ by simp)
          (fun i hi ↦ ⟨i.getLeft <| (hmem_left hi).left Sum.isLeft_inl, by simp [hi]⟩)
      · exact card_bij (fun j hj ↦ .inr j) (fun j hj ↦ by simpa using hj) (fun i hi j hj ↦ by simp)
          (fun j hj ↦ ⟨j.getRight <| (hmem_right hj).right Sum.isRight_inr, by simp [hj]⟩)
      · rw [mem_coe, mem_toLeft] at hi
        rw [mem_coe, mem_toRight] at hj
        simpa using h hi hj
    · refine ⟨left.toRight, right.toLeft, ?_, ?_, fun i hi j hj ↦ ?_⟩
      · exact card_bij (fun i _ ↦ .inr i) (fun i hi ↦ by simpa using hi) (fun i hi j hj ↦ by simp)
          (fun i hi ↦ ⟨i.getRight <| (hmem_left hi).right Sum.isRight_inr, by simp [hi]⟩)
      · exact card_bij (fun j hj ↦ .inl j) (fun j hj ↦ by simpa using hj) (fun i hi j hj ↦ by simp)
          (fun j hj ↦ ⟨j.getLeft <| (hmem_right hj).left Sum.isLeft_inl, by simp [hj]⟩)
      · rw [mem_coe, mem_toRight] at hi
        rw [mem_coe, mem_toLeft] at hj
        simpa using h hi hj
    · simpa using h hl hr
  · simp_rw [← card_left, ← card_right]
    refine ⟨left.map .inl, right.map .inr, card_map _, card_map _, fun i hi j hj ↦ ?_⟩
    simp_rw [mem_coe, mem_map, Function.Embedding.inl_apply,
      Function.Embedding.inr_apply] at hi hj
    obtain ⟨i', hi', hi⟩ := hi
    obtain ⟨j', hj', hj⟩ := hj
    simpa [← hi, ← hj] using h hi' hj'

name: isClique_map_iff_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem isClique_map_iff_of_nontrivial {f : α ↪ β} {t : Set β} (ht : t.Nontrivial) :
    (G.map f).IsClique t ↔ ∃ (s : Set α), G.IsClique s ∧ f '' s = t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨f ⁻¹' t, ?_, ?_⟩, by rintro ⟨x, hs, rfl⟩; exact hs.map⟩
  · rintro x (hx : f x ∈ t) y (hy : f y ∈ t) hne
    obtain ⟨-, u, v, huv, hux, hvy⟩ := h hx hy (by simpa)
    rw [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at hux hvy
    rwa [← hux, ← hvy]
  rw [Set.image_preimage_eq_iff]
  intro x hxt
  obtain ⟨y, hyt, hyne⟩ := ht.exists_ne x
  obtain ⟨-, u, v, -, rfl, rfl⟩ := h hyt hxt hyne
  exact Set.mem_range_self _

name: isClique_map_iff
statement:
theorem isClique_map_iff {f : α ↪ β} {t : Set β} :
    (G.map f).IsClique t ↔ t.Subsingleton ∨ ∃ (s : Set α), G.IsClique s ∧ f '' s = t
proof:
:= by
  obtain (ht | ht) := t.subsingleton_or_nontrivial
  · simp [IsClique.of_subsingleton, ht]
  simp [isClique_map_iff_of_nontrivial ht, ht.not_subsingleton]

name: isClique_map_image_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem isClique_map_image_iff {f : α ↪ β} :
    (G.map f).IsClique (f '' s) ↔ G.IsClique s
proof:
:= by
  rw [isClique_map_iff, f.injective.subsingleton_image_iff]
  obtain (hs | hs) := s.subsingleton_or_nontrivial
  · simp [hs, IsClique.of_subsingleton]
  simp [or_iff_right hs.not_subsingleton, Set.image_eq_image f.injective]

theorem isClique_induce_iff {s : Set α} {t : Set s} :

name: isClique_map_finset_iff_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem isClique_map_finset_iff_of_nontrivial (ht : t.Nontrivial) :
    (G.map f).IsClique t ↔ ∃ (s : Finset α), G.IsClique s ∧ s.map f = t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [isClique_map_iff_of_nontrivial (by simpa)]
    rintro ⟨s, hs, hst⟩
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Set.Finite.exists_finset_coe <|
      (show s.Finite from Set.Finite.of_finite_image (by simp [hst]) f.injective.injOn)
    exact ⟨s,hs, Finset.coe_inj.1 (by simpa)⟩
  rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  simpa using hs.map (f := f)

name: isClique_map_finset_iff
statement:
theorem isClique_map_finset_iff :
    (G.map f).IsClique t ↔ #t ≤ 1 ∨ ∃ (s : Finset α), G.IsClique s ∧ s.map f = t
proof:
:= by
  obtain (ht | ht) := le_or_gt #t 1
  · simp only [ht, true_or, iff_true]
    exact IsClique.of_subsingleton <| card_le_one.1 ht
  rw [isClique_map_finset_iff_of_nontrivial, ← not_lt]
  · simp [ht]
  exact Finset.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp ht

name: IsClique.of_induce
statement:
theorem IsClique.of_induce {S : Subgraph G} {F : Set α} {A : Set F}
    (c : (S.induce F).coe.IsClique A) : G.IsClique (Subtype.val '' A)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.Pairwise, Set.mem_image, Subtype.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right]
  intro _ ⟨_, ainA⟩ _ ⟨_, binA⟩ anb
  exact S.adj_sub (c ainA binA (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mp anb)).2.2

name: IsClique.sdiff_of_sup_edge
statement:
lemma IsClique.sdiff_of_sup_edge {v w : α} {s : Set α} (hc : (G ⊔ edge v w).IsClique s) :
    G.IsClique (s \ {v})
proof:
:= by
  intro _ hx _ hy hxy
  have := hc hx.1 hy.1 hxy
  simp_all [sup_adj, edge_adj]

name: isClique_sup_edge_of_ne_sdiff
statement:
lemma isClique_sup_edge_of_ne_sdiff {v w : α} {s : Set α} (h : v ≠ w) (hv : G.IsClique (s \ {v}))
    (hw : G.IsClique (s \ {w})) : (G ⊔ edge v w).IsClique s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  by_cases h' : x ∈ s \ {v} ∧ y ∈ s \ {v} ∨ x ∈ s \ {w} ∧ y ∈ s \ {w}
  · obtain (⟨hx, hy⟩ | ⟨hx, hy⟩) := h'
    · exact hv.mono le_sup_left hx hy hxy
    · exact hw.mono le_sup_left hx hy hxy
  · exact Or.inr ⟨by by_cases x = v <;> aesop, hxy⟩

name: isClique_sup_edge_of_ne_iff
statement:
lemma isClique_sup_edge_of_ne_iff {v w : α} {s : Set α} (h : v ≠ w) :
    (G ⊔ edge v w).IsClique s ↔ G.IsClique (s \ {v}) ∧ G.IsClique (s \ {w})
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h' ↦ ⟨h'.sdiff_of_sup_edge, (edge_comm .. ▸ h').sdiff_of_sup_edge⟩,
    fun h' ↦ isClique_sup_edge_of_ne_sdiff h h'.1 h'.2⟩

name: isClique_range_copy_top
statement:
theorem isClique_range_copy_top (f : Copy (⊤ : SimpleGraph β) G) :
    G.IsClique (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  intro _ ⟨_, h⟩ _ ⟨_, h'⟩ nh
  rw [← h, ← Copy.topEmbedding_apply, ← h', ← Copy.topEmbedding_apply] at nh ⊢
  rwa [← f.topEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding, (f.topEmbedding.apply_eq_iff_eq _ _).ne,
    ← top_adj, ← f.topEmbedding.map_adj_iff] at nh

name: isNClique_iff
statement: theorem isNClique_iff : G.IsNClique n s ↔ G.IsClique s ∧ #s = n

name: isNClique_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma isNClique_empty : G.IsNClique n ∅ ↔ n = 0

name: isNClique_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isNClique_singleton : G.IsNClique n {a} ↔ n = 1

name: IsNClique.mono
statement: theorem IsNClique.mono (h : G ≤ H) : G.IsNClique n s → H.IsNClique n s

name: IsNClique.map
statement:
protected theorem IsNClique.map (h : G.IsNClique n s) {f : α ↪ β} :
    (G.map f).IsNClique n (s.map f)

name: isNClique_map_iff
statement:
theorem isNClique_map_iff (hn : 1 < n) {t : Finset β} {f : α ↪ β} :
    (G.map f).IsNClique n t ↔ ∃ s : Finset α, G.IsNClique n s ∧ s.map f = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNClique_iff, isClique_map_finset_iff, or_and_right,
    or_iff_right (by rintro ⟨h', rfl⟩; exact h'.not_gt hn)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [isNClique_iff, hs]
  rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  simp [hs.card_eq, hs.isClique]

name: isNClique_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNClique_bot_iff : (⊥ : SimpleGraph α).IsNClique n s ↔ n ≤ 1 ∧ #s = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNClique_iff, isClique_bot_iff]
  refine and_congr_left ?_
  rintro rfl
  exact card_le_one.symm

name: isNClique_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNClique_zero : G.IsNClique 0 s ↔ s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isNClique_iff, Finset.card_eq_zero, and_iff_right_iff_imp]; rintro rfl; simp

name: isNClique_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNClique_one : G.IsNClique 1 s ↔ ∃ a, s = {a}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isNClique_iff, card_eq_one, and_iff_right_iff_imp]; rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; simp

name: IsNClique.insert
statement:
protected theorem IsNClique.insert (hs : G.IsNClique n s) (h : ∀ b ∈ s, G.Adj a b) :
    G.IsNClique (n + 1) (insert a s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · push_cast
    exact hs.1.insert fun b hb _ => h _ hb
  · rw [card_insert_of_notMem fun ha => (h _ ha).ne rfl, hs.2]

name: IsNClique.erase_of_mem
statement:
lemma IsNClique.erase_of_mem (hs : G.IsNClique n s) (ha : a ∈ s) :
    G.IsNClique (n - 1) (s.erase a) where
  isClique
proof:
:= hs.isClique.subset <| by simp
  card_eq := by rw [card_erase_of_mem ha, hs.2]

name: IsNClique.insert_erase
statement:
protected lemma IsNClique.insert_erase
    (hs : G.IsNClique n s) (ha : ∀ w ∈ s \ {b}, G.Adj a w) (hb : b ∈ s) :
    G.IsNClique n (insert a (erase s b))
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact False.elim <| notMem_empty _ (isNClique_zero.1 hs ▸ hb)
  | succ _ => exact (hs.erase_of_mem hb).insert fun w h ↦ by aesop

name: is3Clique_triple_iff
statement: theorem is3Clique_triple_iff : G.IsNClique 3 {a, b, c} ↔ G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj a c ∧ G.Adj b c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a = b <;> by_cases hbc : b = c <;> by_cases hac : a = c <;>
    simp [isNClique_iff, and_rotate, *]

name: is3Clique_iff
statement:
theorem is3Clique_iff :
    G.IsNClique 3 s ↔ ∃ a b c, G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj a c ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ s = {a, b, c}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, b, c, -, -, -, hs⟩ := card_eq_three.1 h.card_eq
    refine ⟨a, b, c, ?_⟩
    rwa [hs, eq_self_iff_true, and_true, is3Clique_triple_iff.symm, ← hs]
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hca, rfl⟩
    exact is3Clique_triple_iff.2 ⟨hab, hbc, hca⟩

name: is3Clique_iff_exists_cycle_length_three
statement:
theorem is3Clique_iff_exists_cycle_length_three :
    (∃ s : Finset α, G.IsNClique 3 s) ↔ ∃ (u : α) (w : G.Walk u u), w.IsCycle ∧ w.length = 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [is3Clique_iff, isCycle_def]
  exact
    ⟨(fun ⟨_, a, _, _, hab, hac, hbc, _⟩ => ⟨a, cons hab (cons hbc (cons hac.symm nil)), by aesop⟩),
    (fun ⟨_, .cons hab (.cons hbc (.cons hca nil)), _, _⟩ => ⟨_, _, _, _, hab, hca.symm, hbc, rfl⟩)⟩

name: IsNClique.of_induce
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNClique_iff] at cc ⊢
  simp only [coe_map, card_map]
  exact ⟨cc.left.of_induce, cc.right⟩

name: IsNClique.erase_of_sup_edge_of_mem
proof:
:= coe_erase v _ ▸ hc.1.sdiff_of_sup_edge
  card_eq  := by rw [card_erase_of_mem hx, hc.2]

name: isNClique_map_copy_top
statement:
theorem isNClique_map_copy_top [Fintype β] (f : Copy (⊤ : SimpleGraph β) G) :
    G.IsNClique (card β) (univ.map f.toEmbedding)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNClique_iff, card_map, card_univ, coe_map, coe_univ, Set.image_univ]
  exact ⟨isClique_range_copy_top f, rfl⟩

name: isNClique_induce_iff
statement:
theorem isNClique_induce_iff (s : Set α) (t : Finset s) (n : ℕ) :
    (G.induce s).IsNClique n t ↔ G.IsNClique n (t.map (.subtype _))

name: IsNClique.not_cliqueFree
statement: theorem IsNClique.not_cliqueFree (hG : G.IsNClique n s) : ¬G.CliqueFree n

name: IsContained.not_cliqueFree
statement: theorem IsContained.not_cliqueFree {n : ℕ} (h : completeGraph (Fin n) ⊑ G) : ¬G.CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  have := isNClique_map_copy_top h.some
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at this
  exact (· _ this)

name: not_cliqueFree_iff_top_isContained
statement: theorem not_cliqueFree_iff_top_isContained (n : ℕ) : ¬G.CliqueFree n ↔ completeGraph (Fin n) ⊑ G

name: cliqueFree_iff_free_top_fin
statement: theorem cliqueFree_iff_free_top_fin : G.CliqueFree n ↔ (completeGraph (Fin n)).Free G

name: cliqueFree_iff_isEmpty_copy_top_fin
statement:
theorem cliqueFree_iff_isEmpty_copy_top_fin {n : ℕ} :
    G.CliqueFree n ↔ IsEmpty (Copy (completeGraph <| Fin n) G)

name: cliqueFree_card_iff_free_top
statement:
theorem cliqueFree_card_iff_free_top {β : Type*} [Fintype β] :
    G.CliqueFree (card β) ↔ (⊤ : SimpleGraph β).Free G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, not_free, not_cliqueFree_iff_top_isContained,
    isContained_congr (Iso.completeGraph (equivFin β)) Iso.refl]

name: IsContained.not_cliqueFree_card
statement:
theorem IsContained.not_cliqueFree_card [Fintype α] (f : completeGraph α ⊑ G) :
    ¬G.CliqueFree (card α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_cliqueFree_iff_top_isContained]
  exact (Iso.completeGraph <| equivFin α).isContained'.trans f

name: not_cliqueFree_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma not_cliqueFree_zero : ¬ G.CliqueFree 0

name: cliqueFree_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueFree_bot (h : 2 ≤ n) : (⊥ : SimpleGraph α).CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  have := le_trans h (isNClique_bot_iff.1 ht).1
  contradiction

name: CliqueFree.mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem CliqueFree.mono (h : m ≤ n) : G.CliqueFree m → G.CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  intro hG s hs
  obtain ⟨t, hts, ht⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (h.trans hs.card_eq.ge)
  exact hG _ ⟨hs.isClique.subset hts, ht⟩

name: CliqueFree.anti
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem CliqueFree.anti (h : G ≤ H) : H.CliqueFree n → G.CliqueFree n

name: CliqueFree.comap
statement:
@[gcongr only]
theorem CliqueFree.comap {H : SimpleGraph β} (hle : H ⊑ G) (h : G.CliqueFree n) :
    H.CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h
  rw [not_cliqueFree_iff_top_isContained] at h ⊢
  exact h.trans hle

name: cliqueFree_map_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem cliqueFree_map_iff {f : α ↪ β} [Nonempty α] :
    (G.map f).CliqueFree n ↔ G.CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hle | hlt) := le_or_gt n 1
  · obtain (rfl | rfl) := Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 hle
    · simp [CliqueFree]
    simp [CliqueFree, show ∃ (_ : β), True from ⟨f (Classical.arbitrary _), trivial⟩]
  simp [CliqueFree, isNClique_map_iff hlt]

name: cliqueFree_of_card_lt
statement: theorem cliqueFree_of_card_lt [Fintype α] (hc : card α < n) : G.CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliqueFree_iff_free_top_fin]
  contrapose! hc
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using card_le_of_embedding hc.some.toEmbedding

name: cliqueFree_completeMultipartiteGraph
statement:
theorem cliqueFree_completeMultipartiteGraph {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (V : ι → Type*)
    (hc : card ι < n) : (completeMultipartiteGraph V).CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliqueFree_iff_free_top_fin]
  intro ⟨f⟩
  obtain ⟨v, w, hn, he⟩ := exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt (Sigma.fst ∘ f) (by simp [hc])
  rw [← top_adj, ← f.topEmbedding.map_adj_iff, comap_adj, top_adj] at hn
  exact absurd he hn

name: not_cliqueFree_of_le_card
statement:
theorem not_cliqueFree_of_le_card [Fintype ι] (f : ∀ (i : ι), V i) (hc : n ≤ card ι) :
    ¬ (completeMultipartiteGraph V).CliqueFree n
proof:
:=
  fun hf ↦ (cliqueFree_iff_isEmpty_copy_top_fin.1 <| hf.mono hc).elim' <|
    topEmbedding V f |>.toCopy.comp (Iso.completeGraph (equivFin ι).symm).toCopy

name: not_cliqueFree_of_infinite
statement:
theorem not_cliqueFree_of_infinite [Infinite ι] (f : ∀ (i : ι), V i) :
    ¬ (completeMultipartiteGraph V).CliqueFree n

name: not_cliqueFree_of_le_enatCard
statement:
theorem not_cliqueFree_of_le_enatCard (f : ∀ (i : ι), V i) (hc : n ≤ ENat.card ι) :
    ¬ (completeMultipartiteGraph V).CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Infinite ι
  · exact not_cliqueFree_of_infinite V f
  · have : Fintype ι := fintypeOfNotInfinite h
    rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card, Nat.cast_le] at hc
    exact not_cliqueFree_of_le_card V f hc

name: CliqueFree.replaceVertex
statement:
protected theorem CliqueFree.replaceVertex [DecidableEq α] (h : G.CliqueFree n) (s t : α) :
    (G.replaceVertex s t).CliqueFree n
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h
  have ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := topEmbeddingOfNotCliqueFree h
  rw [not_cliqueFree_iff_top_isContained]
  by_cases mt : t ∈ Set.range φ
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := mt
    by_cases ms : s ∈ Set.range φ
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ms
      have e := @hφ x y
      simp_rw [hx, hy, adj_comm, not_adj_replaceVertex_same, top_adj, false_iff, not_ne_iff] at e
      rwa [← hx, e, hy, replaceVertex_self, not_cliqueFree_iff_top_isContained] at h
    · unfold replaceVertex at hφ
      refine Embedding.isContained ⟨φ.setValue x s, fun {a b} ↦ ?_⟩
      simp only [Embedding.coeFn_mk, Embedding.setValue, not_exists.mp ms, ite_false]
      rw [apply_ite (G.Adj · _), apply_ite (G.Adj _ ·), apply_ite (G.Adj _ ·)]
      convert! @hφ a b <;> simp only [← φ.apply_eq_iff_eq, SimpleGraph.irrefl, hx]
  · refine Embedding.isContained ⟨φ, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [Set.mem_range, not_exists, ← ne_eq] at mt
    conv at hφ => enter [a, b]; rw [G.adj_replaceVertex_iff_of_ne _ (mt a) (mt b)]
    exact hφ

name: cliqueFree_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cliqueFree_one : G.CliqueFree 1 ↔ IsEmpty α

name: cliqueFree_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueFree_two : G.CliqueFree 2 ↔ G = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · simp_rw [← edgeSet_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem, Sym2.forall, mem_edgeSet]
    exact fun h a b hab => h _ ⟨by simpa [hab.ne], card_pair hab.ne⟩
  · rintro rfl
    exact cliqueFree_bot le_rfl

name: CliqueFree.mem_of_sup_edge_isNClique
statement:
lemma CliqueFree.mem_of_sup_edge_isNClique {x y : α} {t : Finset α} {n : ℕ} (h : G.CliqueFree n)
    (hc : (G ⊔ edge x y).IsNClique n t) : x ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hf
  have ht : (t : Set α) \ {x} = t := sdiff_eq_left.mpr <| Set.disjoint_singleton_right.mpr hf
  exact h t ⟨ht ▸ hc.1.sdiff_of_sup_edge, hc.2⟩

name: CliqueFree.sup_edge
statement:
protected theorem CliqueFree.sup_edge (h : G.CliqueFree n) (v w : α) :
    (G ⊔ edge v w).CliqueFree (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact fun _ hs ↦ (hs.erase_of_sup_edge_of_mem <|
    (h.mono n.le_succ).mem_of_sup_edge_isNClique hs).not_cliqueFree h

name: IsNClique.exists_not_adj_of_cliqueFree_succ
statement:
lemma IsNClique.exists_not_adj_of_cliqueFree_succ (hc : G.IsNClique n s)
    (h : G.CliqueFree (n + 1)) (x : α) : ∃ y, y ∈ s ∧ ¬ G.Adj x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! hf
  exact (hc.insert hf).not_cliqueFree h

name: exists_of_maximal_cliqueFree_not_adj
statement:
lemma exists_of_maximal_cliqueFree_not_adj [DecidableEq α]
    (h : Maximal (fun H ↦ H.CliqueFree (n + 1)) G) {x y : α} (hne : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ s, x ∉ s ∧ y ∉ s ∧ G.IsNClique n (insert x s) ∧ G.IsNClique n (insert y s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hc⟩ := not_forall_not.1 <| h.not_prop_of_gt <| G.lt_sup_edge _ _ hne hn
  use (t.erase x).erase y, erase_right_comm (a := x) ▸ (notMem_erase _ _), notMem_erase _ _
  have h1 := h.1.mem_of_sup_edge_isNClique hc
  have h2 := h.1.mem_of_sup_edge_isNClique (edge_comm .. ▸ hc)
  rw [insert_erase <| mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne.symm h2, erase_right_comm,
      insert_erase <| mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne h1]
  exact ⟨(edge_comm .. ▸ hc).erase_of_sup_edge_of_mem h2, hc.erase_of_sup_edge_of_mem h1⟩

name: CliqueFreeOn.subset
statement: theorem CliqueFreeOn.subset (hs : s₁ ⊆ s₂) (h₂ : G.CliqueFreeOn s₂ n) : G.CliqueFreeOn s₁ n

name: CliqueFreeOn.mono
statement: theorem CliqueFreeOn.mono (hmn : m ≤ n) (hG : G.CliqueFreeOn s m) : G.CliqueFreeOn s n
proof:
:= by
  rintro t hts ht
  obtain ⟨u, hut, hu⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (hmn.trans ht.card_eq.ge)
  exact hG ((coe_subset.2 hut).trans hts) ⟨ht.isClique.subset hut, hu⟩

name: CliqueFreeOn.anti
statement: theorem CliqueFreeOn.anti (hGH : G ≤ H) (hH : H.CliqueFreeOn s n) : G.CliqueFreeOn s n
proof:
:=
  fun _t hts ht => hH hts <| ht.mono hGH

name: cliqueFreeOn_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueFreeOn_empty : G.CliqueFreeOn ∅ n ↔ n ≠ 0

name: cliqueFreeOn_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueFreeOn_singleton : G.CliqueFreeOn {a} n ↔ 1 < n
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ | n := n <;>
    simp [CliqueFreeOn, isNClique_iff, ← subset_singleton_iff', (Nat.succ_ne_zero _).symm]

name: cliqueFreeOn_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueFreeOn_univ : G.CliqueFreeOn Set.univ n ↔ G.CliqueFree n

name: CliqueFree.cliqueFreeOn
statement: protected theorem CliqueFree.cliqueFreeOn (hG : G.CliqueFree n) : G.CliqueFreeOn s n

name: cliqueFreeOn_of_card_lt
statement: theorem cliqueFreeOn_of_card_lt {s : Finset α} (h : #s < n) : G.CliqueFreeOn s n
proof:
:=
  fun _t hts ht => h.not_ge <| ht.2.symm.trans_le <| card_mono hts

name: cliqueFreeOn_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueFreeOn_two : G.CliqueFreeOn s 2 ↔ s.Pairwise (G.Adjᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h a ha b hb _ hab => h ?_ ⟨by simpa [hab.ne], card_pair hab.ne⟩, ?_⟩
  · push_cast
    exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hb⟩
  simp only [CliqueFreeOn, isNClique_iff, card_eq_two, not_and, not_exists]
  rintro h t hst ht a b hab rfl
  simp only [coe_insert, coe_singleton, Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at hst
  refine h hst.1 hst.2 hab (ht ?_ ?_ hab) <;> simp

name: CliqueFreeOn.of_succ
statement:
theorem CliqueFreeOn.of_succ (hs : G.CliqueFreeOn s (n + 1)) (ha : a ∈ s) :
    G.CliqueFreeOn (s ∩ G.neighborSet a) n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine fun t hts ht => hs ?_ (ht.insert fun b hb => (hts hb).2)
  push_cast
  exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨ha, hts.trans Set.inter_subset_left⟩

name: cliqueFree_induce_iff
statement:
theorem cliqueFree_induce_iff (s : Set α) (n : ℕ) :
    (G.induce s).CliqueFree n ↔ G.CliqueFreeOn s n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [CliqueFree, isNClique_induce_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h t ht ↦ ?_, (· <| map_subtype_subset ·)⟩
  have := h <| t.subtype _
  rwa [← filter_eq_self.mpr ht, ← subtype_map]

name: mem_cliqueSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cliqueSet_iff : s ∈ G.cliqueSet n ↔ G.IsNClique n s

name: cliqueSet_eq_empty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueSet_eq_empty_iff : G.cliqueSet n = ∅ ↔ G.CliqueFree n

name: cliqueSet_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem cliqueSet_mono (h : G ≤ H) : G.cliqueSet n ⊆ H.cliqueSet n

name: cliqueSet_mono'
statement: theorem cliqueSet_mono' (h : G ≤ H) : G.cliqueSet ≤ H.cliqueSet

name: cliqueSet_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueSet_zero (G : SimpleGraph α) : G.cliqueSet 0 = {∅}

name: cliqueSet_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueSet_one (G : SimpleGraph α) : G.cliqueSet 1 = Set.range singleton

name: cliqueSet_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueSet_bot (hn : 1 < n) : (⊥ : SimpleGraph α).cliqueSet n = ∅

name: cliqueSet_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueSet_map (hn : n ≠ 1) (G : SimpleGraph α) (f : α ↪ β) :
    (G.map f).cliqueSet n = map f '' G.cliqueSet n
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, rfl⟩
    have hs' : (s.preimage f f.injective.injOn).map f = s := by
      classical
      rw [map_eq_image, image_preimage, filter_true_of_mem]
      rintro a ha
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := exists_mem_ne (hn.lt_of_le' <| Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨a, ha⟩) a
      obtain ⟨-, c, _, _, hc, _⟩ := hs ha hb hba.symm
      exact ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨s.preimage f f.injective.injOn, ⟨?_, by rw [← card_map f, hs']⟩, hs'⟩
    rw [coe_preimage]
    exact fun a ha b hb hab => map_adj_apply.1 (hs ha hb <| f.injective.ne hab)
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact hs.map

name: cliqueSet_map_of_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueSet_map_of_equiv (G : SimpleGraph α) (e : α ≃ β) (n : ℕ) :
    (G.map e).cliqueSet n = map e.toEmbedding '' G.cliqueSet n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 1
  · ext
    simp [e.exists_congr_left]
  · simpa using cliqueSet_map hn G e.toEmbedding

name: finite_cliqueNum_bddAbove
statement: private lemma finite_cliqueNum_bddAbove [Finite α] : BddAbove {n | ∃ s, G.IsNClique n s}
proof:
:= by
  have := ofFinite α
  use card α
  rintro y ⟨s, syc⟩
  rw [isNClique_iff] at syc
  rw [← syc.right]
  exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ s)

name: IsClique.card_le_cliqueNum
statement: lemma IsClique.card_le_cliqueNum [Finite α] {t : Finset α} (tc : G.IsClique t) : #t ≤ G.cliqueNum

name: cliqueNum_ne_zero_of_finite
statement: theorem cliqueNum_ne_zero_of_finite [Nonempty α] [Finite α] : G.cliqueNum ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.not_succ_le_zero 0 <| le_of_le_of_eq ?_ ·)
  exact IsClique.card_le_cliqueNum (t := {Classical.arbitrary α}) <| by simp

name: exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
statement: lemma exists_isNClique_cliqueNum : ∃ s, G.IsNClique G.cliqueNum s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : BddAbove {n | ∃ s, G.IsNClique n s}
  · exact Nat.sSup_mem ⟨0, by simp⟩ h
  · simp [cliqueNum, h]

name: cliqueNum_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueNum_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty α] : G.cliqueNum = 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_zero.mp <| csSup_le' fun n ⟨s, h⟩ ↦ by simp [s.eq_empty_of_isEmpty, ← h.card_eq]

name: cliqueNum_le_natCard
statement: theorem cliqueNum_le_natCard [Finite α] : G.cliqueNum ≤ Nat.card α

name: cliqueNum_le_enatCard
statement: theorem cliqueNum_le_enatCard : G.cliqueNum ≤ ENat.card α
proof:
:= by
  cases finite_or_infinite α
  · grw [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard, Nat.cast_le, cliqueNum_le_natCard]
  · simp

name: cliqueNum_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueNum_top : (⊤ : SimpleGraph α).cliqueNum = Nat.card α
proof:
:= by
  cases finite_or_infinite α
  · have := Fintype.ofFinite α
    apply cliqueNum_le_natCard _ |>.antisymm
    grw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Finset.card_univ, IsClique.card_le_cliqueNum]
    apply IsClique.top
  · rw [Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite]
    apply Set.Infinite.Nat.sSup_eq_zero
    rw [Set.eq_univ_of_forall (Finset.exists_card_eq · |>.imp fun _ hn ↦ ⟨.top _, hn⟩)]
    exact Set.infinite_univ

name: cliqueNum_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueNum_bot [Nonempty α] [Finite α] : (⊥ : SimpleGraph α).cliqueNum = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (csSup_le' fun n ⟨s, h⟩ ↦ ?_) (cliqueNum_ne_zero_of_finite ⊥).pos
  by_contra!
  have ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hne⟩ := s.one_lt_card.mp <| this.trans_eq h.card_eq.symm
  exact h.isClique ha hb hne

name: cliqueNum_eq_natCard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cliqueNum_eq_natCard [Finite α] : G.cliqueNum = Nat.card α ↔ G = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, (· ▸ cliqueNum_top α)⟩
  have ⟨s, hs⟩ := G.exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
  suffices s = @Set.univ α from isClique_univ.mp <| this ▸ hs.isClique
  simp [Set.eq_univ_iff_ncard, h, hs.card_eq]

name: eq_top_of_enatCard_le_cliqueNum
statement: theorem eq_top_of_enatCard_le_cliqueNum (h : ENat.card α ≤ G.cliqueNum) : G = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := ENat.card_lt_top.mp <| h.trans_lt <| ENat.natCast_lt_top _
  simpa [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard] using cliqueNum_le_enatCard G |>.antisymm h

name: cliqueNum_induce_le
statement:
theorem cliqueNum_induce_le [Finite α] (s : Set α) :
    (G.induce s).cliqueNum ≤ G.cliqueNum
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨t', tc⟩ := (G.induce s).exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
  rw [isNClique_induce_iff] at tc
  exact tc.card_eq ▸ tc.isClique.card_le_cliqueNum

name: isMaximumClique_iff
statement:
theorem isMaximumClique_iff [Finite α] {s : Finset α} :
    G.IsMaximumClique s ↔ G.IsClique s ∧ ∀ t : Finset α, G.IsClique t → #t ≤ #s

name: isMaximalClique_iff
statement:
theorem isMaximalClique_iff {s : Set α} :
    Maximal G.IsClique s ↔ G.IsClique s ∧ ∀ t : Set α, G.IsClique t → s ⊆ t → t ⊆ s

name: IsMaximumClique.isMaximalClique
statement:
lemma IsMaximumClique.isMaximalClique [Finite α] (s : Finset α) (M : G.IsMaximumClique s) :
    Maximal G.IsClique s
proof:
:=
  ⟨ M.isClique,
    fun t ht hsub => by
      by_contra hc
      have fint := ofFinite t
      have ne : s ≠ t.toFinset := fun a ↦ by subst a; simp_all[Set.coe_toFinset, not_true_eq_false]
      have hle : #t.toFinset ≤ #s := M.maximum t.toFinset (by simp [Set.coe_toFinset, ht])
      have hlt : #s < #t.toFinset :=
        card_lt_card (ssubset_of_ne_of_subset ne (Set.subset_toFinset.mpr hsub))
      exact lt_irrefl _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hle) ⟩

name: maximumClique_card_eq_cliqueNum
statement:
lemma maximumClique_card_eq_cliqueNum [Finite α] (s : Finset α) (sm : G.IsMaximumClique s) :
    #s = G.cliqueNum
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sc, sm⟩ := sm
  obtain ⟨t, tc, tcard⟩ := G.exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
  exact eq_of_le_of_not_lt sc.card_le_cliqueNum (by simp [← tcard, sm t tc])

name: maximumClique_exists
statement: lemma maximumClique_exists [Finite α] : ∃ (s : Finset α), G.IsMaximumClique s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, snc⟩ := G.exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
  exact ⟨s, ⟨snc.isClique, fun t ht => snc.card_eq.symm ▸ ht.card_le_cliqueNum⟩⟩

name: IsIndepSet.nonempty_mem_compl_mem_edge
statement:
lemma IsIndepSet.nonempty_mem_compl_mem_edge {s : Set α} (indA : G.IsIndepSet s) {e}
    (he : e ∈ G.edgeSet) : { b ∈ sᶜ | b ∈ e }.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, w⟩ := e
  by_contra! c
  refine indA ?_ ?_ he.ne he
  · exact Set.not_notMem.mp <| not_and'.mp (c ▸ Set.notMem_empty v) <| Sym2.mem_mk_left ..
  · exact Set.not_notMem.mp <| not_and'.mp (c ▸ Set.notMem_empty w) <| Sym2.mem_mk_right ..

name: isIndepSet_neighborSet_of_triangleFree
statement:
theorem isIndepSet_neighborSet_of_triangleFree (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (v : α) :
    G.IsIndepSet (G.neighborSet v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra nind
  rw [IsIndepSet, Set.Pairwise] at nind
  push Not at nind
  simp_rw [mem_neighborSet] at nind
  obtain ⟨j, avj, k, avk, _, ajk⟩ := nind
  exact h {v, j, k} (is3Clique_triple_iff.mpr (by simp [avj, avk, ajk]))

statement: @[to_additive] lemma mulEnergy_mono_right (ht : t₁ ⊆ t₂) : Eₘ[s, t₁] ≤ Eₘ[s, t₂]

statement: @[to_additive] lemma le_mulEnergy : #s * #t ≤ Eₘ[s, t]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_product]
  exact card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x => ((x.1, x.1), x.2, x.2)) (by simp [Set.MapsTo]) (by simp)

statement: @[to_additive] lemma le_mulEnergy_self : #s ^ 2 ≤ Eₘ[s]

statement: @[to_additive] lemma mulEnergy_pos (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) : 0 < Eₘ[s, t]

statement: @[to_additive] lemma mulEnergy_self_pos (hs : s.Nonempty) : 0 < Eₘ[s]

statement: @[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma mulEnergy_empty_right : Eₘ[s, ∅] = 0

statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma mulEnergy_pos_iff : 0 < Eₘ[s, t] ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ t.Nonempty where
  mp h
proof:
:= by by_contra! +distrib rfl | rfl <;> simp at h
  mpr h := mulEnergy_pos h.1 h.2
