:=
  ⟨fun h' => h' ▸ C.subset_hom h, C.ind fun _ vnL vD => (vD ⟨vnL, rfl⟩).choose_spec⟩

name: hom_eq_iff_not_disjoint
statement:
theorem hom_eq_iff_not_disjoint (C : G.ComponentCompl L) (h : K ⊆ L) (D : G.ComponentCompl K) :
    C.hom h = D ↔ ¬Disjoint (C : Set V) (D : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.not_disjoint_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    refine C.ind fun x xnL => ?_
    exact ⟨x, ⟨xnL, rfl⟩, ⟨fun xK => xnL (h xK), rfl⟩⟩
  · refine C.ind fun x xnL => ?_
    rintro ⟨x, ⟨_, e₁⟩, _, rfl⟩
    rw [← e₁]
    rfl

name: hom_refl
statement: theorem hom_refl (C : G.ComponentCompl L) : C.hom (subset_refl L) = C
proof:
:= by
  change C.map _ = C
  rw [induceHom_id G Lᶜ, ConnectedComponent.map_id]

name: hom_trans
statement:
theorem hom_trans (C : G.ComponentCompl L) (h : K ⊆ L) (h' : M ⊆ K) :
    C.hom (h'.trans h) = (C.hom h).hom h'
proof:
:= by
  change C.map _ = (C.map _).map _
  rw [ConnectedComponent.map_comp, induceHom_comp]
  rfl

name: hom_mk
statement:
theorem hom_mk {v : V} (vnL : v ∉ L) (h : K ⊆ L) :
    (G.componentComplMk vnL).hom h = G.componentComplMk (Set.notMem_subset h vnL)

name: hom_infinite
statement:
theorem hom_infinite (C : G.ComponentCompl L) (h : K ⊆ L) (Cinf : (C : Set V).Infinite) :
    (C.hom h : Set V).Infinite

name: infinite_iff_in_all_ranges
statement:
theorem infinite_iff_in_all_ranges {K : Finset V} (C : G.ComponentCompl K) :
    C.supp.Infinite ↔ ∀ (L) (h : K ⊆ L), ∃ D : G.ComponentCompl L, D.hom h = C
proof:
:= by
  classical
    constructor
    · rintro Cinf L h
      obtain ⟨v, ⟨vK, rfl⟩, vL⟩ := Set.Infinite.nonempty (Set.Infinite.sdiff Cinf L.finite_toSet)
      exact ⟨componentComplMk _ vL, rfl⟩
    · rintro h Cfin
      obtain ⟨D, e⟩ := h (K ∪ Cfin.toFinset) Finset.subset_union_left
      obtain ⟨v, vD⟩ := D.nonempty
      let Ddis := D.disjoint_right
      simp_rw [Finset.coe_union, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, Set.disjoint_union_left,
        Set.disjoint_iff] at Ddis
      exact Ddis.right ⟨(ComponentCompl.hom_eq_iff_le _ _ _).mp e vD, vD⟩

name: end_hom_mk_of_mk
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sec h, hs]
  apply ComponentCompl.hom_mk _ (le_of_op_hom h)

name: infinite_iff_in_eventualRange
statement:
theorem infinite_iff_in_eventualRange {K : (Finset V)ᵒᵖ} (C : G.componentComplFunctor.obj K) :
    C.supp.Infinite ↔ C ∈ G.componentComplFunctor.eventualRange K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [C.infinite_iff_in_all_ranges, CategoryTheory.Functor.eventualRange, Set.mem_iInter,
    Set.mem_range, componentComplFunctor_map]
  exact
    ⟨fun h Lop KL => h Lop.unop (le_of_op_hom KL), fun h L KL =>
      h (Opposite.op L) (opHomOfLE KL)⟩

name: end_componentCompl_infinite
statement:
lemma end_componentCompl_infinite (e : G.end) (K : (Finset V)ᵒᵖ) :
    ((e : (j : (Finset V)ᵒᵖ) → G.componentComplFunctor.obj j) K).supp.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  refine (e.val K).infinite_iff_in_all_ranges.mpr (fun L h => ?_)
  change Opposite.unop K ⊆ Opposite.unop (Opposite.op L) at h
  exact ⟨e.val (Opposite.op L), (e.prop (CategoryTheory.opHomOfLE h))⟩

name: nonempty_ends_of_infinite
statement:
lemma nonempty_ends_of_infinite [LocallyFinite G] [Fact G.Preconnected] [Infinite V] :
    G.end.Nonempty

name: filter_subset_compl_verts
statement: theorem filter_subset_compl_verts : filter K t ⊆ K.vertsᶜ

name: between_verts_isBipartiteWith
statement:
theorem between_verts_isBipartiteWith :
    (G.between K.verts K.vertsᶜ).IsBipartiteWith K.verts ↑K.vertsᶜ

name: le_card_edgeFinset_between_verts
statement:
lemma le_card_edgeFinset_between_verts :
    (#K.verts * (G.minDegree - #K.verts) : ℝ) ≤ #(G.between K.verts K.vertsᶜ).edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges (between_verts_isBipartiteWith K),
    ← nsmul_eq_mul, ← sum_const, Nat.cast_sum]
  exact sum_le_sum (fun v hv ↦ sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr <|
    mod_cast (G.minDegree_le_degree v).trans (degree_le_between_add hv))

name: degree_between_verts_lt_of_mem_sdiff
statement:
lemma degree_between_verts_lt_of_mem_sdiff
    {v : Fin n} (hv : v ∈ K.vertsᶜ \ filter K t) (ht'_pos : 0 < t') :
    (G.between K.verts K.vertsᶜ).degree v < #K.verts - t' + t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, ErdosStone.filter, mem_filter, not_and_or, and_or_left,
    and_not_self_iff, false_or, not_forall, not_exists, not_and_or, not_forall, exists_prop] at hv
  obtain ⟨hv, p, hp, hs⟩ := hv
  rw [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree,
    isBipartiteWith_neighborFinset' (between_verts_isBipartiteWith K) hv]
  conv =>
    enter [1, 1, 2]
    unfold CompleteEquipartiteSubgraph.verts
  rw [filter_disjiUnion, card_disjiUnion, sum_eq_sum_sdiff_singleton_add hp]
  apply add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
  · conv_rhs =>
      rw [K.card_verts, ← Nat.sub_one_mul, ← K.card_parts.resolve_right ht'_pos.ne',
        ← card_singleton p, ← Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hp),
        ← smul_eq_mul, ← sum_const,
        ← Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ h ↦ K.card_mem_parts (mem_sdiff.mp h).1]
    exact sum_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ card_filter_le _ _)
  · contrapose! hs
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := powersetCard_nonempty.mpr hs
    have hs' : s ∈ p.powersetCard t := powersetCard_mono (filter_subset _ _) hs
    refine ⟨s, hs', fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, hadj, _⟩ := by
      rw [mem_powersetCard] at hs
      apply hs.1 at hw
      rwa [mem_filter, between_adj] at hw
    exact hadj.symm

name: card_edgeFinset_between_verts_le
statement:
lemma card_edgeFinset_between_verts_le (hr_pos : 0 < r) (ht'_pos : 0 < t') :
    (#(G.between K.verts K.vertsᶜ).edgeFinset : ℝ)
      ≤ (n - #K.verts) * (#K.verts - (t' - t))
        + #(filter K t) * (t' - t)
proof:
:=
  calc (#(G.between K.verts K.vertsᶜ).edgeFinset : ℝ)
    _ = ∑ v ∈ K.vertsᶜ \ filter K t, ((G.between K.verts K.vertsᶜ).degree v : ℝ)
      + ∑ v ∈ filter K t, ((G.between K.verts K.vertsᶜ).degree v : ℝ) := by
        rw [ErdosStone.filter, sum_sdiff (filter_subset _ K.vertsᶜ), eq_comm]
        exact_mod_cast isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges'
          (between_verts_isBipartiteWith K)
    _ ≤ ∑ _ ∈ K.vertsᶜ \ filter K t, (#K.verts - t' + t : ℝ)
      + ∑ _ ∈ filter K t, (#K.verts : ℝ) := by
        apply add_le_add <;> refine sum_le_sum (fun v hv ↦ ?_)
        · rw [← Nat.cast_sub ((Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left t' hr_pos).trans_eq K.card_verts.symm)]
          exact_mod_cast (degree_between_verts_lt_of_mem_sdiff K hv ht'_pos).le
        · exact_mod_cast isBipartiteWith_degree_le'
            (between_verts_isBipartiteWith K) (filter_subset_compl_verts K hv)
    _ = (n - #K.verts) * (#K.verts - (t' - t))
      + #(filter K t) * (t' - t) := by
        rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, card_sdiff_of_subset (filter_subset_compl_verts K),
          Nat.cast_sub (card_le_card (filter_subset_compl_verts K)), card_compl,
          Nat.cast_sub (card_le_univ K.verts), Fintype.card_fin, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, sub_mul,
          sub_add (#K.verts : ℝ) _ _, mul_sub (#(filter K t) : ℝ) _ _,
          ← sub_add, sub_add_eq_add_sub, sub_add_cancel]

name: mul_le_card_filter_mul
statement:
lemma mul_le_card_filter_mul (hr_pos : 0 < r) (ht'_pos : 0 < t')
    (hδ : G.minDegree ≥ (1 - 1 / r + ε) * n)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : (N + r * t') * (t' - t) ≤ n * (r * t' * ε - t)) :
    (N * (t' - t) : ℝ) ≤ (#(filter K t) * (t' - t) : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  calc (N * (t' - t) : ℝ)
    _ ≤ n * (r * t' * ε - t) - r * t' * (t' - t) := by
        rw [← add_sub_cancel_right (N : ℝ) (r * t' : ℝ), sub_mul]
        exact sub_le_sub_right hN _
    _ = #K.verts * ((1 - 1 / r + ε) * n - #K.verts)
      - (n - #K.verts) * (#K.verts - (t' - t)) := by
        conv_rhs => rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_mul, neg_sub, sub_mul, mul_sub, ← add_sub_assoc,
          mul_sub, ← add_sub_assoc, sub_add_cancel, sub_right_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_rotate,
          mul_assoc, ← mul_sub, mul_add, mul_sub (#K.verts : ℝ) _ _, mul_one,
          sub_add_eq_add_sub, add_sub_assoc, add_sub_sub_cancel, K.card_verts, Nat.cast_mul,
          mul_one_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀ (t' : ℝ) (mod_cast hr_pos.ne'), sub_add_sub_cancel]
    _ ≤ #K.verts * (G.minDegree - #K.verts) - (n - #K.verts) * (#K.verts - (t' - t)) :=
        sub_le_sub_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (sub_le_sub_right hδ _) (#K.verts).cast_nonneg) _
    _ ≤ #(filter K t) * (t' - t) :=
        sub_left_le_of_le_add <| (le_card_edgeFinset_between_verts K).trans
          (card_edgeFinset_between_verts_le K hr_pos ht'_pos)

name: filter.pi.mem_val
statement:
theorem filter.pi.mem_val {p} (hp : p ∈ K.parts) (w : filter K t) :
    ∀ v ∈ (filter.pi K w).val p hp, G.Adj w v
proof:
:=
  let s := Multiset.of_mem_filter w.prop p hp
  s.choose_spec.right

name: filter.pi.exists_le_card_fiber
statement:
theorem filter.pi.exists_le_card_fiber (hr_pos : 0 < r) (ht'_pos : 0 < t')
    (ht_lt_t' : t < t') (hδ : G.minDegree ≥ (1 - 1 / r + ε) * n)
    (hN : (t'.choose t ^ r * t + r * t') * (t' - t) ≤ n * (r * t' * ε - t)) :
    ∃ y : K.parts.pi (·.powersetCard t), t ≤ #{ w | filter.pi K w = y }
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (K.parts.pi (·.powersetCard t)) := by
    simp_rw [nonempty_coe_sort, pi_nonempty, powersetCard_nonempty]
    intro p hp
    rw [K.card_mem_parts hp]
    exact ht_lt_t'.le
  apply exists_le_card_fiber_of_mul_le_card
  simp_rw [card_coe]
  calc #(K.parts.pi (·.powersetCard t)) * t
    _ = (∏ x ∈ K.parts, (#x).choose t) * t := by
        simp_rw [Finset.card_pi, card_powersetCard]
    _ = (∏ p ∈ K.parts, t'.choose t) * t :=
        congrArg (· * t) <| prod_congr rfl
          fun p hp ↦ congrArg (Nat.choose · t) <| K.card_mem_parts hp
    _ ≤ t'.choose t ^ r * t := by
        rw [prod_const, K.card_parts.resolve_right ht'_pos.ne']
    _ ≤ #(filter K t) := by
        refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt ht_lt_t')
        rw [← @Nat.cast_le ℝ, Nat.cast_mul _ (t' - t), Nat.cast_mul _ (t' - t),
          Nat.cast_sub ht_lt_t'.le]
        exact mul_le_card_filter_mul K hr_pos ht'_pos hδ (mod_cast hN)

name: IsExtremal.prop
statement: lemma IsExtremal.prop {p : SimpleGraph V → Prop} (h : G.IsExtremal p) : p G

name: exists_isExtremal_iff_exists
statement:
theorem exists_isExtremal_iff_exists (p : SimpleGraph V → Prop) :
    (∃ G : SimpleGraph V, ∃ _ : DecidableRel G.Adj, G.IsExtremal p) ↔ ∃ G, p G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, _, h⟩ ↦ ⟨_, h.1⟩, fun ⟨G, hp⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨G', hp', h⟩ := by
    apply exists_max_image { G | p G } (#·.edgeFinset)
    use G, by simpa using hp
  use G', inferInstanceAs (DecidableRel G'.Adj)
  exact ⟨by simpa using hp', fun _ _ hp ↦ by convert! h _ (by simpa using hp)⟩

name: exists_isExtremal_free
statement:
theorem exists_isExtremal_free {W : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph W} (h : H ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ G : SimpleGraph V, ∃ _ : DecidableRel G.Adj, G.IsExtremal H.Free

name: IsExtremal.le_iff_eq
statement:
theorem IsExtremal.le_iff_eq
    {p : SimpleGraph V → Prop} (hG : G.IsExtremal p) {H : SimpleGraph V} (hH : p H) :
    G ≤ H ↔ G = H
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hGH ↦ edgeFinset_inj.1 <|
    eq_of_subset_of_card_le (edgeFinset_subset_edgeFinset.2 hGH) (hG.2 hH), le_of_eq⟩

name: extremalNumber_of_fintypeCard_eq
statement:
theorem extremalNumber_of_fintypeCard_eq [Fintype V] (hc : card V = n) :
    extremalNumber n H = sup { G : SimpleGraph V | H.Free G } (#·.edgeFinset)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hc
  rw [extremalNumber, le_antisymm_iff]
  and_intros
  on_goal 1 =>
    replace e := e.symm
  all_goals
  rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro G h
  have h' : G.map e ∈ univ.filter (H.Free ·) := by
    rw [mem_filter, ← free_congr .refl (.map e G)]
    simpa using h
  rw [Iso.card_edgeFinset_eq (.map e G)]
  convert! @le_sup _ _ _ _ {G | H.Free G} (#·.edgeFinset) _ h'

name: card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber
statement:
theorem card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber (h : H.Free G) :
    #G.edgeFinset ≤ extremalNumber (card V) H
proof:
:= by
  rw [extremalNumber_of_fintypeCard_eq rfl]
  convert! @le_sup _ _ _ _ {G | H.Free G} (#·.edgeFinset) G (by simpa using h)

name: IsContained.of_extremalNumber_lt_card_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem IsContained.of_extremalNumber_lt_card_edgeFinset
    (h : extremalNumber (card V) H < #G.edgeFinset) : H ⊑ G
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h; push Not
  exact card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber h

name: extremalNumber_le_iff
statement:
theorem extremalNumber_le_iff (H : SimpleGraph W) (m : ℕ) :
    extremalNumber (card V) H ≤ m ↔
      ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph V⦄ [DecidableRel G.Adj], H.Free G → #G.edgeFinset ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [extremalNumber_of_fintypeCard_eq rfl, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter_univ]
  exact ⟨fun h _ _ h' ↦ by convert! h _ h', fun h _ h' ↦ by convert! h h'⟩

name: lt_extremalNumber_iff
statement:
theorem lt_extremalNumber_iff (H : SimpleGraph W) (m : ℕ) :
    m < extremalNumber (card V) H ↔
      ∃ G : SimpleGraph V, ∃ _ : DecidableRel G.Adj, H.Free G ∧ m < #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [extremalNumber_of_fintypeCard_eq rfl, Finset.lt_sup_iff, mem_filter_univ]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, h, h'⟩ ↦ ⟨_, _, h, h'⟩, fun ⟨_, _, h, h'⟩ ↦ ⟨_, h, by convert!
    h'⟩⟩

name: extremalNumber_le_iff_of_nonneg
statement:
@[inherit_doc extremalNumber_le_iff]
theorem extremalNumber_le_iff_of_nonneg (H : SimpleGraph W) {m : R} (h : 0 ≤ m) :
    extremalNumber (card V) H ≤ m ↔
      ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph V⦄ [DecidableRel G.Adj], H.Free G → #G.edgeFinset ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Nat.le_floor_iff h]
  exact extremalNumber_le_iff H ⌊m⌋₊

name: lt_extremalNumber_iff_of_nonneg
statement:
@[inherit_doc lt_extremalNumber_iff]
theorem lt_extremalNumber_iff_of_nonneg (H : SimpleGraph W) {m : R} (h : 0 ≤ m) :
    m < extremalNumber (card V) H ↔
      ∃ G : SimpleGraph V, ∃ _ : DecidableRel G.Adj, H.Free G ∧ m < #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Nat.floor_lt h]
  exact lt_extremalNumber_iff H ⌊m⌋₊

name: IsContained.extremalNumber_le
statement:
theorem IsContained.extremalNumber_le {W' : Type*} {H' : SimpleGraph W'} (h : H' ⊑ H) :
    extremalNumber n H' ≤ extremalNumber n H
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_fin n, extremalNumber_le_iff]
  intro _ _ h'
  contrapose! h'
  exact h.trans (IsContained.of_extremalNumber_lt_card_edgeFinset h')

name: extremalNumber_congr
statement:
@[congr]
theorem extremalNumber_congr {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} {W₁ W₂ : Type*} {H₁ : SimpleGraph W₁}
    {H₂ : SimpleGraph W₂} (h : n₁ = n₂) (e : H₁ ≃g H₂) :
    extremalNumber n₁ H₁ = extremalNumber n₂ H₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, le_antisymm_iff]
  and_intros
  on_goal 2 =>
    replace e := e.symm
  all_goals
    rw [← Fintype.card_fin n₂, extremalNumber_le_iff]
    intro G _ h
    apply card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber
    contrapose h
    exact h.trans' ⟨e.toCopy⟩

name: extremalNumber_congr_right
statement:
theorem extremalNumber_congr_right {W₁ W₂ : Type*} {H₁ : SimpleGraph W₁} {H₂ : SimpleGraph W₂}
    (e : H₁ ≃g H₂) : extremalNumber n H₁ = extremalNumber n H₂

name: isExtremal_free_iff
statement:
theorem isExtremal_free_iff :
    G.IsExtremal H.Free ↔ H.Free G ∧ #G.edgeFinset = extremalNumber (card V) H
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsExtremal, and_congr_right_iff, ← extremalNumber_le_iff]
  exact fun h ↦ ⟨eq_of_le_of_ge (card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber h), ge_of_eq⟩

name: card_edgeFinset_of_isExtremal_free
statement:
lemma card_edgeFinset_of_isExtremal_free (h : G.IsExtremal H.Free) :
    #G.edgeFinset = extremalNumber (card V) H

name: card_edgeFinset_deleteIncidenceSet_le_extremalNumber
statement:
theorem card_edgeFinset_deleteIncidenceSet_le_extremalNumber
    [DecidableEq V] (h : H.Free G) (v : V) :
    #(G.deleteIncidenceSet v).edgeFinset ≤ extremalNumber (card V - 1) H
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_edgeFinset_induce_compl_singleton, ← @card_unique ({v} : Set V), ← card_compl_set]
  apply card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber
  contrapose h
  exact h.trans ⟨Copy.induce G {v}ᶜ⟩

name: turanGraph_adj
statement: lemma turanGraph_adj {v w} : (turanGraph n r).Adj v w ↔ v % r ≠ w % r

name: turanGraph_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma turanGraph_zero : turanGraph n 0 = ⊤

name: turanGraph_one
statement: @[simp] lemma turanGraph_one : turanGraph n 1 = ⊥

name: turanGraph_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem turanGraph_eq_top : turanGraph n r = ⊤ ↔ r = 0 ∨ n ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [SimpleGraph.ext_iff, funext_iff, turanGraph, top_adj, eq_iff_iff, not_iff_not]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · contrapose! h
    use ⟨0, (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h.1).trans h.2⟩, ⟨r, h.2⟩
    simp [h.1.symm]
  · rintro (rfl | h) a b
    · simp [Fin.val_inj]
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (a.2.trans_le h), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (b.2.trans_le h), Fin.val_inj]

name: turanGraph_cliqueFree
statement: theorem turanGraph_cliqueFree (hr : 0 < r) : (turanGraph n r).CliqueFree (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliqueFree_iff_isEmpty_copy_top_fin]
  by_contra! ⟨f⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, d, c⟩ := exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt (fun x ↦
    (⟨(f x).1 % r, Nat.mod_lt _ hr⟩ : Fin r)) (by simp)
  rw [Fin.mk.injEq] at c
  exact absurd c <| f.toHom.map_adj d

name: not_cliqueFree_of_isTuranMaximal
statement:
theorem not_cliqueFree_of_isTuranMaximal (hn : r ≤ card V) (hG : G.IsTuranMaximal r) :
    ¬G.CliqueFree r
proof:
:= by
  rintro h
  obtain ⟨K, _, rfl⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq hn
  obtain ⟨a, -, b, -, hab, hGab⟩ : ∃ a ∈ K, ∃ b ∈ K, a ≠ b ∧ ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    simpa only [isNClique_iff, IsClique, Set.Pairwise, mem_coe, ne_eq, and_true, not_forall,
      exists_prop, exists_and_right] using h K
  exact hGab <| le_sup_right.trans_eq ((hG.le_iff_eq <| h.sup_edge _ _).1 le_sup_left).symm <|
    (edge_adj ..).2 ⟨Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hab⟩

name: exists_isTuranMaximal
statement:
lemma exists_isTuranMaximal (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph V, ∃ _ : DecidableRel H.Adj, H.IsTuranMaximal r
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsTuranMaximal, exists_isExtremal_iff_exists] using ⟨⊥, cliqueFree_bot (by lia)⟩

name: degree_eq_of_not_adj
statement:
lemma degree_eq_of_not_adj (h : G.IsTuranMaximal r) (hn : ¬G.Adj s t) :
    G.degree s = G.degree t
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsTuranMaximal, IsExtremal] at h; contrapose! h; intro cf
  wlog hd : G.degree t < G.degree s generalizing G t s
  · replace hd : G.degree s < G.degree t := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hd) h
    exact this (by rwa [adj_comm] at hn) hd.ne' cf hd
  classical
  use G.replaceVertex s t, inferInstance, cf.replaceVertex s t
  have := G.card_edgeFinset_replaceVertex_of_not_adj hn
  lia

name: not_adj_trans
statement:
lemma not_adj_trans (h : G.IsTuranMaximal r) (hts : ¬G.Adj t s) (hsu : ¬G.Adj s u) :
    ¬G.Adj t u
proof:
:= by
  have hst : ¬G.Adj s t := fun a ↦ hts a.symm
  have dst := h.degree_eq_of_not_adj hst
  have dsu := h.degree_eq_of_not_adj hsu
  rw [IsTuranMaximal, IsExtremal] at h; contrapose! h; intro cf
  classical
  use (G.replaceVertex s t).replaceVertex s u, inferInstance,
    (cf.replaceVertex s t).replaceVertex s u
  have nst : s ≠ t := fun a ↦ hsu (a ▸ h)
  have ntu : t ≠ u := G.ne_of_adj h
  have := (G.adj_replaceVertex_iff_of_ne s nst ntu.symm).not.mpr hsu
  rw [card_edgeFinset_replaceVertex_of_not_adj _ this,
    card_edgeFinset_replaceVertex_of_not_adj _ hst, dst, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have l1 : (G.replaceVertex s t).degree s = G.degree s := by
    unfold degree; congr 1; ext v
    simp_rw [mem_neighborFinset]
    by_cases eq : v = t
    · simpa only [eq, not_adj_replaceVertex_same, false_iff]
    · rw [G.adj_replaceVertex_iff_of_ne s nst eq]
  have l2 : (G.replaceVertex s t).degree u = G.degree u - 1 := by
    rw [degree, degree, ← card_singleton t, ← card_sdiff_of_subset (by simp [h.symm])]
    congr 1; ext v
    simp_rw [mem_neighborFinset, mem_sdiff, mem_singleton, replaceVertex]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [adj_comm]
  have l3 : 0 < G.degree u := by rw [G.degree_pos_iff_exists_adj u]; use t, h.symm
  lia

name: equivalence_not_adj
statement:
theorem equivalence_not_adj : Equivalence (¬G.Adj · ·) where
  refl
proof:
:= by simp
  symm := by simp [adj_comm]
  trans := h.not_adj_trans

name: not_adj_iff_part_eq
statement:
lemma not_adj_iff_part_eq [DecidableEq V] :
    ¬G.Adj s t ↔ h.finpartition.part s = h.finpartition.part t
proof:
:= by
  change h.setoid.r s t ↔ _
  rw [← Finpartition.mem_part_ofSetoid_iff_rel]
  let fp := h.finpartition
  change t ∈ fp.part s ↔ fp.part s = fp.part t
  rw [fp.mem_part_iff_part_eq_part (mem_univ t) (mem_univ s), eq_comm]

name: degree_eq_card_sub_part_card
statement:
lemma degree_eq_card_sub_part_card [DecidableEq V] :
    G.degree s = card V - #(h.finpartition.part s)
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = #{t | G.Adj s t} := by
      simp [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, neighborFinset]
    _ = card V - #{t | ¬G.Adj s t} :=
      eq_tsub_of_add_eq (card_filter_add_card_filter_not _)
    _ = _ := by
      congr; ext; rw [mem_filter]
      convert! Finpartition.mem_part_ofSetoid_iff_rel.symm
      simp +instances [setoid]

name: isEquipartition
statement: theorem isEquipartition [DecidableEq V] : h.finpartition.IsEquipartition
proof:
:= by
  set fp := h.finpartition
  by_contra hn
  rw [Finpartition.not_isEquipartition] at hn
  obtain ⟨large, hl, small, hs, ineq⟩ := hn
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := fp.nonempty_of_mem_parts hl
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := fp.nonempty_of_mem_parts hs
  apply absurd h
  rw [IsTuranMaximal, IsExtremal]; push Not; intro cf
  use G.replaceVertex v w, inferInstance, cf.replaceVertex v w
  have large_eq := fp.part_eq_of_mem hl hw
  have small_eq := fp.part_eq_of_mem hs hv
  have ha : G.Adj v w := by
    by_contra hn; rw [h.not_adj_iff_part_eq, small_eq, large_eq] at hn
    rw [hn] at ineq; lia
  rw [G.card_edgeFinset_replaceVertex_of_adj ha,
    degree_eq_card_sub_part_card h, small_eq, degree_eq_card_sub_part_card h, large_eq]
  have : #large ≤ card V := by simpa using card_le_card large.subset_univ
  lia

name: card_parts_le
statement: lemma card_parts_le [DecidableEq V] : #h.finpartition.parts ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! l
  obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := h.finpartition.exists_subset_part_bijOn
  have ncf : ¬G.CliqueFree #z := by
    refine IsNClique.not_cliqueFree ⟨fun v hv w hw hn ↦ ?_, rfl⟩
    contrapose hn
    exact hz.injOn hv hw (by rwa [← h.not_adj_iff_part_eq])
  rw [Finset.card_eq_of_equiv hz.equiv] at ncf
  exact absurd (h.1.mono (Nat.succ_le_of_lt l)) ncf

name: card_parts
statement: theorem card_parts [DecidableEq V] : #h.finpartition.parts = min (card V) r
proof:
:= by
  set fp := h.finpartition
  apply le_antisymm (le_min fp.card_parts_le_card h.card_parts_le)
  by_contra! l
  rw [lt_min_iff] at l
  obtain ⟨x, -, y, -, hn, he⟩ :=
    exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to l.1 fun a _ ↦ fp.part_mem.2 (mem_univ a)
  apply absurd h
  rw [IsTuranMaximal, IsExtremal]; push Not; rintro -
  have cf : G.CliqueFree r := by
    simp_rw [← cliqueFinset_eq_empty_iff, cliqueFinset, filter_eq_empty_iff, mem_univ,
      forall_true_left, isNClique_iff, and_comm, not_and, isClique_iff, Set.Pairwise]
    intro z zc; push Not; simp_rw [h.not_adj_iff_part_eq]
    exact exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (zc.symm ▸ l.2) fun a _ ↦
      fp.part_mem.2 (mem_univ a)
  use G ⊔ edge x y, inferInstance, cf.sup_edge x y
  convert! Nat.lt_add_one #G.edgeFinset
  convert! G.card_edgeFinset_sup_edge _ hn
  rwa [h.not_adj_iff_part_eq]

name: nonempty_iso_turanGraph
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_turanGraph :
    Nonempty (G ≃g turanGraph (card V) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨zm, zp⟩ := h.isEquipartition.exists_partPreservingEquiv
  use (Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv mem_univ).symm.trans zm
  intro a b
  simp_rw [turanGraph_adj, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv_symm_apply]
  have := zp ⟨a, mem_univ a⟩ ⟨b, mem_univ b⟩
  rw [← h.not_adj_iff_part_eq] at this
  rw [← not_iff_not, not_ne_iff, this, card_parts]
  rcases le_or_gt r (card V) with c | c
  · rw [min_eq_right c]; rfl
  · have lc : ∀ x, zm ⟨x, _⟩ < card V := fun x ↦ (zm ⟨x, mem_univ x⟩).2
    rw [min_eq_left c.le, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lc a), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lc b),
      ← Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ((lc a).trans c), ← Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ((lc b).trans c)]; rfl

name: isTuranMaximal_of_iso
statement: theorem isTuranMaximal_of_iso (f : G ≃g turanGraph n r) (hr : 0 < r) : G.IsTuranMaximal r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, _, j⟩ := exists_isTuranMaximal (V := V) hr
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := j.nonempty_iso_turanGraph
  rw [f.card_eq, Fintype.card_fin] at g
  use (turanGraph_cliqueFree (n := n) hr).comap f.isContained,
    fun H _ cf ↦ (f.symm.comp g).card_edgeFinset_eq ▸ j.2 cf

name: IsTuranMaximal.iso
statement:
theorem IsTuranMaximal.iso {W : Type*} [Fintype W] {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [DecidableRel H.Adj] (h : G.IsTuranMaximal r) (f : G ≃g H) (hr : 0 < r) : H.IsTuranMaximal r

name: isTuranMaximal_turanGraph
statement: theorem isTuranMaximal_turanGraph (hr : 0 < r) : (turanGraph n r).IsTuranMaximal r

name: isTuranMaximal_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph
statement:
theorem isTuranMaximal_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph (hr : 0 < r) :
    G.IsTuranMaximal r ↔ Nonempty (G ≃g turanGraph (card V) r)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.nonempty_iso_turanGraph, fun h ↦ isTuranMaximal_of_iso h.some hr⟩

name: isExtremal_top_free_iff_isTuranMaximal
statement:
lemma isExtremal_top_free_iff_isTuranMaximal :
    G.IsExtremal (⊤ : SimpleGraph α).Free ↔ G.IsTuranMaximal (card α - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsTuranMaximal, IsExtremal,
    Nat.sub_one_add_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, cliqueFree_card_iff_free_top]

name: isExtremal_top_free_turanGraph
statement:
lemma isExtremal_top_free_turanGraph :
    (turanGraph n (card α - 1)).IsExtremal (⊤ : SimpleGraph α).Free

name: extremalNumber_top
statement:
theorem extremalNumber_top :
    extremalNumber n (⊤ : SimpleGraph α) = #(turanGraph n (card α - 1)).edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    enter [1, 1]
    rw [← Fintype.card_fin n]
  exact (card_edgeFinset_of_isExtremal_free isExtremal_top_free_turanGraph).symm

name: card_edgeFinset_eq_extremalNumber_top_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph
statement:
theorem card_edgeFinset_eq_extremalNumber_top_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph :
    (⊤ : SimpleGraph α).Free G ∧ #G.edgeFinset = extremalNumber (card V) (⊤ : SimpleGraph α)
      ↔ Nonempty (G ≃g turanGraph (card V) (card α - 1))

name: sum_ne_add_mod_eq_sub_one
statement:
private lemma sum_ne_add_mod_eq_sub_one {c : ℕ} :
    ∑ w ∈ range r, (if c % r ≠ (n + w) % r then 1 else 0) = r - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases r.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hr; · simp
  suffices #{i ∈ range r | c % r = (n + i) % r} = 1 by
    rw [← card_filter, ← this]; apply Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq'
    rw [card_filter_add_card_filter_not, card_range]
  apply le_antisymm
  · change #{i ∈ range r | _ ≡ _ [MOD r]} ≤ 1
    rw [card_le_one_iff]; intro w x mw mx
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range] at mw mx
    have := mw.2.symm.trans mx.2
    rw [Nat.ModEq.add_iff_left rfl] at this
    change w % r = x % r at this
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt mw.1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt mx.1] at this
  · rw [one_le_card]; use ((r - 1) * n + c) % r
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range]; refine ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hr, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.add_mod_mod, ← add_assoc, ← one_add_mul, show 1 + (r - 1) = r by lia,
      Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left]

name: turanNumber_add
statement: lemma turanNumber_add : turanNumber (n + r) r = turanNumber n r + n * (r - 1) + r.choose 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_right_inj' two_ne_zero]
  simp_rw [mul_add, ← sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges,
    degree, neighborFinset_eq_filter, turanGraph, card_filter]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [2, v]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range fun w ↦ if v % r ≠ w % r then 1 else 0, sum_range_add]
  rw [sum_add_distrib,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range fun v ↦ ∑ w ∈ range n, if v % r ≠ w % r then 1 else 0,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range fun v ↦ ∑ w ∈ range r, if v % r ≠ (n + w) % r then 1 else 0,
    sum_range_add, sum_range_add, add_assoc, add_assoc]
  congr 1; · simp [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  rw [← add_assoc, sum_comm]; simp_rw [ne_comm, ← two_mul]; congr
  · conv_rhs => rw [← card_range n, ← smul_eq_mul, ← sum_const]
    congr!; exact sum_ne_add_mod_eq_sub_one
  · rw [mul_comm 2, Nat.choose_two_right, Nat.div_two_mul_two_of_even (Nat.even_mul_pred_self r)]
    conv_rhs => enter [1]; rw [← card_range r]
    rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← sum_const]
    congr!; exact sum_ne_add_mod_eq_sub_one

name: turanNumber_eq
statement:
theorem turanNumber_eq {n r : ℕ} :
    turanNumber n r = (n ^ 2 - (n % r) ^ 2) * (r - 1) / (2 * r) + (n % r).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases r.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hr
  · rw [Nat.mod_zero, tsub_self, zero_mul, Nat.zero_div, zero_add]
    have := card_edgeFinset_top_eq_card_choose_two (V := Fin n)
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at this; convert! this; exact turanGraph_zero
  · have ring₁ (n) : (n ^ 2 - (n % r) ^ 2) * (r - 1) / (2 * r) =
        n % r * (n / r) * (r - 1) + r * (r - 1) * (n / r) ^ 2 / 2 := by
      nth_rw 1 [← Nat.mod_add_div n r, Nat.sq_sub_sq, add_tsub_cancel_left,
        show (n % r + r * (n / r) + n % r) * (r * (n / r)) * (r - 1) =
          (2 * ((n % r) * (n / r) * (r - 1)) + r * (r - 1) * (n / r) ^ 2) * r by grind]
      rw [Nat.mul_div_mul_right _ _ hr, Nat.mul_add_div zero_lt_two]
    rcases lt_or_ge n r with h | h
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h, tsub_self, zero_mul, Nat.zero_div, zero_add]
      have := card_edgeFinset_top_eq_card_choose_two (V := Fin n)
      rw [Fintype.card_fin] at this; convert! this
      rw [turanGraph_eq_top]; exact .inr h.le
    · let n' := n - r
      have n'r : n = n' + r := by lia
      rw [n'r, turanNumber_add, turanNumber_eq, ring₁, ring₁,
        add_rotate, ← add_assoc, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.add_div_right _ hr]
      congr 1
      have rd : 2 ∣ r * (r - 1) := (Nat.even_mul_pred_self _).two_dvd
      rw [← Nat.div_mul_right_comm rd, ← Nat.div_mul_right_comm rd, ← Nat.choose_two_right]
      have ring₂ : n' % r * (n' / r + 1) * (r - 1) + r.choose 2 * (n' / r + 1) ^ 2 =
          n' % r * (n' / r + 1) * (r - 1) + r.choose 2 +
          r.choose 2 * 2 * (n' / r) + r.choose 2 * (n' / r) ^ 2 := by grind
      rw [ring₂, ← add_assoc]; congr 1
      rw [← add_rotate, ← add_rotate _ _ (r.choose 2)]; congr 1
      rw [Nat.choose_two_right, Nat.div_mul_cancel rd, mul_add_one, add_mul, ← add_assoc,
        ← add_rotate, add_comm _ (_ * _)]; congr 1
      rw [← mul_rotate, ← add_mul, add_comm, mul_comm _ r, Nat.div_add_mod n' r]

name: turanNumber_two
statement: lemma turanNumber_two : turanNumber n 2 = n ^ 2 / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [turanNumber_eq]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩ := n.even_or_odd
  · simp [← two_mul]
  · simp; lia

name: turanNumber_three
statement: lemma turanNumber_three : turanNumber n 3 = n ^ 2 / 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [turanNumber_eq]
  obtain hn | hn | hn : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by lia
  all_goals
    nth_rw 1 [← n.mod_add_div 3]
    grind

name: mul_turanNumber_le
statement: theorem mul_turanNumber_le : 2 * r * turanNumber n r ≤ (r - 1) * n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  grw [turanNumber_eq, mul_add, Nat.mul_div_le]
  rw [tsub_mul, ← Nat.sub_add_comm]; swap
  · grw [Nat.mod_le]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  rw [Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add, mul_comm, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left, Nat.choose_two_right,
    ← Nat.mul_div_assoc _ (Nat.even_mul_pred_self _).two_dvd, mul_assoc,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_rotate, sq, ← mul_rotate (r - 1)]
  gcongr ?_ * _
  rcases r.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hr; · lia
  rw [Nat.sub_one_mul, Nat.sub_one_mul, mul_comm]
  exact Nat.sub_le_sub_left (Nat.mod_lt _ hr).le _

name: CliqueFree.card_edgeFinset_le
statement:
theorem CliqueFree.card_edgeFinset_le (cf : G.CliqueFree (r + 1)) :
    #G.edgeFinset ≤ turanNumber (Fintype.card V) r
proof:
:= by
  rcases r.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hr
  · rw [cliqueFree_one, ← Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff] at cf
    simp [turanNumber_eq, card_edgeFinset_le_card_choose_two]
  · obtain ⟨H, _, maxH⟩ := exists_isTuranMaximal (V := V) hr
    convert! maxH.2 cf
    rw [((isTuranMaximal_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph hr).mp maxH).some.card_edgeFinset_eq]

name: strictMonoOn_turanNumber
statement: lemma strictMonoOn_turanNumber : StrictMonoOn (turanNumber n) (Set.Icc 1 n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro a ⟨lba, -⟩ b ⟨lbb, ubb⟩ hab
  by_contra! ht
  have itm : (turanGraph n a).IsTuranMaximal b :=
    ⟨(turanGraph_cliqueFree lba).mono (by lia),
      fun G' _ hG' ↦ ((isTuranMaximal_turanGraph lbb).2 hG').trans ht⟩
  obtain ⟨f⟩ : Nonempty (turanGraph n a ≃g turanGraph n b) := by
    convert itm.nonempty_iso_turanGraph <;> simp
  apply absurd ((turanGraph_cliqueFree lba).comap ⟨f.symm.toCopy⟩)
  have key := not_cliqueFree_of_isTuranMaximal (by simp [ubb]) (@isTuranMaximal_turanGraph n _ lbb)
  contrapose key
  exact key.mono hab

name: antitoneOn_extremalNumber_div_choose_two
statement:
lemma antitoneOn_extremalNumber_div_choose_two (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    AntitoneOn (fun n ↦ (extremalNumber n H / n.choose 2 : ℝ)) (Set.Ici 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply antitoneOn_nat_Ici_of_succ_le
  intro n hn
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 1]
    rw [← Fintype.card_fin (n + 1)]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (mod_cast Nat.choose_pos (by linarith)),
    extremalNumber_le_iff_of_nonneg H (by positivity)]
  intro G _ h
  rw [mul_comm, ← mul_div_assoc, le_div_iff₀' (mod_cast Nat.choose_pos hn), Nat.cast_choose_two,
    Nat.cast_choose_two, Nat.cast_add_one, add_sub_cancel_right (n : ℝ) 1,
    mul_comm _ (n - 1 : ℝ), ← mul_div (n - 1 : ℝ), mul_comm _ (n / 2 : ℝ), mul_assoc,
    mul_comm (n - 1 : ℝ), ← mul_div (n + 1 : ℝ), mul_comm _ (n / 2 : ℝ), mul_assoc,
    mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity), ← Nat.cast_pred (by positivity), ← Nat.cast_mul,
    ← Nat.cast_add_one, ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_le]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← Fintype.card_fin (n + 1), ← card_univ]
  
  apply card_nsmul_le_card_nsmul' (r := fun v e ↦ v ∉ e)
  
  · intro e he
    simp_rw [← Sym2.mem_toFinset, bipartiteBelow, filter_not, filter_mem_eq_inter, univ_inter,
      ← compl_eq_univ_sdiff, card_compl, Fintype.card_fin, card_toFinset_mem_edgeFinset ⟨e, he⟩,
      Nat.cast_id, Nat.reduceSubDiff, le_refl]
  
  · intro v hv
    simpa [edgeFinset_deleteIncidenceSet_eq_filter]
      using! card_edgeFinset_deleteIncidenceSet_le_extremalNumber h v

name: isGLB_turanDensity
statement:
theorem isGLB_turanDensity (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    IsGLB { (extremalNumber n H / n.choose 2 : ℝ) | n ∈ Set.Ici 2 } (turanDensity H)
proof:
:= by
  have h_bdd : BddBelow { (extremalNumber n H / n.choose 2 : ℝ) | n ∈ Set.Ici 2 } := by
    refine ⟨0, fun x ⟨_, _, hx⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← hx]
    positivity
  refine Real.isGLB_of_tendsto_antitoneOn_bddBelow_nat_Ici ?_
    (antitoneOn_extremalNumber_div_choose_two H) h_bdd
  have h_tto := Real.tendsto_atTop_csInf_of_antitoneOn_bddBelow_nat_Ici
    (antitoneOn_extremalNumber_div_choose_two H) h_bdd
  rwa [← h_tto.limUnder_eq] at h_tto

name: turanDensity_eq_csInf
statement:
theorem turanDensity_eq_csInf (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    turanDensity H = sInf { (extremalNumber n H / n.choose 2 : ℝ) | n ∈ Set.Ici 2 }

name: tendsto_turanDensity
statement:
theorem tendsto_turanDensity (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ (extremalNumber n H / n.choose 2 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (turanDensity H))
proof:
:= by
  have h_tendsto := Real.tendsto_atTop_csInf_of_antitoneOn_bddBelow_nat_Ici
    (antitoneOn_extremalNumber_div_choose_two H) (isGLB_turanDensity H).bddBelow
  rwa [turanDensity, h_tendsto.limUnder_eq]

name: isEquivalent_extremalNumber
statement:
theorem isEquivalent_extremalNumber {H : SimpleGraph W} (h : turanDensity H ≠ 0) :
    (fun n ↦ (extremalNumber n H : ℝ)) ~[atTop] (fun n ↦ (turanDensity H * n.choose 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := tendsto_turanDensity H
  apply Tendsto.const_mul (1 / turanDensity H : ℝ) at hπ
  simp_rw [one_div_mul_cancel h, div_mul_div_comm, one_mul] at hπ
  have hz : ∀ᶠ (x : ℕ) in atTop, turanDensity H * x.choose 2 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eventually_atTop]
    refine ⟨2, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    simpa [h, Nat.choose_eq_zero_iff]
  simpa [isEquivalent_iff_tendsto_one hz] using! hπ

name: eventually_isContained_of_card_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem eventually_isContained_of_card_edgeFinset (H : SimpleGraph W) {ε : ℝ} (hε_pos : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ {G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)} [DecidableRel G.Adj],
      #G.edgeFinset ≥ (turanDensity H + ε) * n.choose 2 → H ⊑ G
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := (turanDensity_eq_csInf H).ge
  rw [eventually_atTop]
  contrapose! hπ with h
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le <| lt_add_of_pos_right (turanDensity H) hε_pos
  refine le_csInf ?_ (fun x ⟨m, hm, hx⟩ ↦ ?_)
  · rw [← Set.image, Set.image_nonempty]
    exact Set.nonempty_Ici
  rw [← hx]
  have ⟨n, hn, G, _, hcard_edges, h_free⟩ := h m
  replace h_free : H.Free G := not_nonempty_iff.mpr h_free
  trans (extremalNumber n H / n.choose 2)
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ <| mod_cast Nat.choose_pos (hm.trans hn)]
    conv =>
      enter [2, 1, 1]
      rw [← Fintype.card_fin n]
    exact hcard_edges.trans (mod_cast card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber h_free)
  · exact antitoneOn_extremalNumber_div_choose_two H hm (hm.trans hn) hn

name: isContained_of_card_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem isContained_of_card_edgeFinset (H : SimpleGraph W) {ε : ℝ} (hε_pos : 0 < ε)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (h_verts : card V ≥ turanDensityConst H ε)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    #G.edgeFinset ≥ (turanDensity H + ε) * (card V).choose 2 → H ⊑ G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [(G.overFinIso rfl).card_edgeFinset_eq, isContained_congr Iso.refl (G.overFinIso rfl)]
  apply Nat.find_spec <| eventually_atTop.mp <| eventually_isContained_of_card_edgeFinset H hε_pos
  simpa only [turanDensityConst, hε_pos, ↓reduceDIte] using h_verts

name: zarankiewicz_of_fintypeCard_eq
statement:
theorem zarankiewicz_of_fintypeCard_eq
    (hm : card V = m) (hn : card W = n) (hs : card α = s) (ht : card β = t) :
    zarankiewicz m n s t =
      sup { G : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W) | G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W
        ∧ (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G} (#·.edgeFinset)
proof:
:= by
  let e₁ := completeBipartiteGraphCongr
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hm) (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hn)
  let K := completeBipartiteGraph (Fin s) (Fin t)
  let e₂ := completeBipartiteGraphCongr
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hs) (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq ht)
  rw [zarankiewicz, le_antisymm_iff]
  and_intros
  on_goal 1 =>
    let e₁ := e₁.symm
    let K := completeBipartiteGraph α β
    let e₂ := e₂.symm
  all_goals
    simp_rw [Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    intro G ⟨h_le, h_free⟩
    simp_rw [Iso.card_edgeFinset_eq (.map e₁.toEquiv G)]
    have h' : G.map e₁.toEquiv.toEmbedding ∈ univ.filter fun G ↦
        G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph _ _ ∧ K.Free G := by
      rw [mem_filter_univ, map_le_iff_le_comap]
      refine ⟨fun _ _ hadj ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
      · replace h_le := h_le hadj
        rw [← Embedding.map_adj_iff e₁.toEmbedding, ← comap_adj] at h_le
        exact h_le
      · rw [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, ← free_congr e₂ (.map e₁.toEquiv G)]
        exact h_free
    have h_le_sup := @le_sup _ _ _ _ _ (#·.edgeFinset) (G.map e₁.toEquiv.toEmbedding) h'
    simp_rw [← card_coe, mem_edgeFinset] at h_le_sup ⊢
    exact h_le_sup

name: zarankiewicz_le_iff
statement:
theorem zarankiewicz_le_iff
    (hm : card V = m) (hn : card W = n) (hs : card α = s) (ht : card β = t) (x : ℕ) :
    zarankiewicz m n s t ≤ x ↔
      ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W)⦄ [DecidableRel G.Adj], G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W →
        (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G → #G.edgeFinset ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [zarankiewicz_of_fintypeCard_eq hm hn hs ht,
    Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨fun h _ _ h_le h_free ↦ (h _ ⟨h_le, h_free⟩).trans_eq' <| by convert rfl,
    fun h _ ⟨h_le, h_free⟩ ↦ by convert h h_le h_free⟩

name: lt_zarankiewicz_iff
statement:
theorem lt_zarankiewicz_iff
    (hm : card V = m) (hn : card W = n) (hs : card α = s) (ht : card β = t) (x : ℕ) :
    x < zarankiewicz m n s t ↔
      ∃ G : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W), ∃ _ : DecidableRel G.Adj, G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W ∧
        (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G ∧  x < #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [zarankiewicz_of_fintypeCard_eq hm hn hs ht,
    Finset.lt_sup_iff, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨h_le, h_free⟩, h_lt⟩ ↦ ⟨_, _, h_le, h_free, by convert h_lt⟩,
    fun ⟨_, _, ⟨h_le, h_free, h_lt⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨_, ⟨h_le, h_free⟩, h_lt.trans_eq <| by convert rfl⟩⟩

name: zarankiewicz_le_iff_of_nonneg
statement:
@[inherit_doc zarankiewicz_le_iff]
theorem zarankiewicz_le_iff_of_nonneg
    (hm : card V = m) (hn : card W = n) (hs : card α = s) (ht : card β = t) {x : R} (h : 0 ≤ x) :
    zarankiewicz m n s t ≤ x ↔
      ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W)⦄ [DecidableRel G.Adj], G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W →
        (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G → #G.edgeFinset ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Nat.le_floor_iff h]
  exact zarankiewicz_le_iff hm hn hs ht ⌊x⌋₊

name: lt_zarankiewicz_iff_of_nonneg
statement:
@[inherit_doc lt_zarankiewicz_iff]
theorem lt_zarankiewicz_iff_of_nonneg
    (hm : card V = m) (hn : card W = n) (hs : card α = s) (ht : card β = t) {x : R} (h : 0 ≤ x) :
    x < zarankiewicz m n s t ↔
      ∃ G : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W), ∃ _ : DecidableRel G.Adj, G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W ∧
        (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G ∧  x < #G.edgeFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Nat.floor_lt h]
  exact lt_zarankiewicz_iff hm hn hs ht ⌊x⌋₊

name: zarankiewicz_le_extremalNumber
statement:
theorem zarankiewicz_le_extremalNumber (hs : card α = s) (ht : card β = t) :
    zarankiewicz m n s t ≤ extremalNumber (m + n) (completeBipartiteGraph α β)
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    enter [2, 1]
    rw [← Fintype.card_fin (m + n)]
  simp_rw [zarankiewicz, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  intro B ⟨_, h⟩
  rw [(Iso.map finSumFinEquiv B).card_edgeFinset_eq]
  refine card_edgeFinset_le_extremalNumber <|
    (h.congr_left ?_).congr_right (Iso.map finSumFinEquiv B).symm
  exact completeBipartiteGraphCongr
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hs) (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq ht)

name: two_mul_extremalNumber_le_zarankiewicz_symm
statement:
theorem two_mul_extremalNumber_le_zarankiewicz_symm
    [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β] (hs : card α = s) (ht : card β = t) :
    2 * extremalNumber n (completeBipartiteGraph α β) ≤ zarankiewicz n n s t
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    enter [1, 2, 1]
    rw [← Fintype.card_fin n]
  rify
  rw [← le_div_iff₀' (by positivity), extremalNumber_le_iff_of_nonneg _ (by positivity)]
  intro G _ h
  rw [le_div_iff₀' (by positivity), ← Nat.cast_two, ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_le]
  apply Finset.le_sup_of_le (b := G.bipartiteDoubleCover)
  · simp_rw [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    refine ⟨bipartiteDoubleCover_le, ?_⟩
    contrapose! h
    refine completeBipartiteGraph_isContained_bipartiteDoubleCover.mp <|
      h.trans' ⟨Iso.toCopy ?_⟩
    exact completeBipartiteGraphCongr
      (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hs) (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq ht)
  · convert card_edgeFinset_bipartiteDoubleCover.symm.le

:= by
  rw [← eRk_inter_ground, inter_eq_self_of_subset_right subset_union_right, eRank_def]

name: eRk_ground_union
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_ground_union (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : M.eRk (M.E ∪ X) = M.eRank

name: eRk_insert_of_notMem_ground
statement: lemma eRk_insert_of_notMem_ground (X : Set α) (he : e ∉ M.E) : M.eRk (insert e X) = M.eRk X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eRk_inter_ground, insert_inter_of_notMem he, eRk_inter_ground]

name: eRk_eq_eRank
statement: lemma eRk_eq_eRank (hX : M.E ⊆ X) : M.eRk X = M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eRk_inter_ground, inter_eq_self_of_subset_right hX, eRank_def]

name: eRk_compl_union_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma eRk_compl_union_of_disjoint (M : Matroid α) (hXY : Disjoint X Y) :
    M.eRk (M.E \ X ∪ Y) = M.eRk (M.E \ X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eRk_inter_ground, union_inter_distrib_right, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left sdiff_subset,
    union_eq_self_of_subset_right
      (subset_sdiff.2 ⟨inter_subset_right, hXY.symm.mono_left inter_subset_left⟩)]

name: one_le_eRank
statement: lemma one_le_eRank (M : Matroid α) [RankPos M] : 1 ≤ M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBase
  rw [← hB.encard_eq_eRank, one_le_encard_iff_nonempty]
  exact hB.nonempty

name: eRk_univ_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_univ_eq (M : Matroid α) : M.eRk univ = M.eRank

name: eRk_empty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_empty (M : Matroid α) : M.eRk ∅ = 0

name: eRk_closure_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_closure_eq (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : M.eRk (M.closure X) = M.eRk X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  rw [← hI.closure_eq_closure, ← hI.indep.isBasis_closure.encard_eq_eRk, hI.encard_eq_eRk]

name: eRk_union_closure_right_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_union_closure_right_eq (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (X ∪ M.closure Y) = M.eRk (X ∪ Y)

name: eRk_union_closure_left_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_union_closure_left_eq (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (M.closure X ∪ Y) = M.eRk (X ∪ Y)

name: eRk_insert_closure_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_insert_closure_eq (M : Matroid α) (e : α) (X : Set α) :
    M.eRk (insert e (M.closure X)) = M.eRk (insert e X)

name: restrict_eRk_eq'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_eRk_eq' (M : Matroid α) (R X : Set α) : (M ↾ R).eRk X = M.eRk (X ∩ R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := (M ↾ R).exists_isBasis' X
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard]
  rw [isBasis'_iff_isBasis_inter_ground, isBasis_restrict_iff', restrict_ground_eq] at hI
  rw [← eRk_inter_ground, ← hI.1.eRk_eq_encard]

name: restrict_eRk_eq
statement: lemma restrict_eRk_eq (M : Matroid α) {R : Set α} (h : X ⊆ R) : (M ↾ R).eRk X = M.eRk X

name: IsBasis'.eRk_eq_eRk_union
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.eRk_eq_eRk_union (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) (Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (I ∪ Y) = M.eRk (X ∪ Y)

name: IsBasis'.eRk_eq_eRk_insert
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.eRk_eq_eRk_insert (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) (e : α) :
    M.eRk (insert e I) = M.eRk (insert e X)

name: IsBasis.eRk_eq_eRk_union
statement: lemma IsBasis.eRk_eq_eRk_union (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (Y : Set α) : M.eRk (I ∪ Y) = M.eRk (X ∪ Y)

name: IsBasis.eRk_eq_eRk_insert
statement:
lemma IsBasis.eRk_eq_eRk_insert (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (e : α) :
    M.eRk (insert e I) = M.eRk (insert e X)

name: eRk_le_encard
statement: lemma eRk_le_encard (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : M.eRk X ≤ X.encard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard]
  exact encard_mono hI.subset

name: eRank_le_encard_ground
statement: lemma eRank_le_encard_ground (M : Matroid α) : M.eRank ≤ M.E.encard

name: eRk_mono
statement: lemma eRk_mono (M : Matroid α) : Monotone M.eRk
proof:
:= by
  rintro X Y (hXY : X ⊆ Y)
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hIJ⟩ := hI.indep.subset_isBasis'_of_subset (hI.subset.trans hXY)
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, hJ.eRk_eq_encard]
  exact encard_mono hIJ

name: eRk_le_eRank
statement: lemma eRk_le_eRank (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : M.eRk X ≤ M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [eRank_def, ← eRk_inter_ground]; exact M.eRk_mono inter_subset_right

name: eRk_eq_eRk_of_subset_of_le
statement: lemma eRk_eq_eRk_of_subset_of_le (hXY : X ⊆ Y) (hYX : M.eRk Y ≤ M.eRk X) : M.eRk X = M.eRk Y

name: le_eRk_iff
statement: lemma le_eRk_iff : n ≤ M.eRk X ↔ ∃ I, I ⊆ X ∧ M.Indep I ∧ I.encard = n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨I, hIX, hI, hIc⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
    rw [← hJ.encard_eq_eRk] at h
    obtain ⟨I, hIJ, rfl⟩ := exists_subset_encard_eq h
    exact ⟨_, hIJ.trans hJ.subset, hJ.indep.subset hIJ, rfl⟩
  rw [← hIc, ← hI.eRk_eq_encard]
  exact M.eRk_mono hIX

name: eRk_le_iff
statement: lemma eRk_le_iff : M.eRk X ≤ n ↔ ∀ ⦃I⦄, I ⊆ X → M.Indep I → I.encard ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h I hIX hI ↦ (hI.eRk_eq_encard.symm.trans_le ((M.eRk_mono hIX).trans h)), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  rw [← hI.encard_eq_eRk]
  exact h hI.subset hI.indep

name: Indep.encard_le_eRk_of_subset
statement: lemma Indep.encard_le_eRk_of_subset (hI : M.Indep I) (hIX : I ⊆ X) : I.encard ≤ M.eRk X

name: Indep.encard_le_eRank
statement: lemma Indep.encard_le_eRank (hI : M.Indep I) : I.encard ≤ M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hI.eRk_eq_encard, eRank_def]
  exact M.eRk_mono hI.subset_ground

name: eRk_eq_zero_iff'
statement: lemma eRk_eq_zero_iff' : M.eRk X = 0 ↔ X ∩ M.E ⊆ M.loops
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis (X ∩ M.E)
  rw [← eRk_inter_ground, ← hI.encard_eq_eRk, encard_eq_zero]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa [h] using! hI, fun h ↦ eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun e heI ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (hI.indep.isNonloop_of_mem heI).not_isLoop (h (hI.subset heI))

name: eRk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_eq_zero_iff (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) : M.eRk X = 0 ↔ X ⊆ M.loops

name: eRk_loops
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_loops : M.eRk M.loops = 0

name: eRk_inter_add_eRk_union_le
statement:
lemma eRk_inter_add_eRk_union_le (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (X ∩ Y) + M.eRk (X ∪ Y) ≤ M.eRk X + M.eRk Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ii, hIi⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' (X ∩ Y)
  obtain ⟨IX, hIX, hIX'⟩ :=
    hIi.indep.subset_isBasis'_of_subset (hIi.subset.trans inter_subset_left)
  obtain ⟨IY, hIY, hIY'⟩ :=
    hIi.indep.subset_isBasis'_of_subset (hIi.subset.trans inter_subset_right)
  rw [← hIX.eRk_eq_eRk_union, union_comm, ← hIY.eRk_eq_eRk_union, ← hIi.encard_eq_eRk,
    ← hIX.encard_eq_eRk, ← hIY.encard_eq_eRk, union_comm, ← encard_union_add_encard_inter, add_comm]
  exact add_le_add (eRk_le_encard _ _) (encard_mono (subset_inter hIX' hIY'))

name: eRk_insert_inter_add_eRk_insert_union_le
statement:
lemma eRk_insert_inter_add_eRk_insert_union_le (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (insert e (X ∩ Y)) + M.eRk (insert e (X ∪ Y))
      ≤ M.eRk (insert e X) + M.eRk (insert e Y)

name: eRk_compl_union_add_eRk_compl_inter_le
statement:
lemma eRk_compl_union_add_eRk_compl_inter_le (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (M.E \ (X ∪ Y)) + M.eRk (M.E \ (X ∩ Y)) ≤ M.eRk (M.E \ X) + M.eRk (M.E \ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_inter_sdiff, sdiff_inter]
  apply M.eRk_submod

name: eRk_compl_insert_union_add_eRk_compl_insert_inter_le
statement:
lemma eRk_compl_insert_union_add_eRk_compl_insert_inter_le (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (M.E \ insert e (X ∪ Y)) + M.eRk (M.E \ insert e (X ∩ Y)) ≤
      M.eRk (M.E \ insert e X) + M.eRk (M.E \ insert e Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [insert_union_distrib, insert_inter_distrib]
  exact M.eRk_compl_union_add_eRk_compl_inter_le (insert e X) (insert e Y)

name: eRk_union_le_eRk_add_eRk
statement: lemma eRk_union_le_eRk_add_eRk (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) : M.eRk (X ∪ Y) ≤ M.eRk X + M.eRk Y

name: eRk_eq_eRk_union_eRk_le_zero
statement: lemma eRk_eq_eRk_union_eRk_le_zero (X : Set α) (hY : M.eRk Y ≤ 0) : M.eRk (X ∪ Y) = M.eRk X

name: eRk_eq_eRk_sdiff_eRk_le_zero
statement: lemma eRk_eq_eRk_sdiff_eRk_le_zero (X : Set α) (hY : M.eRk Y ≤ 0) : M.eRk (X \ Y) = M.eRk X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eRk_eq_eRk_union_eRk_le_zero (X \ Y) hY, sdiff_union_self,
    eRk_eq_eRk_union_eRk_le_zero _ hY]

name: eRk_le_eRk_inter_add_eRk_sdiff
statement:
lemma eRk_le_eRk_inter_add_eRk_sdiff (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk X ≤ M.eRk (X ∩ Y) + M.eRk (X \ Y)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← inter_union_sdiff X Y]; apply eRk_union_le_eRk_add_eRk

name: eRk_le_eRk_add_eRk_sdiff
statement:
lemma eRk_le_eRk_add_eRk_sdiff (M : Matroid α) (h : Y ⊆ X) :
    M.eRk X ≤ M.eRk Y + M.eRk (X \ Y)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← union_sdiff_cancel h]; apply eRk_union_le_eRk_add_eRk

name: eRk_union_le_encard_add_eRk
statement:
lemma eRk_union_le_encard_add_eRk (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (X ∪ Y) ≤ X.encard + M.eRk Y

name: eRk_union_le_eRk_add_encard
statement:
lemma eRk_union_le_eRk_add_encard (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) :
    M.eRk (X ∪ Y) ≤ M.eRk X + Y.encard

name: eRank_le_encard_add_eRk_compl
statement:
lemma eRank_le_encard_add_eRk_compl (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) :
    M.eRank ≤ X.encard + M.eRk (M.E \ X)
proof:
:=
  le_trans (by rw [← eRk_inter_ground, eRank_def, union_sdiff_self,
    union_inter_cancel_right]) (M.eRk_union_le_encard_add_eRk X (M.E \ X))

name: eRank_ne_top_iff
statement: lemma eRank_ne_top_iff (M : Matroid α) : M.eRank ≠ ⊤ ↔ M.RankFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBase
  rw [← hB.encard_eq_eRank, encard_ne_top_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ hB.rankFinite_of_finite h, fun h ↦ hB.finite⟩

name: eRank_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_eq_top_iff (M : Matroid α) : M.eRank = ⊤ ↔ M.RankInfinite

name: eRank_lt_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_lt_top_iff : M.eRank < ⊤ ↔ M.RankFinite

name: eRank_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_eq_top [RankInfinite M] : M.eRank = ⊤

name: eRk_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_eq_top_iff : M.eRk X = ⊤ ↔ ¬ M.IsRkFinite X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, encard_eq_top_iff, ← hI.finite_iff_isRkFinite, Set.Infinite]

name: eRk_ne_top_iff
statement: lemma eRk_ne_top_iff : M.eRk X ≠ ⊤ ↔ M.IsRkFinite X

name: eRk_lt_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_lt_top_iff : M.eRk X < ⊤ ↔ M.IsRkFinite X

name: IsRkFinite.eRk_lt_top
statement: lemma IsRkFinite.eRk_lt_top (h : M.IsRkFinite X) : M.eRk X < ⊤

name: IsRkFinite.isBasis_of_subset_closure_of_subset_of_encard_le
statement:
lemma IsRkFinite.isBasis_of_subset_closure_of_subset_of_encard_le (hX : M.IsRkFinite X)
    (hXI : X ⊆ M.closure I) (hIX : I ⊆ X) (hI : I.encard ≤ M.eRk X) : M.IsBasis I X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := M.exists_isBasis (I ∩ M.E)
  have hIJ := hJ.subset.trans inter_subset_left
  rw [← closure_inter_ground] at hXI
  replace hXI := hXI.trans <| M.closure_subset_closure_of_subset_closure hJ.subset_closure
  have hJX := hJ.indep.isBasis_of_subset_of_subset_closure (hIJ.trans hIX) hXI
  rw [← hJX.encard_eq_eRk] at hI
  rwa [← Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le (hX.finite_of_isBasis hJX) hIJ hI]

name: IsRkFinite.closure_eq_closure_of_subset_of_eRk_ge_eRk
statement:
lemma IsRkFinite.closure_eq_closure_of_subset_of_eRk_ge_eRk (hX : M.IsRkFinite X) (hXY : X ⊆ Y)
    (hr : M.eRk Y ≤ M.eRk X) : M.closure X = M.closure Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hIJ⟩ := hI.indep.subset_isBasis'_of_subset (hI.subset.trans hXY)
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, hJ.eRk_eq_encard] at hr
  rw [← closure_inter_ground, ← M.closure_inter_ground Y,
    ← hI.isBasis_inter_ground.closure_eq_closure,
    ← hJ.isBasis_inter_ground.closure_eq_closure, Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le
      (hI.indep.finite_of_subset_isRkFinite hI.subset hX) hIJ hr]

name: eRk_insert_le_add_one
statement:
lemma eRk_insert_le_add_one (M : Matroid α) (e : α) (X : Set α) :
    M.eRk (insert e X) ≤ M.eRk X + 1

name: eRk_insert_eq_add_one
statement: lemma eRk_insert_eq_add_one (he : e ∈ M.E \ M.closure X) : M.eRk (insert e X) = M.eRk X + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  rw [← hI.closure_eq_closure, mem_sdiff, hI.indep.mem_closure_iff', not_and] at he
  rw [← eRk_closure_eq, ← closure_insert_congr_right hI.closure_eq_closure, hI.eRk_eq_encard,
    eRk_closure_eq, Indep.eRk_eq_encard (by tauto), encard_insert_of_notMem (by tauto)]

name: exists_eRk_insert_eq_add_one_of_lt
statement:
lemma exists_eRk_insert_eq_add_one_of_lt (h : M.eRk X < M.eRk Y) :
    ∃ y ∈ Y \ X, M.eRk (insert y X) = M.eRk X + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ¬ Y ∩ M.E ⊆ M.closure X := by
    contrapose! h
    simpa using M.eRk_mono h
  obtain ⟨e, ⟨heZ, heE⟩, heX⟩ := not_subset.1 hz
  refine ⟨e, ⟨heZ, fun heX' ↦ heX (mem_closure_of_mem' _ heX')⟩, eRk_insert_eq_add_one ⟨heE, heX⟩⟩

name: IsRkFinite.closure_eq_closure_of_subset_of_forall_insert
statement:
lemma IsRkFinite.closure_eq_closure_of_subset_of_forall_insert (hX : M.IsRkFinite X) (hXY : X ⊆ Y)
    (hY : ∀ e ∈ Y \ X, M.eRk (Insert.insert e X) ≤ M.eRk X) : M.closure X = M.closure Y
proof:
:= by
  refine hX.closure_eq_closure_of_subset_of_eRk_ge_eRk hXY <| not_lt.1 fun hlt ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hr⟩ := exists_eRk_insert_eq_add_one_of_lt hlt
  simpa [hr, ENat.add_one_le_iff hX.eRk_lt_top.ne] using hY z hz

name: eRk_eq_of_eRk_insert_le_forall
statement:
lemma eRk_eq_of_eRk_insert_le_forall (hXY : X ⊆ Y)
    (hY : ∀ e ∈ Y \ X, M.eRk (insert e X) ≤ M.eRk X) : M.eRk X = M.eRk Y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hX : M.IsRkFinite X
  · rw [← eRk_closure_eq, hX.closure_eq_closure_of_subset_of_forall_insert hXY hY, eRk_closure_eq]
  rw [eRk_eq_top_iff.2 hX, eRk_eq_top_iff.2 (mt (fun h ↦ h.subset hXY) hX)]

name: indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite
statement: lemma indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite (hI : I.Finite) : M.Indep I ↔ M.eRk I = I.encard
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [h.eRk_eq_encard], fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' I
  rw [← hI.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le' hJ.subset]
  · exact hJ.indep
  rw [← h, ← hJ.eRk_eq_encard]

name: indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard
statement: lemma indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard [M.RankFinite] : M.Indep I ↔ M.eRk I = I.encard
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Indep.eRk_eq_encard, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain hfin | hinf := I.finite_or_infinite
  · rwa [indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite hfin]
  rw [hinf.encard_eq] at h
  exact False.elim <| (M.isRkFinite_set I).eRk_lt_top.ne h

name: IsRkFinite.indep_of_encard_le_eRk
statement:
lemma IsRkFinite.indep_of_encard_le_eRk (hX : M.IsRkFinite I) (h : encard I ≤ M.eRk I) :
    M.Indep I
proof:
:= by
  rw [indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite _]
  · exact (M.eRk_le_encard I).antisymm h
  simpa using h.trans_lt hX.eRk_lt_top

name: eRk_lt_encard_of_dep_of_finite
statement: lemma eRk_lt_encard_of_dep_of_finite (h : X.Finite) (hX : M.Dep X) : M.eRk X < X.encard
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (M.eRk_le_encard X) fun h' ↦
    ((indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite h).mpr h').not_dep hX

name: eRk_lt_encard_iff_dep_of_finite
statement:
lemma eRk_lt_encard_iff_dep_of_finite (hX : X.Finite) (hXE : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M.eRk X < X.encard ↔ M.Dep X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ eRk_lt_encard_of_dep_of_finite hX h⟩
  rw [← not_indep_iff, indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite hX]
  exact h.ne

name: Dep.eRk_lt_encard
statement: lemma Dep.eRk_lt_encard [M.RankFinite] (hX : M.Dep X) : M.eRk X < X.encard
proof:
:= by
  refine (M.eRk_le_encard X).lt_of_ne ?_
  rw [ne_eq, ← indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard]
  exact hX.not_indep

name: eRk_lt_encard_iff_dep
statement:
lemma eRk_lt_encard_iff_dep [M.RankFinite] (hXE : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M.eRk X < X.encard ↔ M.Dep X
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ (not_indep_iff).1 fun hi ↦ h.ne hi.eRk_eq_encard, Dep.eRk_lt_encard⟩

name: Indep.exists_insert_of_encard_lt
statement:
lemma Indep.exists_insert_of_encard_lt {I J : Set α} (hI : M.Indep I) (hJ : M.Indep J)
    (hcard : I.encard < J.encard) : ∃ e ∈ J \ I, M.Indep (insert e I)

name: isBasis'_iff_indep_encard_eq_of_finite
statement:
lemma isBasis'_iff_indep_encard_eq_of_finite (hIfin : I.Finite) :
    M.IsBasis' I X ↔ I ⊆ X ∧ M.Indep I ∧ I.encard = M.eRk X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.subset,h.indep, h.eRk_eq_encard.symm⟩, fun ⟨hIX, hI, hcard⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hIJ⟩ := hI.subset_isBasis'_of_subset hIX
  rwa [hIfin.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le hIJ (hJ.encard_eq_eRk.trans hcard.symm).le]

name: isBasis_iff_indep_encard_eq_of_finite
statement:
lemma isBasis_iff_indep_encard_eq_of_finite (hIfin : I.Finite) (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M.IsBasis I X ↔ I ⊆ X ∧ M.Indep I ∧ I.encard = M.eRk X

name: Indep.isBasis'_of_eRk_ge
statement:
lemma Indep.isBasis'_of_eRk_ge (hI : M.Indep I) (hIfin : I.Finite) (hIX : I ⊆ X)
    (h : M.eRk X ≤ M.eRk I) : M.IsBasis' I X
proof:
:=
  (isBasis'_iff_indep_encard_eq_of_finite hIfin).2
    ⟨hIX, hI, by rw [h.antisymm (M.eRk_mono hIX), hI.eRk_eq_encard]⟩

name: Indep.isBasis_of_eRk_ge
statement:
lemma Indep.isBasis_of_eRk_ge (hI : M.Indep I) (hIfin : I.Finite) (hIX : I ⊆ X)
    (h : M.eRk X ≤ M.eRk I) (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) : M.IsBasis I X

name: Indep.isBase_of_eRk_ge
statement:
lemma Indep.isBase_of_eRk_ge (hI : M.Indep I) (hIfin : I.Finite) (h : M.eRank ≤ M.eRk I) :
    M.IsBase I
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hI.isBasis_of_eRk_ge hIfin hI.subset_ground (M.eRk_ground.trans_le h)

name: IsCircuit.eRk_add_one_eq
statement: lemma IsCircuit.eRk_add_one_eq {C : Set α} (hC : M.IsCircuit C) : M.eRk C + 1 = C.encard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis C
  obtain ⟨e, ⟨heC, heI⟩, rfl⟩ := hC.isBasis_iff_insert_eq.1 hI
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, encard_insert_of_notMem heI]

name: IsLoop.eRk_eq
statement: lemma IsLoop.eRk_eq (he : M.IsLoop e) : M.eRk {e} = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eRk_closure_eq, he.closure, loops, eRk_closure_eq, eRk_empty]

name: IsNonloop.eRk_eq
statement: lemma IsNonloop.eRk_eq (he : M.IsNonloop e) : M.eRk {e} = 1

name: eRk_singleton_eq
statement:
lemma eRk_singleton_eq [Loopless M] (he : e ∈ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M.eRk {e} = 1

name: eRk_singleton_le
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_singleton_le (M : Matroid α) (e : α) : M.eRk {e} ≤ 1

name: eRk_singleton_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_singleton_eq_one_iff {e : α} : M.eRk {e} = 1 ↔ M.IsNonloop e
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.eRk_eq⟩
  rwa [← indep_singleton, indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite (by simp), encard_singleton]

name: eRk_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma eRk_eq_one_iff (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M.eRk X = 1 ↔ ∃ e ∈ X, M.IsNonloop e ∧ X ⊆ M.closure {e}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨e, heX, he, hXe⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis X
    rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, encard_eq_one]
    rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e, singleton_subset_iff.1 hI.subset, indep_singleton.1 hI.indep, hI.subset_closure⟩
  rw [← he.eRk_eq]
  exact ((M.eRk_mono hXe).trans (M.eRk_closure_eq _).le).antisymm
    (M.eRk_mono (singleton_subset_iff.2 heX))

name: eRk_le_one_iff
statement:
lemma eRk_le_one_iff [M.Nonempty] (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M.eRk X ≤ 1 ↔ ∃ e ∈ M.E, X ⊆ M.closure {e}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨e, _, he⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis X
    rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, encard_le_one_iff_eq] at h
    obtain (rfl | ⟨e, rfl⟩) := h
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := M.ground_nonempty
      exact ⟨e, he, hI.subset_closure.trans ((M.closure_subset_closure (empty_subset _)))⟩
    exact ⟨e, hI.indep.subset_ground rfl,  hI.subset_closure⟩
  refine (M.eRk_mono he).trans ?_
  rw [eRk_closure_eq, ← encard_singleton e]
  exact M.eRk_le_encard {e}

name: Spanning.eRk_eq
statement: lemma Spanning.eRk_eq (hX : M.Spanning X) : M.eRk X = M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBasis X
  exact (M.eRk_le_eRank X).antisymm <| by
    rw [← hB.encard_eq_eRk, ← (hB.isBase_of_spanning hX).encard_eq_eRank]

name: spanning_iff_eRk_le'
statement: lemma spanning_iff_eRk_le' [RankFinite M] : M.Spanning X ↔ M.eRank ≤ M.eRk X ∧ X ⊆ M.E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.eRk_eq.symm.le, h.subset_ground⟩, fun ⟨h, hX⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis X
  exact (hI.indep.isBase_of_eRk_ge
    hI.indep.finite (h.trans hI.eRk_eq_eRk.symm.le)).spanning_of_superset hI.subset

name: spanning_iff_eRk_le
statement:
lemma spanning_iff_eRk_le [RankFinite M] (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M.Spanning X ↔ M.eRank ≤ M.eRk X

name: Spanning.eRank_restrict
statement: lemma Spanning.eRank_restrict (hX : M.Spanning X) : (M ↾ X).eRank = M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [eRank_def, restrict_ground_eq, restrict_eRk_eq _ rfl.subset, hX.eRk_eq]

name: eRank_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_map {β : Type*} {f : α → β} (M : Matroid α) (hf : InjOn f M.E) :
    (M.map f hf).eRank = M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBase
  rw [← (hB.map hf).encard_eq_eRank, ← hB.encard_eq_eRank, (hf.mono hB.subset_ground).encard_image]

name: eRk_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_map {β : Type*} {f : α → β} (M : Matroid α) (hf : InjOn f M.E)
    (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) : (M.map f hf).eRk (f '' X) = M.eRk X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis X
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, (hI.map hf).eRk_eq_encard, (hf.mono hI.indep.subset_ground).encard_image]

name: eRk_comap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_comap {β : Type*} {f : α → β} (M : Matroid β) (X : Set α) :
    (M.comap f).eRk X = M.eRk (f '' X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := (M.comap f).exists_isBasis' X
  obtain ⟨hI', hinj, -⟩ := comap_isBasis'_iff.1 hI
  rw [← hI.encard_eq_eRk, ← hI'.encard_eq_eRk, hinj.encard_image]

name: eRk_loopyOn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRk_loopyOn (X Y : Set α) : (loopyOn Y).eRk X = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := (loopyOn Y).exists_isBasis' X
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, loopyOn_indep_iff.1 hI.indep, encard_empty]

name: eRank_loopyOn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_loopyOn (X : Set α) : (loopyOn X).eRank = 0

name: eRank_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma eRank_eq_zero_iff : M.eRank = 0 ↔ M = loopyOn M.E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ closure_empty_eq_ground_iff.1 ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h, eRank_loopyOn]⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBase
  rw [← hB.encard_eq_eRank, encard_eq_zero] at h
  rw [← h, hB.closure_eq]

name: exists_of_eRank_eq_zero
statement: lemma exists_of_eRank_eq_zero (h : M.eRank = 0) : ∃ X, M = loopyOn X

name: eRank_emptyOn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_emptyOn (α : Type*) : (emptyOn α).eRank = 0

name: eq_loopyOn_iff_eRank
statement: lemma eq_loopyOn_iff_eRank : M = loopyOn X ↔ M.eRank = 0 ∧ M.E = X
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [h]; simp, fun ⟨h,h'⟩ ↦ by rw [← h', ← eRank_eq_zero_iff, h]⟩

name: eRank_freeOn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_freeOn (X : Set α) : (freeOn X).eRank = X.encard

name: eRk_freeOn
statement: lemma eRk_freeOn (hXY : X ⊆ Y) : (freeOn Y).eRk X = X.encard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := (freeOn Y).exists_isBasis X
  rw [hI.eRk_eq_encard, (freeOn_indep hXY).eq_of_isBasis hI]

name: IsBase.encard_compl_eq
statement: lemma IsBase.encard_compl_eq (hB : M.IsBase B) : (M.E \ B).encard = M✶.eRank

name: eRk_dual_add_eRank
statement:
lemma eRk_dual_add_eRank (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    M✶.eRk X + M.eRank = M.eRk (M.E \ X) + X.encard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M✶.exists_isBasis X
  obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := hI.exists_isBasis_inter_eq_of_superset hX
  have hB' : M✶.IsBase B := isBasis_ground_iff.1 hB
  have hd : M.IsBasis (M.E \ B ∩ (M.E \ X)) (M.E \ X) := by
    simpa using hB'.inter_isBasis_iff_compl_inter_isBasis_dual.1 hI
  rw [← hB'.compl_isBase_of_dual.encard_eq_eRank, hI.eRk_eq_encard, hd.eRk_eq_encard,
    ← encard_union_eq (by tauto_set), ← encard_union_eq (by tauto_set)]
  exact congr_arg _ (by tauto_set)

name: eRk_dual_add_eRank'
statement:
lemma eRk_dual_add_eRank' (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) :
    M✶.eRk X + M.eRank = M.eRk (M.E \ X) + (X ∩ M.E).encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_inter_self_eq_sdiff, ← eRk_dual_add_eRank .., ← dual_ground, eRk_inter_ground]

name: eRank_add_eRank_dual
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eRank_add_eRank_dual (M : Matroid α) : M.eRank + M✶.eRank = M.E.encard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBase
  rw [← hB.encard_eq_eRank, ← hB.compl_isBase_dual.encard_eq_eRank,
    ← encard_union_eq disjoint_sdiff_right, union_sdiff_cancel hB.subset_ground]

name: IsBase.cardinalMk_le_cRank
statement: theorem IsBase.cardinalMk_le_cRank (hB : M.IsBase B) : #B ≤ M.cRank
proof:
:=
  le_ciSup (f := fun B : {B // M.IsBase B} ↦ #B.1) bddAbove_of_small ⟨B, hB⟩

name: Indep.cardinalMk_le_cRank
statement: theorem Indep.cardinalMk_le_cRank (ind : M.Indep I) : #I ≤ M.cRank
proof:
:=
  have ⟨B, isBase, hIB⟩ := ind.exists_isBase_superset
  le_ciSup_of_le bddAbove_of_small ⟨B, isBase⟩ (mk_le_mk_of_subset hIB)

name: cRank_eq_iSup_cardinalMk_indep
statement: theorem cRank_eq_iSup_cardinalMk_indep : M.cRank = ⨆ I : {I // M.Indep I}, #I
proof:
:=
  (ciSup_le' fun B ↦ le_ciSup_of_le bddAbove_of_small ⟨B, B.2.indep⟩ <| by rfl).antisymm <|
    ciSup_le' fun I ↦
      have ⟨B, isBase, hIB⟩ := I.2.exists_isBase_superset
      le_ciSup_of_le bddAbove_of_small ⟨B, isBase⟩ (mk_le_mk_of_subset hIB)

name: IsBasis'.cardinalMk_le_cRk
statement: theorem IsBasis'.cardinalMk_le_cRk (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) : #I ≤ M.cRk X

name: IsBasis.cardinalMk_le_cRk
statement: theorem IsBasis.cardinalMk_le_cRk (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) : #I ≤ M.cRk X

name: cRank_le_iff
statement: theorem cRank_le_iff : M.cRank ≤ κ ↔ ∀ ⦃B⦄, M.IsBase B → #B ≤ κ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hB ↦ (hB.cardinalMk_le_cRank.trans h), fun h ↦ ciSup_le fun ⟨_, hB⟩ ↦ h hB⟩

name: cRk_le_iff
statement: theorem cRk_le_iff : M.cRk X ≤ κ ↔ ∀ ⦃I⦄, M.IsBasis' I X → #I ≤ κ

name: Indep.cardinalMk_le_cRk_of_subset
statement: theorem Indep.cardinalMk_le_cRk_of_subset (hI : M.Indep I) (hIX : I ⊆ X) : #I ≤ M.cRk X
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hJ, hIJ⟩ := hI.subset_isBasis'_of_subset hIX
  (mk_le_mk_of_subset hIJ).trans hJ.cardinalMk_le_cRk

name: cRk_le_cardinalMk
statement: theorem cRk_le_cardinalMk (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : M.cRk X ≤ #X

name: cRk_ground
statement: @[simp] theorem cRk_ground (M : Matroid α) : M.cRk M.E = M.cRank

name: cRank_restrict
statement: @[simp] theorem cRank_restrict (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : (M ↾ X).cRank = M.cRk X

name: cRk_mono
statement: theorem cRk_mono (M : Matroid α) : Monotone M.cRk
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Monotone, cRk_le_iff]
  intro X Y hXY I hIX
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hIJ⟩ := hIX.indep.subset_isBasis'_of_subset (hIX.subset.trans hXY)
  exact (mk_le_mk_of_subset hIJ).trans hJ.cardinalMk_le_cRk

name: cRk_le_of_subset
statement: theorem cRk_le_of_subset (M : Matroid α) (hXY : X ⊆ Y) : M.cRk X ≤ M.cRk Y

name: cRk_inter_ground
statement: @[simp] theorem cRk_inter_ground (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : M.cRk (X ∩ M.E) = M.cRk X

name: cRk_restrict_subset
statement: theorem cRk_restrict_subset (M : Matroid α) (hYX : Y ⊆ X) : (M ↾ X).cRk Y = M.cRk Y
proof:
:= by
  have aux : ∀ ⦃I⦄, M.IsBasis' I Y ↔ (M ↾ X).IsBasis' I Y := by
    simp_rw [isBasis'_restrict_iff, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hYX, iff_self_and]
    exact fun I h ↦ h.subset.trans hYX
  simp_rw [le_antisymm_iff, cRk_le_iff]
  exact ⟨fun I hI ↦ (aux.2 hI).cardinalMk_le_cRk, fun I hI ↦ (aux.1 hI).cardinalMk_le_cRk⟩

name: cRk_restrict
statement: theorem cRk_restrict (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) : (M ↾ X).cRk Y = M.cRk (X ∩ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cRk_inter_ground, restrict_ground_eq, cRk_restrict_subset _ inter_subset_right,
    inter_comm]

name: Indep.cRk_eq_cardinalMk
statement: theorem Indep.cRk_eq_cardinalMk (hI : M.Indep I) : #I = M.cRk I

name: cRk_map_image_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem cRk_map_image_lift (M : Matroid α) (hf : InjOn f M.E) (X : Set α)
    (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) : lift.{u, v} ((M.map f hf).cRk (f '' X)) = lift (M.cRk X)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [cRk, cRank, le_antisymm_iff, lift_iSup bddAbove_of_small, cRk, cRank, cRk, cRank]
  nth_rw 2 [lift_iSup bddAbove_of_small]
  simp only [ciSup_le_iff bddAbove_of_small, Subtype.forall, isBase_restrict_iff',
    isBasis'_iff_isBasis hX, isBasis'_iff_isBasis (show f '' X ⊆ (M.map f hf).E from image_mono hX)]
  refine ⟨fun I hI ↦ ?_, fun I hI ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨I, X', hIX, rfl, hXX'⟩ := map_isBasis_iff'.1 hI
    rw [mk_image_eq_of_injOn_lift _ _ (hf.mono hIX.indep.subset_ground), lift_le]
    obtain rfl : X = X' := by rwa [hf.image_eq_image_iff hX hIX.subset_ground] at hXX'
    exact hIX.cardinalMk_le_cRk
  rw [← mk_image_eq_of_injOn_lift _ _ (hf.mono hI.indep.subset_ground), lift_le]
  exact (hI.map hf).cardinalMk_le_cRk

name: cRk_map_image
statement:
@[simp] theorem cRk_map_image {β : Type u} {f : α → β} (M : Matroid α) (hf : InjOn f M.E)
    (X : Set α) (hX : X ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) : (M.map f hf).cRk (f '' X) = M.cRk X

name: cRk_map_eq
statement:
theorem cRk_map_eq {β : Type u} {f : α → β} {X : Set β} (M : Matroid α) (hf : InjOn f M.E) :
    (M.map f hf).cRk X = M.cRk (f ⁻¹' X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← M.cRk_inter_ground, ← M.cRk_map_image hf _, image_preimage_inter, ← map_ground _ _ hf,
    cRk_inter_ground]

name: cRk_comap_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem cRk_comap_lift (M : Matroid β) (f : α → β) (X : Set α) :
    lift.{v, u} ((M.comap f).cRk X) = lift (M.cRk (f '' X))
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [cRk, cRank, le_antisymm_iff, lift_iSup bddAbove_of_small, cRk, cRank, cRk, cRank]
  nth_rw 2 [lift_iSup bddAbove_of_small]
  simp only [ciSup_le_iff bddAbove_of_small, Subtype.forall, isBase_restrict_iff',
    comap_isBasis'_iff, and_imp]
  refine ⟨fun I hI hfI hIX ↦ ?_, fun I hIX ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← mk_image_eq_of_injOn_lift _ _ hfI, lift_le]
    exact hI.cardinalMk_le_cRk
  obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀X, rfl, hfI₀⟩ := show ∃ I₀ ⊆ X, f '' I₀ = I ∧ InjOn f I₀ by
    obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀ss, hbij⟩ := exists_subset_bijOn (f ⁻¹' I ∩ X) f
    refine ⟨I₀, hI₀ss.trans inter_subset_right, ?_, hbij.injOn⟩
    rw [hbij.image_eq, image_preimage_inter, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hIX.subset]
  rw [mk_image_eq_of_injOn_lift _ _ hfI₀, lift_le]
  exact IsBasis'.cardinalMk_le_cRk <| comap_isBasis'_iff.2 ⟨hIX, hfI₀, hI₀X⟩

name: cRk_comap
statement:
@[simp] theorem cRk_comap {β : Type u} (M : Matroid β) (f : α → β) (X : Set α) :
    (M.comap f).cRk X = M.cRk (f '' X)

name: IsBasis.cardinalMk_sdiff_comm
statement:
theorem IsBasis.cardinalMk_sdiff_comm (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (hJX : M.IsBasis J X) :
    #(I \ J : Set α) = #(J \ I : Set α)

name: IsBasis'.cardinalMk_sdiff_comm
statement:
theorem IsBasis'.cardinalMk_sdiff_comm (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) (hJX : M.IsBasis' J X) :
    #(I \ J : Set α) = #(J \ I : Set α)

name: IsBase.cardinalMk_sdiff_comm
statement:
theorem IsBase.cardinalMk_sdiff_comm (hB : M.IsBase B) (hB' : M.IsBase B') :
    #(B \ B' : Set α) = #(B' \ B : Set α)

name: IsBasis.cardinalMk_eq
statement: theorem IsBasis.cardinalMk_eq (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (hJX : M.IsBasis J X) : #I = #J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_union_inter I J,
    mk_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_sdiff_left.mono_right inter_subset_right),
    hIX.cardinalMk_sdiff_comm hJX,
    ← mk_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_sdiff_left.mono_right inter_subset_left),
    inter_comm, sdiff_union_inter]

name: IsBasis'.cardinalMk_eq
statement: theorem IsBasis'.cardinalMk_eq (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) (hJX : M.IsBasis' J X) : #I = #J

name: IsBase.cardinalMk_eq
statement: theorem IsBase.cardinalMk_eq (hB : M.IsBase B) (hB' : M.IsBase B') : #B = #B'

name: Indep.cardinalMk_le_isBase
statement: theorem Indep.cardinalMk_le_isBase (hI : M.Indep I) (hB : M.IsBase B) : #I ≤ #B
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_B', hB', hIB'⟩ := hI.exists_isBase_superset
  hB'.cardinalMk_eq hB ▸ mk_le_mk_of_subset hIB'

name: Indep.cardinalMk_le_isBasis'
statement:
theorem Indep.cardinalMk_le_isBasis' (hI : M.Indep I) (hJ : M.IsBasis' J X) (hIX : I ⊆ X) :
    #I ≤ #J
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_J', hJ', hIJ'⟩ := hI.subset_isBasis'_of_subset hIX
  hJ'.cardinalMk_eq hJ ▸ mk_le_mk_of_subset hIJ'

name: Indep.cardinalMk_le_isBasis
statement:
theorem Indep.cardinalMk_le_isBasis (hI : M.Indep I) (hJ : M.IsBasis J X) (hIX : I ⊆ X) :
    #I ≤ #J

name: IsBase.cardinalMk_eq_cRank
statement: theorem IsBase.cardinalMk_eq_cRank (hB : M.IsBase B) : #B = M.cRank
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : ∀ B' : {B : Set α // M.IsBase B}, #B' = #B := fun B' ↦ B'.2.cardinalMk_eq hB
  simp [cRank, hrw]

name: IsBasis'.cardinalMk_eq_cRk
statement: theorem IsBasis'.cardinalMk_eq_cRk (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) : #I = M.cRk X

name: IsBasis.cardinalMk_eq_cRk
statement: theorem IsBasis.cardinalMk_eq_cRk (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) : #I = M.cRk X

name: cRk_closure
statement:
@[simp] theorem cRk_closure (M : Matroid α) [InvariantCardinalRank M] (X : Set α) :
    M.cRk (M.closure X) = M.cRk X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' X
  rw [← hI.isBasis_closure_right.cardinalMk_eq_cRk, ← hI.cardinalMk_eq_cRk]

name: cRk_closure_congr
statement: theorem cRk_closure_congr (hXY : M.closure X = M.closure Y) : M.cRk X = M.cRk Y

name: Spanning.cRank_le_cardinalMk
statement: theorem Spanning.cRank_le_cardinalMk (h : M.Spanning X) : M.cRank ≤ #X

name: cRk_union_closure_right_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem cRk_union_closure_right_eq : M.cRk (X ∪ M.closure Y) = M.cRk (X ∪ Y)

name: cRk_union_closure_left_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem cRk_union_closure_left_eq : M.cRk (M.closure X ∪ Y) = M.cRk (X ∪ Y)

name: cRk_insert_closure_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem cRk_insert_closure_eq : M.cRk (insert e (M.closure X)) = M.cRk (insert e X)

name: cRk_union_closure_eq
statement: theorem cRk_union_closure_eq : M.cRk (M.closure X ∪ M.closure Y) = M.cRk (X ∪ Y)

name: cRk_inter_add_cRk_union_le
statement: theorem cRk_inter_add_cRk_union_le : M.cRk (X ∩ Y) + M.cRk (X ∪ Y) ≤ M.cRk X + M.cRk Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ii, hIi⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' (X ∩ Y)
  obtain ⟨IX, hIX, hIX'⟩ :=
    hIi.indep.subset_isBasis'_of_subset (hIi.subset.trans inter_subset_left)
  obtain ⟨IY, hIY, hIY'⟩ :=
    hIi.indep.subset_isBasis'_of_subset (hIi.subset.trans inter_subset_right)
  rw [← cRk_union_closure_eq, ← hIX.closure_eq_closure, ← hIY.closure_eq_closure,
    cRk_union_closure_eq, ← hIi.cardinalMk_eq_cRk, ← hIX.cardinalMk_eq_cRk,
    ← hIY.cardinalMk_eq_cRk, ← mk_union_add_mk_inter, add_comm]
  exact add_le_add (M.cRk_le_cardinalMk _) (mk_le_mk_of_subset (subset_inter hIX' hIY'))

name: rankFinite_iff_cRank_lt_aleph0
statement: theorem rankFinite_iff_cRank_lt_aleph0 : M.RankFinite ↔ M.cRank < ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · have ⟨B, hB, fin⟩ := h
    exact hB.cardinalMk_eq_cRank ▸ lt_aleph0_iff_finite.mpr fin
  have ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBase
  simp_rw [← finite_coe_iff, ← lt_aleph0_iff_finite]
  exact ⟨B, hB, hB.cardinalMk_le_cRank.trans_lt h⟩

name: rankInfinite_iff_aleph0_le_cRank
statement: theorem rankInfinite_iff_aleph0_le_cRank : M.RankInfinite ↔ ℵ₀ ≤ M.cRank

name: isRkFinite_iff_cRk_lt_aleph0
statement: theorem isRkFinite_iff_cRk_lt_aleph0 : M.IsRkFinite X ↔ M.cRk X < ℵ₀

name: Indep.isBase_of_cRank_le
statement:
theorem Indep.isBase_of_cRank_le [M.RankFinite] (ind : M.Indep I) (le : M.cRank ≤ #I) :
    M.IsBase I
proof:
:=
  ind.isBase_of_maximal fun _J ind_J hIJ ↦ ind.finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le hIJ <|
    toENat.monotone' <| ind_J.cardinalMk_le_cRank.trans le

name: Spanning.isBase_of_le_cRank
statement:
theorem Spanning.isBase_of_le_cRank [M.RankFinite] (h : M.Spanning X) (le : #X ≤ M.cRank) :
    M.IsBase X
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨B, hB, hBX⟩ := h.exists_isBase_subset
  rwa [← hB.finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le hBX
    (toENat.monotone' <| le.trans hB.cardinalMk_eq_cRank.ge)]

name: Indep.isBase_of_cRank_le_of_finite
statement:
theorem Indep.isBase_of_cRank_le_of_finite (ind : M.Indep I)
    (le : M.cRank ≤ #I) (fin : I.Finite) : M.IsBase I
proof:
:=
  have := rankFinite_iff_cRank_lt_aleph0.mpr (le.trans_lt <| lt_aleph0_iff_finite.mpr fin)
  ind.isBase_of_cRank_le le

name: Spanning.isBase_of_le_cRank_of_finite
statement:
theorem Spanning.isBase_of_le_cRank_of_finite (h : M.Spanning X)
    (le : #X ≤ M.cRank) (fin : X.Finite) : M.IsBase X
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_B, hB, hBX⟩ := h.exists_isBase_subset
  have := hB.rankFinite_of_finite (fin.subset hBX)
  h.isBase_of_le_cRank le

name: toENat_cRank_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toENat_cRank_eq (M : Matroid α) : M.cRank.toENat = M.eRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := M.rankFinite_or_rankInfinite
  · obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := M.exists_isBase
    rw [← hB.cardinalMk_eq_cRank, ← hB.encard_eq_eRank, toENat_cardinalMk]
  simp [rankInfinite_iff_aleph0_le_cRank.1 h]

name: toENat_cRk_eq
statement:

theorem toENat_cRk_eq (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : (M.cRk X).toENat = M.eRk X

@[simp]
lemma contract_delete_isMinor (M : Matroid α) (C D : Set α) : M ／ C ＼ D ≤m M

name: IsMinor.exists_eq_contract_delete_disjoint
statement:
lemma IsMinor.exists_eq_contract_delete_disjoint (h : N ≤m M) :
    ∃ (C D : Set α), C ⊆ M.E ∧ D ⊆ M.E ∧ Disjoint C D ∧ N = M ／ C ＼ D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, D, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨C ∩ M.E, (D ∩ M.E) \ C, inter_subset_right, sdiff_subset.trans inter_subset_right,
    disjoint_sdiff_right.mono_left inter_subset_left,
    by simp [delete_eq_delete_iff, inter_assoc, inter_sdiff_assoc]⟩

name: IsMinor.subset
statement: lemma IsMinor.subset (h : N ≤m M) : N.E ⊆ M.E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, D, rfl⟩ := h
  exact sdiff_subset.trans sdiff_subset

name: IsMinor.refl
statement: lemma IsMinor.refl {M : Matroid α} : M ≤m M

name: IsMinor.trans
statement: lemma IsMinor.trans {M₁ M₂ M₃ : Matroid α} (h : M₁ ≤m M₂) (h' : M₂ ≤m M₃) : M₁ ≤m M₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₁, D₁, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨C₂, D₂, rfl⟩ := h'
  exact ⟨C₂ ∪ C₁ \ D₂, D₂ ∪ D₁, by rw [contract_delete_contract_delete']⟩

name: IsMinor.eq_of_ground_subset
statement: lemma IsMinor.eq_of_ground_subset (h : N ≤m M) (hE : M.E ⊆ N.E) : M = N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, D, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [delete_ground, contract_ground, subset_sdiff, subset_sdiff] at hE
  rw [← contract_inter_ground_eq, hE.1.2.symm.inter_eq, contract_empty, ← delete_inter_ground_eq,
    hE.2.symm.inter_eq, delete_empty]

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.isMinor, h.ssubset⟩, fun ⟨h, hss⟩ ↦ ⟨h, fun h' ↦ hss.ne <| by rw [h'.antisymm h]⟩⟩
