proof:
:= by
  refine ext_indep rfl ?_
  simp only [restrict_ground_eq, restrict_indep_iff, and_congr_left_iff, and_iff_left_iff_imp]

proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isBase_iff_maximal_indep, IsBasis, and_iff_left hX, maximal_iff, restrict_indep_iff]

statement: theorem isBasis'_restrict_iff : (M ↾ R).IsBasis' I X ↔ M.IsBasis' I (X ∩ R) ∧ I ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsBasis', maximal_iff, restrict_indep_iff, subset_inter_iff, and_imp]
  tauto

name: isBasis_restrict_iff'
statement: theorem isBasis_restrict_iff' : (M ↾ R).IsBasis I X ↔ M.IsBasis I (X ∩ M.E) ∧ X ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [isBasis_iff_isBasis'_subset_ground, isBasis'_restrict_iff, restrict_ground_eq,
    and_congr_left_iff, ← isBasis'_iff_isBasis_inter_ground]
  intro hXR
  rw [inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hXR, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  exact fun h ↦ h.subset.trans hXR

name: isBasis_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem isBasis_restrict_iff (hR : R ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    (M ↾ R).IsBasis I X ↔ M.IsBasis I X ∧ X ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [isBasis_restrict_iff', and_congr_left_iff]
  intro hXR
  rw [← isBasis'_iff_isBasis_inter_ground, isBasis'_iff_isBasis]

statement: lemma isBasis'_iff_isBasis_restrict_univ : M.IsBasis' I X ↔ (M ↾ univ).IsBasis I X

name: restrict_eq_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem restrict_eq_restrict_iff (M M' : Matroid α) (X : Set α) :
    M ↾ X = M' ↾ X ↔ ∀ I, I ⊆ X → (M.Indep I ↔ M'.Indep I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h I hIX ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ext_indep rfl fun I (hI : I ⊆ X) ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← and_iff_left (a := (M.Indep I)) hIX, ← and_iff_left (a := (M'.Indep I)) hIX,
      ← restrict_indep_iff, h, restrict_indep_iff]
  rw [restrict_indep_iff, and_iff_left hI, restrict_indep_iff, and_iff_left hI, h _ hI]

name: restrict_eq_self_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem restrict_eq_self_iff : M ↾ R = M ↔ R = M.E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [← h]; rfl, fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩

statement: theorem isRestriction_iff_exists : (N ≤r M) ↔ ∃ R, R ⊆ M.E ∧ N = M ↾ R
proof:
:= by
  use IsRestriction.exists_eq_restrict; rintro ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩; exact restrict_isRestriction M R hR

:= by

name: IsStrictRestriction.ssubset
statement: theorem IsStrictRestriction.ssubset (h : N <r M) : N.E ⊂ M.E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, -, rfl⟩ := h.1
  refine h.isRestriction.subset.ssubset_of_ne (fun h' ↦ h.2 ⟨R, Subset.rfl, ?_⟩)
  rw [show R = M.E from h', restrict_idem, restrict_ground_eq_self]

name: IsStrictRestriction.eq_restrict
statement: theorem IsStrictRestriction.eq_restrict (h : N <r M) : M ↾ N.E = N

name: IsStrictRestriction.exists_eq_restrict
statement: theorem IsStrictRestriction.exists_eq_restrict (h : N <r M) : ∃ R, R ⊂ M.E ∧ N = M ↾ R

name: IsRestriction.isStrictRestriction_of_ne
statement: theorem IsRestriction.isStrictRestriction_of_ne (h : N ≤r M) (hne : N ≠ M) : N <r M

name: IsRestriction.eq_or_isStrictRestriction
statement: theorem IsRestriction.eq_or_isStrictRestriction (h : N ≤r M) : N = M ∨ N <r M

name: restrict_isStrictRestriction
statement: theorem restrict_isStrictRestriction {M : Matroid α} (hR : R ⊂ M.E) : M ↾ R <r M
proof:
:= by
  refine (M.restrict_isRestriction R hR.subset).isStrictRestriction_of_ne (fun h ↦ ?_)
  rw [← h, restrict_ground_eq] at hR
  exact hR.ne rfl

name: IsRestriction.isStrictRestriction_of_ground_ne
statement: theorem IsRestriction.isStrictRestriction_of_ground_ne (h : N ≤r M) (hne : N.E ≠ M.E) : N <r M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.eq_restrict]
  exact restrict_isStrictRestriction (h.subset.ssubset_of_ne hne)

name: IsStrictRestriction.of_ssubset
statement:
theorem IsStrictRestriction.of_ssubset {R' : Set α} (M : Matroid α) (h : R ⊂ R') :
    (M ↾ R) <r (M ↾ R')

name: IsRestriction.finite
statement: theorem IsRestriction.finite {M : Matroid α} [M.Finite] (h : N ≤r M) : N.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩ := h
  exact restrict_finite <| M.ground_finite.subset hR

name: IsRestriction.rankFinite
statement: theorem IsRestriction.rankFinite {M : Matroid α} [RankFinite M] (h : N ≤r M) : N.RankFinite

name: IsRestriction.finitary
statement: theorem IsRestriction.finitary {M : Matroid α} [Finitary M] (h : N ≤r M) : N.Finitary

name: finite_setOfPred_isRestriction
statement: theorem finite_setOfPred_isRestriction (M : Matroid α) [M.Finite] : {N | N ≤r M}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (M.ground_finite.finite_subsets.image (fun R ↦ M ↾ R)).subset <|
    by rintro _ ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, hR, rfl⟩

name: Indep.of_isRestriction
statement: theorem Indep.of_isRestriction (hI : N.Indep I) (hNM : N ≤r M) : M.Indep I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, -, rfl⟩ := hNM; exact hI.of_restrict

name: Indep.indep_isRestriction
statement: theorem Indep.indep_isRestriction (hI : M.Indep I) (hNM : N ≤r M) (hIN : I ⊆ N.E) : N.Indep I

name: IsRestriction.indep_iff
statement: theorem IsRestriction.indep_iff (hMN : N ≤r M) : N.Indep I ↔ M.Indep I ∧ I ⊆ N.E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.of_isRestriction hMN, h.subset_ground⟩, fun h ↦ h.1.indep_isRestriction hMN h.2⟩

name: IsBasis.isBasis_isRestriction
statement:
theorem IsBasis.isBasis_isRestriction (hI : M.IsBasis I X) (hNM : N ≤r M) (hX : X ⊆ N.E) :
    N.IsBasis I X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩ := hNM; rwa [isBasis_restrict_iff, and_iff_left (show X ⊆ R from hX)]

name: IsBasis.of_isRestriction
statement: theorem IsBasis.of_isRestriction (hI : N.IsBasis I X) (hNM : N ≤r M) : M.IsBasis I X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩ := hNM; exact ((isBasis_restrict_iff hR).1 hI).1

name: IsBase.isBasis_of_isRestriction
statement: theorem IsBase.isBasis_of_isRestriction (hI : N.IsBase I) (hNM : N ≤r M) : M.IsBasis I N.E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩ := hNM; rwa [isBase_restrict_iff] at hI

name: IsRestriction.base_iff
statement: theorem IsRestriction.base_iff (hMN : N ≤r M) {B : Set α} : N.IsBase B ↔ M.IsBasis B N.E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ IsBase.isBasis_of_isRestriction h hMN,
    fun h ↦ by simpa [hMN.eq_restrict] using h.restrict_isBase⟩

name: IsRestriction.isBasis_iff
statement: theorem IsRestriction.isBasis_iff (hMN : N ≤r M) : N.IsBasis I X ↔ M.IsBasis I X ∧ X ⊆ N.E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.of_isRestriction hMN, h.subset_ground⟩, fun h ↦ h.1.isBasis_isRestriction hMN h.2⟩

name: Dep.of_isRestriction
statement: theorem Dep.of_isRestriction (hX : N.Dep X) (hNM : N ≤r M) : M.Dep X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩ := hNM
  rw [restrict_dep_iff] at hX
  exact ⟨hX.1, hX.2.trans hR⟩

name: Dep.dep_isRestriction
statement:
theorem Dep.dep_isRestriction (hX : M.Dep X) (hNM : N ≤r M) (hXE : X ⊆ N.E := by aesop_mat) :
    N.Dep X

name: IsRestriction.dep_iff
statement: theorem IsRestriction.dep_iff (hMN : N ≤r M) : N.Dep X ↔ M.Dep X ∧ X ⊆ N.E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.of_isRestriction hMN, h.subset_ground⟩, fun h ↦ h.1.dep_isRestriction hMN h.2⟩

name: IsBasis.transfer
statement:
theorem IsBasis.transfer (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (hJX : M.IsBasis J X) (hXY : X ⊆ Y)
    (hJY : M.IsBasis J Y) : M.IsBasis I Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isBase_restrict_iff]; rw [← isBase_restrict_iff] at hJY
  exact hJY.isBase_of_isBasis_superset hJX.subset (hIX.isBasis_restrict_of_subset hXY)

name: IsBasis.isBasis_of_isBasis_of_subset_of_subset
statement:
theorem IsBasis.isBasis_of_isBasis_of_subset_of_subset (hI : M.IsBasis I X) (hJ : M.IsBasis J Y)
    (hJX : J ⊆ X) (hIY : I ⊆ Y) : M.IsBasis I Y
proof:
:= by
  have hI' := hI.isBasis_subset (subset_inter hI.subset hIY) inter_subset_left
  have hJ' := hJ.isBasis_subset (subset_inter hJX hJ.subset) inter_subset_right
  exact hI'.transfer hJ' inter_subset_right hJ

name: Indep.exists_isBasis_subset_union_isBasis
statement:
theorem Indep.exists_isBasis_subset_union_isBasis (hI : M.Indep I) (hIX : I ⊆ X)
    (hJ : M.IsBasis J X) : ∃ I', M.IsBasis I' X ∧ I ⊆ I' ∧ I' ⊆ I ∪ J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I', hI', hII', hI'IJ⟩ :=
    (hI.indep_restrict_of_subset hIX).exists_isBase_subset_union_isBase (IsBasis.isBase_restrict hJ)
  rw [isBase_restrict_iff] at hI'
  exact ⟨I', hI', hII', hI'IJ⟩

name: Indep.exists_insert_of_not_isBasis
statement:
theorem Indep.exists_insert_of_not_isBasis (hI : M.Indep I) (hIX : I ⊆ X) (hI' : ¬M.IsBasis I X)
    (hJ : M.IsBasis J X) : ∃ e ∈ J \ I, M.Indep (insert e I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isBase_restrict_iff] at hI'; rw [← isBase_restrict_iff] at hJ
  obtain ⟨e, he, hi⟩ := (hI.indep_restrict_of_subset hIX).exists_insert_of_not_isBase hI' hJ
  exact ⟨e, he, (restrict_indep_iff.mp hi).1⟩

name: IsBasis.isBase_of_isBase_subset
statement:
theorem IsBasis.isBase_of_isBase_subset (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (hB : M.IsBase B) (hBX : B ⊆ X) :
    M.IsBase I

name: IsBasis.exchange
statement:
theorem IsBasis.exchange (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (hJX : M.IsBasis J X) (he : e ∈ I \ J) :
    ∃ f ∈ J \ I, M.IsBasis (insert f (I \ {e})) X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, h⟩ := hIX.restrict_isBase.exchange hJX.restrict_isBase he
  exact ⟨y, hy, by rwa [isBase_restrict_iff] at h⟩

name: IsBasis.eq_exchange_of_sdiff_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem IsBasis.eq_exchange_of_sdiff_eq_singleton (hI : M.IsBasis I X) (hJ : M.IsBasis J X)
    (hIJ : I \ J = {e}) : ∃ f ∈ J \ I, J = insert f I \ {e}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isBase_restrict_iff] at hI hJ; exact hI.eq_exchange_of_sdiff_eq_singleton hJ hIJ

name: IsBasis'.encard_eq_encard
statement:
theorem IsBasis'.encard_eq_encard (hI : M.IsBasis' I X) (hJ : M.IsBasis' J X) :
    I.encard = J.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isBase_restrict_iff'] at hI hJ; exact hI.encard_eq_encard_of_isBase hJ

name: IsBasis.encard_eq_encard
statement: theorem IsBasis.encard_eq_encard (hI : M.IsBasis I X) (hJ : M.IsBasis J X) : I.encard = J.encard

name: Indep.augment
statement:
theorem Indep.augment (hI : M.Indep I) (hJ : M.Indep J) (hIJ : I.encard < J.encard) :
    ∃ e ∈ J \ I, M.Indep (insert e I)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! he
  have hb : M.IsBasis I (I ∪ J) := by
    simp_rw [hI.isBasis_iff_forall_insert_dep subset_union_left, union_sdiff_left, mem_sdiff,
      and_imp, dep_iff, insert_subset_iff, and_iff_left hI.subset_ground]
    exact fun e heJ heI ↦ ⟨he e ⟨heJ, heI⟩, hJ.subset_ground heJ⟩
  obtain ⟨J', hJ', hJJ'⟩ := hJ.subset_isBasis_of_subset I.subset_union_right
  rw [← hJ'.encard_eq_encard hb] at hIJ
  exact hIJ.not_ge (encard_mono hJJ')

name: Indep.augment_finset
statement:
lemma Indep.augment_finset {I J : Finset α} (hI : M.Indep I) (hJ : M.Indep J)
    (hIJ : I.card < J.card) : ∃ e ∈ J, e ∉ I ∧ M.Indep (insert e I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxI⟩ := hI.augment hJ (by simpa [encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card])
  simp only [mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_coe] at hx
  exact ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2, hxI⟩

name: contract_ground
statement: @[simp] lemma contract_ground (M : Matroid α) (C : Set α) : (M ／ C).E = M.E \ C

name: dual_delete_dual
statement: lemma dual_delete_dual (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : (M✶ ＼ X)✶ = M ／ X

name: dual_delete
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dual_delete (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : (M ＼ X)✶ = M✶ ／ X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_dual M, dual_delete_dual, dual_dual]

name: dual_contract
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dual_contract (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : (M ／ X)✶ = M✶ ＼ X

name: dual_contract_dual
statement: lemma dual_contract_dual (M : Matroid α) (X : Set α) : (M✶ ／ X)✶ = M ＼ X

name: contract_contract
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_contract (M : Matroid α) (C₁ C₂ : Set α) : M ／ C₁ ／ C₂ = M ／ (C₁ ∪ C₂)

name: contract_comm
statement: lemma contract_comm (M : Matroid α) (C₁ C₂ : Set α) : M ／ C₁ ／ C₂ = M ／ C₂ ／ C₁

name: dual_contract_delete
statement: lemma dual_contract_delete (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) : (M ／ X ＼ Y)✶ = M✶ ＼ X ／ Y

name: dual_delete_contract
statement: lemma dual_delete_contract (M : Matroid α) (X Y : Set α) : (M ＼ X ／ Y)✶ = M✶ ／ X ＼ Y

name: contract_eq_self_iff
statement: lemma contract_eq_self_iff : M ／ C = M ↔ Disjoint C M.E
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_delete_dual, ← dual_inj, dual_dual, delete_eq_self_iff, dual_ground]

name: contractElem_eq_self
statement: lemma contractElem_eq_self (he : e ∉ M.E) : M ／ {e} = M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_delete_dual, deleteElem_eq_self (by simpa), dual_dual]

name: contract_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma contract_empty (M : Matroid α) : M ／ ∅ = M

name: contract_contract_eq_contract_sdiff
statement:
lemma contract_contract_eq_contract_sdiff (M : Matroid α) (C₁ C₂ : Set α) :
    M ／ C₁ ／ C₂ = M ／ C₁ ／ (C₂ \ C₁)

name: contract_eq_contract_iff
statement: lemma contract_eq_contract_iff : M ／ C₁ = M ／ C₂ ↔ C₁ ∩ M.E = C₂ ∩ M.E
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_delete_dual, ← dual_delete_dual, dual_inj, delete_eq_delete_iff, dual_ground]

name: contract_inter_ground_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma contract_inter_ground_eq (M : Matroid α) (C : Set α) : M ／ (C ∩ M.E) = M ／ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_delete_dual, ← dual_ground, delete_inter_ground_eq, dual_delete_dual]

name: contract_ground_subset_ground
statement: lemma contract_ground_subset_ground (M : Matroid α) (C : Set α) : (M ／ C).E ⊆ M.E

name: coindep_contract_iff
statement: lemma coindep_contract_iff : (M ／ C).Coindep X ↔ M.Coindep X ∧ Disjoint X C

name: Coindep.coindep_contract_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma Coindep.coindep_contract_of_disjoint (hX : M.Coindep X) (hXC : Disjoint X C) :
    (M ／ C).Coindep X

name: contract_isCocircuit_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma contract_isCocircuit_iff :
    (M ／ C).IsCocircuit K ↔ M.IsCocircuit K ∧ Disjoint K C

name: Indep.contract_isBase_iff
statement:
lemma Indep.contract_isBase_iff (hI : M.Indep I) :
    (M ／ I).IsBase B ↔ M.IsBase (B ∪ I) ∧ Disjoint B I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_delete_dual, dual_isBase_iff', delete_ground, dual_ground, delete_isBase_iff,
    subset_sdiff, ← and_assoc, and_congr_left_iff, ← dual_dual M, dual_isBase_iff', dual_dual,
    dual_dual, union_comm, dual_ground, union_subset_iff, and_iff_right hI.subset_ground,
    and_congr_left_iff, ← isBase_restrict_iff, sdiff_sdiff, Spanning.isBase_restrict_iff,
    and_iff_left (sdiff_subset_sdiff_right subset_union_left)]
  · simp
  rwa [← dual_ground, ← coindep_iff_compl_spanning, dual_coindep_iff]

name: Indep.contract_indep_iff
statement:
lemma Indep.contract_indep_iff (hI : M.Indep I) :
    (M ／ I).Indep J ↔ Disjoint J I ∧ M.Indep (J ∪ I)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [indep_iff, hI.contract_isBase_iff, union_subset_iff]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨B, ⟨hBI, hdj⟩, hJB⟩ ↦ ⟨disjoint_of_subset_left hJB hdj, _, hBI,
    hJB.trans subset_union_left, subset_union_right⟩,
    fun ⟨hdj, B, hB, hJB, hIB⟩ ↦ ⟨B \ I,⟨by simpa [union_eq_self_of_subset_right hIB],
      disjoint_sdiff_left⟩, subset_sdiff.2 ⟨hJB, hdj⟩ ⟩⟩

name: IsNonloop.contractElem_indep_iff
statement:
lemma IsNonloop.contractElem_indep_iff (he : M.IsNonloop e) :
    (M ／ {e}).Indep I ↔ e ∉ I ∧ M.Indep (insert e I)

name: Indep.union_indep_iff_contract_indep
statement:
lemma Indep.union_indep_iff_contract_indep (hI : M.Indep I) :
    M.Indep (I ∪ J) ↔ (M ／ I).Indep (J \ I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hI.contract_indep_iff, and_iff_right disjoint_sdiff_left, sdiff_union_self, union_comm]

name: Indep.diff_indep_contract_of_subset
statement:
lemma Indep.diff_indep_contract_of_subset (hJ : M.Indep J) (hIJ : I ⊆ J) :
    (M ／ I).Indep (J \ I)

name: Indep.contract_dep_iff
statement:
lemma Indep.contract_dep_iff (hI : M.Indep I) :
    (M ／ I).Dep J ↔ Disjoint J I ∧ M.Dep (J ∪ I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dep_iff, hI.contract_indep_iff, dep_iff, contract_ground, subset_sdiff, disjoint_comm,
    union_subset_iff, and_iff_left hI.subset_ground]
  tauto

name: IsBasis.contract_eq_contract_delete
statement: lemma IsBasis.contract_eq_contract_delete (hI : M.IsBasis I X) : M ／ X = M ／ I ＼ (X \ I)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← sdiff_union_of_subset hI.subset, ← dual_inj, dual_contract_delete, dual_contract,
    union_comm, ← delete_delete, ext_iff_indep]
  refine ⟨rfl, fun J hJ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hss : X \ I ⊆ (M✶ ＼ I).coloops := fun e he ↦ by
    rw [← dual_contract, dual_coloops, ← IsLoop, ← singleton_dep, hI.indep.contract_dep_iff,
      singleton_union, and_iff_right (by simpa using he.2), hI.indep.insert_dep_iff,
      hI.closure_eq_closure]
    exact sdiff_subset_sdiff_left (M.subset_closure X) he
  rw [((coloops_indep _).subset hss).contract_indep_iff, delete_indep_iff,
    union_indep_iff_indep_of_subset_coloops hss, and_comm]

name: Indep.union_isBasis_union_of_contract_isBasis
statement:
lemma Indep.union_isBasis_union_of_contract_isBasis (hI : M.Indep I) (hB : (M ／ I).IsBasis J X) :
    M.IsBasis (J ∪ I) (X ∪ I)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsBasis, hI.contract_indep_iff, contract_ground, subset_sdiff,
    maximal_subset_iff, and_imp] at hB
  refine hB.1.1.1.2.isBasis_of_maximal_subset (union_subset_union_left _ hB.1.1.2)
    fun K hK hKJ hKX ↦ ?_
  rw [union_subset_iff] at hKJ
  rw [hB.1.2 (t := K \ I) disjoint_sdiff_left (by simpa [sdiff_union_of_subset hKJ.2])
    (sdiff_subset_iff.2 (by rwa [union_comm])) (subset_sdiff.2 ⟨hKJ.1, hB.1.1.1.1⟩),
    sdiff_union_of_subset hKJ.2]

name: IsBasis'.contract_isBasis'_sdiff_sdiff_of_subset
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_isBasis'_sdiff_sdiff_of_subset (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) (hJI : J ⊆ I) :
    (M ／ J).IsBasis' (I \ J) (X \ J)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ ⦃K⦄, Disjoint K J → M.Indep (K ∪ J) → K ⊆ X → I ⊆ K ∪ J → K ⊆ I by
    simpa +contextual [IsBasis', (hIX.indep.subset hJI).contract_indep_iff,
      subset_sdiff, maximal_subset_iff, disjoint_sdiff_left,
      union_eq_self_of_subset_right hJI, hIX.indep, sdiff_subset.trans hIX.subset,
      sdiff_subset_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, union_comm J]
  exact fun K hJK hKJi hKX hIJK ↦ by
    simp [hIX.eq_of_subset_indep hKJi hIJK (union_subset hKX (hJI.trans hIX.subset))]

name: IsBasis'.contract_isBasis'_sdiff_of_subset
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_isBasis'_sdiff_of_subset (hIX : M.IsBasis' I X) (hJI : J ⊆ I) :
    (M ／ J).IsBasis' (I \ J) X
proof:
:= by
  simpa [isBasis'_iff_isBasis_inter_ground, inter_sdiff_assoc, ← sdiff_inter_distrib_right] using
    (hIX.contract_isBasis'_sdiff_sdiff_of_subset hJI).isBasis_inter_ground

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_sdiff_sdiff_of_subset
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_isBasis_sdiff_sdiff_of_subset (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (hJI : J ⊆ I) :
    (M ／ J).IsBasis (I \ J) (X \ J)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hIX.isBasis'.contract_isBasis'_sdiff_of_subset hJI).isBasis_inter_ground
  rwa [contract_ground, ← inter_sdiff_assoc, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hIX.subset_ground] at h

name: IsBasis.contract_sdiff_isBasis_sdiff
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_sdiff_isBasis_sdiff (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) (hJY : M.IsBasis J Y)
    (hIJ : I ⊆ J) : (M ／ I).IsBasis (J \ I) (Y \ X)
proof:
:= by
  refine (hJY.contract_isBasis_sdiff_sdiff_of_subset hIJ).isBasis_subset ?_ ?_
  · rw [subset_sdiff, and_iff_right (sdiff_subset.trans hJY.subset),
      hIX.eq_of_subset_indep (hJY.indep.inter_right X) (subset_inter hIJ hIX.subset)
      inter_subset_right, sdiff_self_inter]
    exact disjoint_sdiff_left
  refine sdiff_subset_sdiff_right hIX.subset

name: IsBasis'.contract_isBasis_union_union
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_isBasis_union_union (h : M.IsBasis' (J ∪ I) (X ∪ I))
    (hJI : Disjoint J I) (hXI : Disjoint X I) : (M ／ I).IsBasis' J X
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hJI.sdiff_eq_left, hXI.sdiff_eq_left] using
    h.contract_isBasis'_sdiff_sdiff_of_subset subset_union_right

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_union_union
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_isBasis_union_union (h : M.IsBasis (J ∪ I) (X ∪ I))
    (hJI : Disjoint J I) (hXI : Disjoint X I) : (M ／ I).IsBasis J X
proof:
:= by
  refine (isBasis'_iff_isBasis ?_).1 <| h.isBasis'.contract_isBasis_union_union hJI hXI
  rw [contract_ground, subset_sdiff, and_iff_left hXI]
  exact subset_union_left.trans h.subset_ground

name: IsBasis'.contract_eq_contract_delete
statement: lemma IsBasis'.contract_eq_contract_delete (hI : M.IsBasis' I X) : M ／ X = M ／ I ＼ (X \ I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← contract_inter_ground_eq, hI.isBasis_inter_ground.contract_eq_contract_delete, eq_comm,
    ← delete_inter_ground_eq, contract_ground, sdiff_eq, sdiff_eq, ← inter_inter_distrib_right,
    ← sdiff_eq]

name: IsBasis'.contract_indep_iff
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_indep_iff (hI : M.IsBasis' I X) :
    (M ／ X).Indep J ↔ M.Indep (J ∪ I) ∧ Disjoint X J
proof:
:= by
  rw [hI.contract_eq_contract_delete, delete_indep_iff, hI.indep.contract_indep_iff,
    and_comm, ← and_assoc, ← disjoint_union_right, sdiff_union_self,
    union_eq_self_of_subset_right hI.subset, and_comm, disjoint_comm]

name: IsBasis.contract_indep_iff
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_indep_iff (hI : M.IsBasis I X) :
    (M ／ X).Indep J ↔ M.Indep (J ∪ I) ∧ Disjoint X J

name: IsBasis'.contract_dep_iff
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_dep_iff (hI : M.IsBasis' I X) {D : Set α} :
    (M ／ X).Dep D ↔ M.Dep (D ∪ I) ∧ Disjoint X D
proof:
:= by
  rw [hI.contract_eq_contract_delete, delete_dep_iff, hI.indep.contract_dep_iff, and_comm,
    ← and_assoc, ← disjoint_union_right, sdiff_union_of_subset hI.subset, disjoint_comm, and_comm]

name: IsBasis.contract_dep_iff
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_dep_iff (hI : M.IsBasis I X) {D : Set α} :
    (M ／ X).Dep D ↔ M.Dep (D ∪ I) ∧ Disjoint X D

name: IsBasis.contract_indep_iff_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_indep_iff_of_disjoint (hI : M.IsBasis I X) (hdj : Disjoint X J) :

name: IsBasis.contract_indep_sdiff_iff

lemma IsBasis.contract_indep_sdiff_iff (hI : M.IsBasis I X) :
    (M ／ X).Indep (J \ X) ↔ M.Indep ((J \ X) ∪ I)

name: IsBasis'.contract_indep_sdiff_iff
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_indep_sdiff_iff (hI : M.IsBasis' I X) :
    (M ／ X).Indep (J \ X) ↔ M.Indep ((J \ X) ∪ I)

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_isBasis'
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_isBasis' (h : M.IsBasis I X) (hJC : M.IsBasis' J C)
    (h_ind : M.Indep (I \ C ∪ J)) : (M ／ C).IsBasis (I \ C) (X \ C)
proof:
:= by
  have hIX := h.subset
  have hJCss := hJC.subset
  rw [hJC.contract_eq_contract_delete, delete_isBasis_iff]
  refine ⟨contract_isBasis_union_union (h_ind.isBasis_of_subset_of_subset_closure ?_ ?_) ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
  rotate_left
  · rw [closure_union_congr_right hJC.closure_eq_closure, sdiff_union_self,
      closure_union_congr_left h.closure_eq_closure]
    exact subset_closure_of_subset' _ (by tauto_set)
      (union_subset (sdiff_subset.trans h.subset_ground) hJC.indep.subset_ground)
  all_goals tauto_set

name: IsBasis'.contract_isBasis'
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_isBasis' (h : M.IsBasis' I X) (hJC : M.IsBasis' J C)
    (h_ind : M.Indep (I \ C ∪ J)) : (M ／ C).IsBasis' (I \ C) (X \ C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isBasis'_iff_isBasis_inter_ground, contract_ground, ← sdiff_inter_distrib_right]
  exact h.isBasis_inter_ground.contract_isBasis_of_isBasis' hJC h_ind

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_isBasis (h : M.IsBasis I X) (hJC : M.IsBasis J C)
    (h_ind : M.Indep (I \ C ∪ J)) : (M ／ C).IsBasis (I \ C) (X \ C)

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_disjoint (h : M.IsBasis I X) (hJC : M.IsBasis J C)
    (hdj : Disjoint C X) (h_ind : M.Indep (I ∪ J)) : (M ／ C).IsBasis I X
proof:
:= by
  have h' := h.contract_isBasis hJC
  rwa [(hdj.mono_right h.subset).sdiff_eq_right, hdj.sdiff_eq_right, imp_iff_right h_ind] at h'

name: IsBasis'.contract_isBasis_of_indep
statement:
lemma IsBasis'.contract_isBasis_of_indep (h : M.IsBasis' I X) (h_ind : M.Indep (I ∪ J)) :

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_indep

lemma IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_indep (h : M.IsBasis I X) (h_ind : M.Indep (I ∪ J)) :

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_disjoint_indep
statement:
lemma IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_disjoint_indep (h : M.IsBasis I X) (hdj : Disjoint J X)
    (h_ind : M.Indep (I ∪ J)) : (M ／ J).IsBasis I X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hdj.sdiff_eq_right, ← (hdj.mono_right h.subset).sdiff_eq_right]
  exact h.contract_isBasis_of_indep h_ind

name: Indep.of_contract
statement: lemma Indep.of_contract (hI : (M ／ C).Indep I) : M.Indep I

name: Dep.of_contract
statement: lemma Dep.of_contract (h : (M ／ C).Dep X) (hC : C ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) : M.Dep (C ∪ X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dep, and_iff_left (union_subset hC (h.subset_ground.trans sdiff_subset))]
  intro hi
  rw [Dep, (hi.subset subset_union_left).contract_indep_iff, union_comm,
    and_iff_left hi] at h
  exact h.1 (subset_sdiff.1 h.2).2

name: contract_eq_delete_of_subset_loops
statement: lemma contract_eq_delete_of_subset_loops (hX : X ⊆ M.loops) : M ／ X = M ＼ X

name: contract_eq_delete_of_subset_coloops
statement: lemma contract_eq_delete_of_subset_coloops (hX : X ⊆ M.coloops) : M ／ X = M ＼ X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_inj, dual_delete, contract_eq_delete_of_subset_loops hX, dual_contract]

name: contract_isLoop_iff_mem_closure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_isLoop_iff_mem_closure : (M ／ C).IsLoop e ↔ e ∈ M.closure C ∧ e ∉ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' C
  rw [hI.contract_eq_contract_delete, delete_isLoop_iff, ← singleton_dep,
    hI.indep.contract_dep_iff, singleton_union, hI.indep.insert_dep_iff, hI.closure_eq_closure]
  by_cases heI : e ∈ I
  · simp [heI, hI.subset heI]
  simp [heI, and_comm]

name: contract_loops_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_loops_eq (M : Matroid α) (C : Set α) : (M ／ C).loops = M.closure C \ C

name: contract_coloops_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_coloops_eq (M : Matroid α) (C : Set α) : (M ／ C).coloops = M.coloops \ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_delete_dual, dual_coloops, delete_loops_eq, dual_loops]

name: contract_isColoop_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_isColoop_iff : (M ／ C).IsColoop e ↔ M.IsColoop e ∧ e ∉ C

name: IsNonloop.of_contract
statement: lemma IsNonloop.of_contract (h : (M ／ C).IsNonloop e) : M.IsNonloop e
proof:
:= by
  rw [← indep_singleton] at h ⊢
  exact h.of_contract

name: contract_isNonloop_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_isNonloop_iff : (M ／ C).IsNonloop e ↔ e ∈ M.E \ M.closure C
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNonloop_iff_mem_compl_loops, contract_ground, contract_loops_eq]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨he,heC⟩ ↦ ⟨he.1, fun h ↦ heC ⟨h, he.2⟩⟩,
    fun h ↦ ⟨⟨h.1, fun heC ↦ h.2 ?_⟩, fun h' ↦ h.2 h'.1⟩⟩
  rw [← closure_inter_ground]
  exact (M.subset_closure (C ∩ M.E)) ⟨heC, h.1⟩

name: IsBasis.sdiff_subset_loops_contract
statement: lemma IsBasis.sdiff_subset_loops_contract (hIX : M.IsBasis I X) : X \ I ⊆ (M ／ I).loops
proof:
:= by
  rw [sdiff_subset_iff, contract_loops_eq, union_sdiff_self,
    union_eq_self_of_subset_left (M.subset_closure I)]
  exact hIX.subset_closure

name: contract_closure_eq_contract_delete
statement:
lemma contract_closure_eq_contract_delete (M : Matroid α) (C : Set α) :
    M ／ M.closure C = M ／ C ＼ (M.closure C \ C)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hCE : C ⊆ M.E with aux
  · rw [← M.contract_inter_ground_eq C, ← closure_inter_ground, aux _ _ inter_subset_right,
      sdiff_inter, sdiff_eq_empty.2 (M.closure_subset_ground _), union_empty]
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis C
  rw [hI.isBasis_closure_right.contract_eq_contract_delete, hI.contract_eq_contract_delete,
    delete_delete, union_comm, sdiff_union_sdiff_cancel (M.subset_closure C) hI.subset]

name: contract_closure_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_closure_eq (M : Matroid α) (C X : Set α) :
    (M ／ C).closure X = M.closure (X ∪ C) \ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_union_inter (M.closure (X ∪ C) \ C) X, sdiff_sdiff, union_comm C, ← contract_loops_eq,
    union_comm X, ← contract_contract, contract_loops_eq, subset_antisymm_iff, union_subset_iff,
    and_iff_right sdiff_subset, ← sdiff_subset_iff]
  simp only [sdiff_sdiff_right_self, subset_inter_iff, inter_subset_right, and_true]
  refine ⟨fun e ⟨he, he'⟩ ↦ ⟨mem_closure_of_mem' _ (.inr he') (mem_ground_of_mem_closure he).1,
    (closure_subset_ground _ _ he).2⟩, fun e ⟨⟨he, heC⟩, he'⟩ ↦
    mem_closure_of_mem' _ he' ⟨M.closure_subset_ground _ he, heC⟩⟩

name: contract_spanning_iff
statement:
lemma contract_spanning_iff (hC : C ⊆ M.E := by aesop_mat) :
    (M ／ C).Spanning X ↔ M.Spanning (X ∪ C) ∧ Disjoint X C
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanning_iff, contract_closure_eq, contract_ground, spanning_iff, union_subset_iff,
    subset_sdiff, ← and_assoc, and_congr_left_iff, and_comm (a := X ⊆ _), ← and_assoc,
    and_congr_left_iff]
  refine fun hdj hX ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, hC⟩, fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩
  rwa [← union_sdiff_cancel (M.subset_closure_of_subset' subset_union_right hC), h,
    union_sdiff_cancel]

name: contract_spanning_iff'
statement: lemma contract_spanning_iff' : (M ／ C).Spanning X ↔ M.Spanning (X ∪ (C ∩ M.E)) ∧ Disjoint X C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← contract_inter_ground_eq, contract_spanning_iff, and_congr_right_iff]
  refine fun h ↦ ⟨fun hdj ↦ ?_, Disjoint.mono_right inter_subset_left⟩
  rw [← sdiff_union_inter C M.E, disjoint_union_right, and_iff_left hdj]
  exact disjoint_sdiff_right.mono_left (subset_union_left.trans h.subset_ground)

name: Spanning.contract
statement: lemma Spanning.contract (hX : M.Spanning X) (C : Set α) : (M ／ C).Spanning (X \ C)
proof:
:= by
  have hXE := hX.subset_ground
  rw [contract_spanning_iff', and_iff_left disjoint_sdiff_left]
  exact hX.superset (by tauto_set) (by tauto_set)

name: Spanning.contract_eq_loopyOn
statement: lemma Spanning.contract_eq_loopyOn (hX : M.Spanning X) : M ／ X = loopyOn (M.E \ X)

name: IsCircuit.contract_isCircuit
statement:
lemma IsCircuit.contract_isCircuit (hK : M.IsCircuit K) (hC : C ⊂ K) :
    (M ／ C).IsCircuit (K \ C)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ e ∈ K, e ∉ C → M.Indep (K \ {e} ∪ C) by
    simpa [isCircuit_iff_dep_forall_sdiff_singleton_indep, sdiff_sdiff_comm (s := K) (t := C),
    dep_iff, (hK.ssubset_indep hC).contract_indep_iff, sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hK.subset_ground,
    disjoint_sdiff_left, sdiff_union_of_subset hC.subset, hK.not_indep]
  exact fun e heK heC ↦ (hK.sdiff_singleton_indep heK).subset <| by
    simp [subset_sdiff_singleton hC.subset heC]

name: IsCircuit.contractElem_isCircuit
statement:
lemma IsCircuit.contractElem_isCircuit (hC : M.IsCircuit C) (hnt : C.Nontrivial) (heC : e ∈ C) :
    (M ／ {e}).IsCircuit (C \ {e})

name: IsCircuit.contract_dep
statement: lemma IsCircuit.contract_dep (hK : M.IsCircuit K) (hCK : Disjoint C K) : (M ／ C).Dep K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis (C ∩ M.E)
  rw [← contract_inter_ground_eq, Dep, hI.contract_indep_iff,
    and_iff_left (hCK.mono_left inter_subset_left), contract_ground, subset_sdiff,
    and_iff_left (hCK.symm.mono_right inter_subset_left), and_iff_left hK.subset_ground]
  exact fun hi ↦ hK.dep.not_indep (hi.subset subset_union_left)

name: IsCircuit.contract_dep_of_not_subset
statement:
lemma IsCircuit.contract_dep_of_not_subset (hK : M.IsCircuit K) {C : Set α} (hKC : ¬ K ⊆ C) :
    (M ／ C).Dep (K \ C)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := hK.contract_isCircuit (C := C ∩ K) (inter_subset_right.ssubset_of_ne (by simpa))
  simp only [sdiff_inter_self_eq_sdiff] at h'
  have hwin := h'.contract_dep (C := C \ K) disjoint_sdiff_sdiff
  rwa [contract_contract, inter_union_sdiff] at hwin

name: IsCircuit.contract_sdiff_isCircuit
statement:
lemma IsCircuit.contract_sdiff_isCircuit (hC : M.IsCircuit C) (hK : K.Nonempty) (hKC : K ⊆ C) :
    (M ／ (C \ K)).IsCircuit K
proof:
:= by
  simpa [inter_eq_self_of_subset_right hKC] using hC.contract_isCircuit (C := C \ K) <|
    by rwa [sdiff_ssubset_left_iff, inter_eq_self_of_subset_right hKC]

name: IsCircuit.exists_subset_isCircuit_of_contract
statement:
lemma IsCircuit.exists_subset_isCircuit_of_contract (hC : (M ／ K).IsCircuit C) :
    ∃ C', M.IsCircuit C' ∧ C ⊆ C' ∧ C' ⊆ C ∪ K
proof:
:= by
  wlog hKi : M.Indep K generalizing K with aux
  · obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := M.exists_isBasis' K
    rw [hI.contract_eq_contract_delete, delete_isCircuit_iff] at hC
    obtain ⟨C', hC', hCC', hC'ss⟩ := aux hC.1 hI.indep
    exact ⟨C', hC', hCC', hC'ss.trans (union_subset_union_right _ hI.subset)⟩
  obtain ⟨hCE : C ⊆ M.E, hCK : Disjoint C K⟩ := subset_sdiff.1 hC.subset_ground
  obtain ⟨C', hC'ss, hC'⟩ := (hKi.contract_dep_iff.1 hC.dep).2.exists_isCircuit_subset
  refine ⟨C', hC', ?_, hC'ss⟩
  have hdep2 : (M ／ K).Dep (C' \ K) := by
    rw [hKi.contract_dep_iff, and_iff_right disjoint_sdiff_left]
    refine hC'.dep.superset (by simp)
  rw [← (hC.eq_of_dep_subset hdep2 (sdiff_subset_iff.2 (union_comm _ _ ▸ hC'ss)))]
  exact sdiff_subset

name: IsCocircuit.of_contract
statement: lemma IsCocircuit.of_contract (hK : (M ／ C).IsCocircuit K) : M.IsCocircuit K
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCocircuit_def, dual_contract] at hK
  exact hK.of_delete

name: IsCocircuit.delete_isCocircuit
statement:
lemma IsCocircuit.delete_isCocircuit {D : Set α} (hK : M.IsCocircuit K) (hD : D ⊂ K) :
    (M ＼ D).IsCocircuit (K \ D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCocircuit_def, dual_delete]
  exact hK.isCircuit.contract_isCircuit hD

name: IsCocircuit.delete_sdiff_isCocircuit
statement:
lemma IsCocircuit.delete_sdiff_isCocircuit {X : Set α} (hK : M.IsCocircuit K) (hXK : X ⊆ K)
    (hX : X.Nonempty) : (M ＼ (K \ X)).IsCocircuit X
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCocircuit_def, dual_delete]
  exact hK.isCircuit.contract_sdiff_isCircuit hX hXK

name: contract_delete_sdiff
statement: lemma contract_delete_sdiff (M : Matroid α) (C D : Set α) : M ／ C ＼ D = M ／ C ＼ (D \ C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [delete_eq_delete_iff, contract_ground, sdiff_eq, sdiff_eq, ← inter_inter_distrib_right,
    inter_assoc]

name: contract_restrict_eq_restrict_contract
statement:
lemma contract_restrict_eq_restrict_contract (M : Matroid α) (h : Disjoint C R) :
    (M ／ C) ↾ R = (M ↾ (R ∪ C)) ／ C
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_indep (by simp [h.sdiff_eq_right]) fun I (hI : I ⊆ R) ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := (M ↾ (R ∪ C)).exists_isBasis' C
  have hJ' : M.IsBasis' J C := by
    simpa [inter_eq_self_of_subset_left subset_union_right] using (isBasis'_restrict_iff.1 hJ).1
  rw [restrict_indep_iff, hJ.contract_indep_iff, hJ'.contract_indep_iff, restrict_indep_iff]
  have hJC := hJ'.subset
  tauto_set

name: restrict_contract_eq_contract_restrict
statement:
lemma restrict_contract_eq_contract_restrict (M : Matroid α) (hCR : C ⊆ R) :
    (M ↾ R) ／ C = (M ／ C) ↾ (R \ C)

name: contract_delete_comm
statement: lemma contract_delete_comm (M : Matroid α) (hCD : Disjoint C D) : M ／ C ＼ D = M ＼ D ／ C
proof:
:= by
  wlog hCE : C ⊆ M.E generalizing C with aux
  · rw [← contract_inter_ground_eq, aux (hCD.mono_left inter_subset_left) inter_subset_right,
      contract_eq_contract_iff, inter_assoc, delete_ground,
      inter_eq_self_of_subset_right sdiff_subset]
  rw [delete_eq_restrict, delete_eq_restrict, contract_ground, sdiff_sdiff_comm,
    restrict_contract_eq_contract_restrict _ (by simpa [hCE, subset_sdiff])]

name: contract_delete_comm'
statement: lemma contract_delete_comm' (M : Matroid α) (C D : Set α) : M ／ C ＼ D = M ＼ (D \ C) ／ C

name: delete_contract_eq_sdiff
statement: lemma delete_contract_eq_sdiff (M : Matroid α) (D C : Set α) : M ＼ D ／ C = M ＼ D ／ (C \ D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contract_eq_contract_iff, delete_ground, ← sdiff_inter_distrib_right, sdiff_eq, sdiff_eq,
    inter_assoc]

name: delete_contract_comm'
statement: lemma delete_contract_comm' (M : Matroid α) (D C : Set α) : M ＼ D ／ C = M ／ (C \ D) ＼ D

lemma delete_delete (M : Matroid α) (D₁ D₂ : Set α) : M ＼ D₁ ＼ D₂ = M ＼ (D₁ ∪ D₂)

statement: lemma delete_inter_ground_eq (M : Matroid α) (D : Set α) : M ＼ (D ∩ M.E) = M ＼ D

name: delete_eq_delete_iff
statement: lemma delete_eq_delete_iff {D₁ D₂ : Set α} : M ＼ D₁ = M ＼ D₂ ↔ D₁ ∩ M.E = D₂ ∩ M.E
proof:
:= by
  rw [← delete_inter_ground_eq, ← M.delete_inter_ground_eq D₂]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h]⟩
  apply_fun (M.E \ Matroid.E ·) at h
  simp_rw [delete_ground, sdiff_sdiff_cancel_left inter_subset_right] at h
  assumption

name: delete_empty

@[simp]

name: delete_delete_eq_delete_sdiff

name: IsRestriction.restrict_delete_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma IsRestriction.restrict_delete_of_disjoint (h : N ≤r M) (hX : Disjoint X N.E) :

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩ := isRestriction_iff_exists_eq_delete.1 h
  refine isRestriction_iff_exists_eq_delete.2 ⟨D \ X, sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hD, ?_⟩
  rwa [delete_delete, union_sdiff_self, union_comm, ← delete_delete, eq_comm,
    delete_eq_self_iff]

lemma delete_indep_iff : (M ＼ D).Indep I ↔ M.Indep I ∧ Disjoint I D

name: delete_isBasis'_iff

@[simp]
lemma delete_isBasis'_iff : (M ＼ D).IsBasis' I X ↔ M.IsBasis' I (X \ D)

  rw [isBasis'_iff_isBasis_inter_ground, delete_isBasis_iff, delete_ground, sdiff_eq,
    inter_comm M.E, ← inter_assoc, ← sdiff_eq, ← isBasis'_iff_isBasis_inter_ground,
    and_iff_left_iff_imp, inter_comm, ← inter_sdiff_assoc]

name: IsBasis.of_delete

name: IsBasis.delete

name: Coindep.delete_isBase_iff
statement:
lemma Coindep.delete_isBase_iff (hD : M.Coindep D) :
    (M ＼ D).IsBase B ↔ M.IsBase B ∧ Disjoint B D
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matroid.delete_isBase_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hss := h.subset
    rw [subset_sdiff] at hss
    have hcl := h.isBasis_closure_right
    rw [hD.closure_compl, isBasis_ground_iff] at hcl
    exact ⟨hcl, hss.2⟩
  exact h.1.isBasis_ground.isBasis_subset (by simp [subset_sdiff, h.1.subset_ground, h.2])
    sdiff_subset

name: Coindep.delete_rankPos
statement: lemma Coindep.delete_rankPos [M.RankPos] (hD : M.Coindep D) : (M ＼ D).RankPos

name: Coindep.delete_spanning_iff
statement:
lemma Coindep.delete_spanning_iff {S : Set α} (hD : M.Coindep D) :
    (M ＼ D).Spanning S ↔ M.Spanning S ∧ Disjoint S D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [spanning_iff_exists_isBase_subset', hD.delete_isBase_iff, and_assoc, delete_ground,
    subset_sdiff, and_congr_left_iff, and_imp]
  refine fun hSE hSD ↦ ⟨fun ⟨B, hB, hBD, hBS⟩ ↦ ⟨B, hB, hBS⟩, fun ⟨B, hB, hBS⟩ ↦ ⟨B, hB, ?_, hBS⟩⟩
  exact hSD.mono_left hBS

@[simp]
lemma delete_isCircuit_iff {C : Set α} :

:= by
  rw [delete_eq_restrict, restrict_isCircuit_iff, and_congr_right_iff, subset_sdiff,

name: delete_closure_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma delete_closure_eq (M : Matroid α) (D X : Set α) :
    (M ＼ D).closure X = M.closure (X \ D) \ D
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrict_compl, restrict_closure_eq', sdiff_sdiff_self, bot_eq_empty, union_empty,
    sdiff_eq, inter_comm M.E, ← inter_assoc X, ← sdiff_eq, closure_inter_ground,
    ← inter_assoc, ← sdiff_eq, inter_eq_left]
  exact sdiff_subset.trans (M.closure_subset_ground _)

lemma delete_closure_eq_of_disjoint (M : Matroid α) {D X : Set α} (hXD : Disjoint X D) :

statement:
lemma delete_isColoop_iff (M : Matroid α) (D : Set α) :

name: exists_notMem_mem_hom_path_path_of_notMem_mem
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_mem_hom_path_path_of_notMem_mem {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (S : Set V)
    (ha_not_in_S : a ∉ S) (hb_in_S : b ∈ S) :
    ∃ᵉ (u ∉ S) (v ∈ S) (e : u ⟶ v) (p₁ : Path a u) (p₂ : Path v b),
      p = p₁.comp (e.toPath.comp p₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction h_len : p.length generalizing a b S ha_not_in_S hb_in_S with
  | zero =>
    obtain rfl := eq_of_length_zero p h_len
    exact (ha_not_in_S hb_in_S).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    have h_pos : 0 < p.length := by simp [h_len]
    obtain ⟨c, p', e, rfl⟩ := (length_ne_zero_iff_eq_cons p).mp h_pos.ne'
    by_cases hc_in_S : c ∈ S
    · have p'_len : p'.length = n := by simp_all
      obtain ⟨u, hu_not_S, v, hv_S, e_uv, p₁, p₂, hp'⟩ :=
        ih p' S ha_not_in_S hc_in_S p'_len
      refine ⟨u, hu_not_S, v, hv_S, e_uv, p₁, p₂.comp e.toPath, ?_⟩
      simp [hp', comp_toPath_eq_cons]
    · refine ⟨c, hc_in_S, b, hb_in_S, e, p', Path.nil, ?_⟩
      simp [comp_toPath_eq_cons]

name: exists_mem_notMem_hom_path_path_of_notMem_mem
statement:
theorem exists_mem_notMem_hom_path_path_of_notMem_mem {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (S : Set V)
    (ha_in_S : a ∈ S) (hb_not_in_S : b ∉ S) :
    ∃ᵉ (u ∈ S) (v ∉ S) (e : u ⟶ v) (p₁ : Path a u) (p₂ : Path v b),
      p = p₁.comp (e.toPath.comp p₂)
proof:
:= by
  have ha_not_in_compl : a ∉ Sᶜ := by simpa
  have hb_in_compl : b ∈ Sᶜ := by simpa
  obtain ⟨u, hu_not_in_compl, v, hv_in_compl, e, p₁, p₂, hp⟩ :=
    exists_notMem_mem_hom_path_path_of_notMem_mem p Sᶜ ha_not_in_compl hb_in_compl
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] at hu_not_in_compl hv_in_compl
  refine ⟨u, hu_not_in_compl, v, hv_in_compl, e, p₁, p₂, hp⟩

name: end_cons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma end_cons {a b c : V} (p : Path a b) (e : b ⟶ c) : (p.cons e).end = c

name: vertices_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_nil (a : V) : (nil : Path a a).vertices = [a]

name: vertices_cons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_cons {a b c : V} (p : Path a b) (e : b ⟶ c) :
  (p.cons e).vertices = p.vertices.concat c

name: mem_vertices_cons
statement:
lemma mem_vertices_cons {a b c : V} (p : Path a b)
    (e : b ⟶ c) {x : V} :
    x ∈ (p.cons e).vertices ↔ x ∈ p.vertices ∨ x = c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vertices_cons]
  simp_all only [concat_eq_append, mem_append, mem_cons, not_mem_nil, or_false]

name: verticesSet_nil
statement: lemma verticesSet_nil {a : V} : {v | v ∈ (nil : Path a a).vertices} = {a}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vertices_nil, mem_singleton, Set.ext_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  exact fun x ↦ Set.mem_ofPred

name: vertices_length
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_length {V : Type*} [Quiver V] {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    p.vertices.length = p.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p' e ih =>
    simp [vertices_cons, length_cons, ih]

name: length_vertices_pos
statement:
lemma length_vertices_pos {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    0 < p.vertices.length

name: vertices_ne_nil
statement: lemma vertices_ne_nil {a : V} {b : V} (p : Path a b) : p.vertices ≠ []

name: start_mem_vertices
statement: lemma start_mem_vertices {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : a ∈ p.vertices
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p' e ih => simp [ih]

name: vertices_head
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_head? {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : p.vertices.head? = some a
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp only [vertices_nil, head?_cons]
  | cons p' e ih => simp [ih]

name: vertices_head_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_head_eq {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (h : p.vertices ≠ [] := p.vertices_ne_nil) :
    p.vertices.head h = a
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp only [vertices_nil, head_cons]
  | cons p' _ ih => simp [head_append_of_ne_nil (vertices_ne_nil p'), ih]

name: getElem_vertices_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma getElem_vertices_zero {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : p.vertices[0] = a
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p' e ih => simp [ih]

name: vertices_getLast
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_getLast {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (h : p.vertices ≠ [] := p.vertices_ne_nil) :
    p.vertices.getLast h = b
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp only [vertices_nil, getLast_singleton]
  | cons p' e ih => simp

name: dropLast_append_end_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dropLast_append_end_eq {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    p.vertices.dropLast ++ [b] = p.vertices

name: vertices_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_comp {a b c : V} (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) :
  (p.comp q).vertices = p.vertices.dropLast ++ q.vertices
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q' e ih => simp [ih]

name: length_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma length_eq_zero_iff {a : V} (p : Path a a) :
    p.length = 0 ↔ p = Path.nil

name: vertices_comp_get_length_eq
statement:
lemma vertices_comp_get_length_eq {a b c : V} (p₁ : Path a c) (p₂ : Path c b)
    (h : p₁.length < (p₁.comp p₂).vertices.length := by simp) :
    (p₁.comp p₂).vertices.get ⟨p₁.length, h⟩ = c

name: vertices_toPath
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vertices_toPath {i j : V} (e : i ⟶ j) :
    e.toPath.vertices = [i, j]

name: vertices_toPath_tail
statement:
lemma vertices_toPath_tail {i j : V} (e : i ⟶ j) :
    e.toPath.vertices.tail = [j]

name: nil_of_comp_eq_nil_left
statement:
lemma nil_of_comp_eq_nil_left {a b : V} {p : Path a b} {q : Path b a}
    (h : p.comp q = Path.nil) : p.length = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (p.comp q).length = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg Path.length h
  have : p.length + q.length = 0 := by
    simpa [length_comp] using hlen
  exact Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_right this

name: nil_of_comp_eq_nil_right
statement:
lemma nil_of_comp_eq_nil_right {a b : V} {p : Path a b} {q : Path b a}
    (h : p.comp q = Path.nil) : q.length = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (p.comp q).length = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg Path.length h
  have : p.length + q.length = 0 := by
    simpa [length_comp] using hlen
  exact Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_left this

name: comp_eq_nil_iff
statement:
lemma comp_eq_nil_iff {a b : V} {p : Path a b} {q : Path b a} :
    p.comp q = Path.nil ↔ p.length = 0 ∧ q.length = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨nil_of_comp_eq_nil_left h, nil_of_comp_eq_nil_right h⟩, fun ⟨hp, hq⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  induction p with
  | nil => simpa using (length_eq_zero_iff q).mp hq
  | cons p' _ ihp => simp at hp

name: end_mem_vertices
statement:
@[simp]
lemma end_mem_vertices {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : b ∈ p.vertices
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : p.vertices.getLast (vertices_ne_nil p) = b :=
    vertices_getLast p (vertices_ne_nil p)
  have h₂ := getLast_mem (l := p.vertices) (vertices_ne_nil p)
  simpa [h₁] using h₂

name: exists_eq_comp_of_le_length
statement:
theorem exists_eq_comp_of_le_length {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ p.length) :
    ∃ (v : V) (p₁ : Path a v) (p₂ : Path v b),
      p = p₁.comp p₂ ∧ p₁.length = n
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    obtain ⟨rfl⟩ : n = 0 := by simpa using hn
    exact ⟨a, Path.nil, Path.nil, by simp, rfl⟩
  | @cons _ c p' e ih =>
    rw [length_cons] at hn
    rcases (Nat.le_succ_iff).1 hn with h | rfl
    · obtain ⟨d, p₁, p₂, hp, hl⟩ := ih h
      exact ⟨d, p₁, p₂.cons e, by simp [hp], hl⟩
    · exact ⟨c, p'.cons e, Path.nil, by simp, by simp⟩

name: exists_eq_comp_and_length_eq_of_lt_length
statement:
theorem exists_eq_comp_and_length_eq_of_lt_length (n : ℕ) (hn : n < p.vertices.length) :
    ∃ (v : V) (p₁ : Path a v) (p₂ : Path v b),
      p = p₁.comp p₂ ∧ p₁.length = n ∧ v = p.vertices[n]
proof:
:= by
  have hn_le_len : n ≤ p.length := by
    rw [vertices_length] at hn
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hn
  obtain ⟨v, p₁, p₂, rfl, rfl⟩ := p.exists_eq_comp_of_le_length hn_le_len
  exact ⟨v, p₁, p₂, rfl, rfl, by simp⟩

name: exists_eq_comp_of_mem_vertices
statement:
theorem exists_eq_comp_of_mem_vertices {v : V} (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    ∃ (p₁ : Path a v) (p₂ : Path v b), p = p₁.comp p₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, ∃ hn : n < p.vertices.length, v = p.vertices[n] :=
    exists_mem_iff_getElem.mp ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, p₁, p₂, hp, hv, rfl⟩ := p.exists_eq_comp_and_length_eq_of_lt_length n hn
  exact ⟨p₁, p₂, hp⟩

name: exists_eq_comp_and_notMem_tail_of_mem_vertices
statement:
theorem exists_eq_comp_and_notMem_tail_of_mem_vertices {v : V} (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    ∃ (p₁ : Path a v) (p₂ : Path v b),
      p = p₁.comp p₂ ∧ v ∉ p₂.vertices.tail
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    have hxa : v = a := by
      simpa [vertices_nil, List.mem_singleton] using hv
    subst hxa
    exact ⟨Path.nil, Path.nil, by simp only [comp_nil],
      by simp only [vertices_nil, tail_cons, not_mem_nil, not_false_eq_true]⟩
  | cons pPrev e ih =>
    have hv' : v ∈ pPrev.vertices ∨ v = (pPrev.cons e).end := by
      simpa using (mem_vertices_cons pPrev e).1 hv
    have h_case₁ : v = (pPrev.cons e).end → ∃ (p₁ : Path a v) (p₂ : Path v (pPrev.cons e).end),
        pPrev.cons e = p₁.comp p₂ ∧ v ∉ p₂.vertices.tail := by
      rintro rfl
      exact ⟨pPrev.cons e, Path.nil, by simp [comp_nil], by simp [vertices_nil]⟩
    have h_case₂ : v ∈ pPrev.vertices → v ≠ (pPrev.cons e).end →
        ∃ (p₁ : Path a v) (p₂ : Path v (pPrev.cons e).end),
          pPrev.cons e = p₁.comp p₂ ∧ v ∉ p₂.vertices.tail := by
      intro hxPrev hxe_ne
      obtain ⟨q₁, q₂, h_prev, h_not_tail⟩ := ih hxPrev
      let q₂' : Path v (pPrev.cons e).end := q₂.cons e
      have h_no_tail : v ∉ q₂'.vertices.tail := by grind [vertices_cons, end_cons]
      exact ⟨q₁, q₂', by simp [q₂', h_prev], h_no_tail⟩
    cases hv' with
    | inl h_in_prefix =>
      by_cases h_eq_end : v = (pPrev.cons e).end
      · exact h_case₁ h_eq_end
      · exact h_case₂ h_in_prefix h_eq_end
    | inr h_eq_end => exact h_case₁ h_eq_end

name: weight_nil
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) addWeight_nil]
lemma weight_nil (w : ∀ {i j : V}, (i ⟶ j) → R) (a : V) :
    weight w (Path.nil : Path a a) = 1

name: weight_cons
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) addWeight_cons]
lemma weight_cons (w : ∀ {i j : V}, (i ⟶ j) → R) {a b c : V} (p : Path a b) (e : b ⟶ c) :
    weight w (p.cons e) = weight w p * w e

name: weightOfEPs_nil
statement:
@[to_additive addWeightOfEPs_nil]
lemma weightOfEPs_nil (w : V → V → R) (a : V) :
    weightOfEPs w (Path.nil : Path a a) = 1

name: weightOfEPs_cons
statement:
@[to_additive addWeightOfEPs_cons]
lemma weightOfEPs_cons (w : V → V → R) {a b c : V} (p : Path a b) (e : b ⟶ c) :
    weightOfEPs w (p.cons e) = weightOfEPs w p * w b c

name: weight_comp
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) addWeight_comp]
lemma weight_comp (w : ∀ {i j : V}, (i ⟶ j) → R) {a b c : V} (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) :
    weight w (p.comp q) = weight w p * weight w q
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | nil => simp
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [ih, mul_assoc]

name: weightOfEPs_comp
statement:
@[to_additive addWeightOfEPs_comp]
lemma weightOfEPs_comp (w : V → V → R) {a b c : V} (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) :
    weightOfEPs w (p.comp q) = weightOfEPs w p * weightOfEPs w q

name: weight_pos
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons p e ih =>
      have he : 0 < w e := hw e
      simpa [weight_cons] using mul_pos ih he

name: weight_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons p e ih =>
      have he : 0 ≤ w e := hw e
      simpa [weight_cons] using mul_nonneg ih he

name: weightOfEPs_pos
proof:
:= by
  apply weight_pos
  intro i j e
  exact hw _ _

name: weightOfEPs_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply weight_nonneg
  intro i j e
  exact hw _ _

name: gosper_trick
proof:
:= by
  have l₁ : (i : ℚ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by norm_cast
  have l₂ : (n : ℚ) - i + 1 ≠ 0 := by norm_cast
  have h₁ := (mul_div_cancel_left₀ (↑(Nat.centralBinom (i + 1))) l₁).symm
  have h₂ := (mul_div_cancel_left₀ (↑(Nat.centralBinom (n - i + 1))) l₂).symm
  have h₃ : ((i : ℚ) + 1) * (i + 1).centralBinom = 2 * (2 * i + 1) * i.centralBinom :=
    mod_cast Nat.succ_mul_centralBinom_succ i
  have h₄ :
    ((n : ℚ) - i + 1) * (n - i + 1).centralBinom = 2 * (2 * (n - i) + 1) * (n - i).centralBinom :=
      mod_cast Nat.succ_mul_centralBinom_succ (n - i)
  simp only [gosperCatalan]
  push_cast
  rw [show n + 1 - i = n - i + 1 by rw [Nat.add_comm (n - i) 1, ← (Nat.add_sub_assoc h 1),
    add_comm]]
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  field

name: gosper_catalan_sub_eq_central_binom_div
statement:
private theorem gosper_catalan_sub_eq_central_binom_div (n : ℕ) : gosperCatalan (n + 1) (n + 1) -
    gosperCatalan (n + 1) 0 = Nat.centralBinom (n + 1) / (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gosperCatalan, tsub_self, Nat.centralBinom_zero, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, Nat.cast_add,
    Nat.sub_zero, one_mul, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_add_rev]
  field

name: catalan_eq_centralBinom_div
statement: theorem catalan_eq_centralBinom_div (n : ℕ) : catalan n = n.centralBinom / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices (catalan n : ℚ) = Nat.centralBinom n / (n + 1) by
    have h := Nat.succ_dvd_centralBinom n
    exact mod_cast this
  induction n using Nat.caseStrongRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | ind d hd =>
    simp_rw [catalan_succ, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul]
    trans (∑ i : Fin d.succ, Nat.centralBinom i / (i + 1) *
                            (Nat.centralBinom (d - i) / (d - i + 1)) : ℚ)
    · congr
      ext1 x
      have m_le_d : x.val ≤ d := by lia
      have d_minus_x_le_d : (d - x.val) ≤ d := tsub_le_self
      rw [hd _ m_le_d, hd _ d_minus_x_le_d]
      norm_cast
    · trans (∑ i : Fin d.succ, (gosperCatalan (d + 1) (i + 1) - gosperCatalan (d + 1) i))
      · refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [gosper_trick i.is_le, mul_div]
      · rw [← sum_range fun i => gosperCatalan (d + 1) (i + 1) - gosperCatalan (d + 1) i,
            sum_range_sub, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
        rw [gosper_catalan_sub_eq_central_binom_div d]
        norm_cast

name: aux_sub_aux
statement:
theorem aux_sub_aux (k n : ℕ) (x : R) :
    powMulProdOneSubPow k n x + x ^ (3 * k + 5) * powMulProdOneSubPow (k + 1) n x =
    aux k (n + 1) x - aux k n x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [aux, Finset.prod_range_succ, powMulProdOneSubPow]
  rw [Finset.prod_range_succ', Finset.prod_range_succ]
  ring_nf

name: tsum_powMulProdOneSubPow
statement:
theorem tsum_powMulProdOneSubPow (k : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : IsTopologicallyNilpotent x)
    (hsum : ∀ k, Summable (powMulProdOneSubPow k · x))
    (h : ∀ k, Multipliable (fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + k + 1))) :
    ∑' n, powMulProdOneSubPow k n x =
      1 - x ^ (2 * k + 3) - x ^ (3 * k + 5) * ∑' n, powMulProdOneSubPow (k + 1) n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, show 1 - x ^ (2 * k + 3) = 0 - aux k 0 x by simp [aux]]
  rw [← (hsum _).tsum_mul_left, ← (hsum _).tsum_add ((hsum _).mul_left _)]
  apply HasSum.tsum_eq
  rw [((hsum _).add ((hsum _).mul_left _)).hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat]
  simp_rw [aux_sub_aux, Finset.sum_range_sub (aux k · x)]
  apply Tendsto.sub_const
  rw [show 𝓝 0 = 𝓝 (0 * (0 - 1) * ∏' i, (1 - x ^ (k + i + 2))) by simp]
  refine (Tendsto.mul ?_ ?_).mul ?_
  · exact hx.comp (strictMono_mul_left_of_pos (by simp)).tendsto_atTop
  · exact (hx.comp (add_right_strictMono.add_monotone monotone_const).tendsto_atTop).sub_const _
  · apply Multipliable.tendsto_prod_tprod_nat
    convert h (k + 1) using 4
    ring

name: tprod_one_sub_pow_eq_powMulProdOneSubPow_zero
statement:
theorem tprod_one_sub_pow_eq_powMulProdOneSubPow_zero {x : R}
    (hsum : ∀ k, Summable (powMulProdOneSubPow k · x))
    (h : ∀ k, Multipliable fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + k + 1)) :
    ∏' n, (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) = 1 - x - x ^ 2 * ∑' n, powMulProdOneSubPow 0 n x
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := hsum 0
  simp_rw [powMulProdOneSubPow, zero_add, one_mul] at hsum
  have hsum' : Summable fun i ↦ x ^ (i + 1) * ∏ n ∈ Finset.range i, (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) := by
    apply Summable.comp_nat_add (k := 1)
    conv in fun k ↦ _ =>
      ext k
      rw [pow_add, pow_add, mul_assoc (x ^ k), mul_comm (x ^ k), mul_assoc (x ^ 1 * x ^ 1)]
    exact hsum.mul_left _
  rw [tprod_one_sub_ordered (by simpa [Nat.Iio_eq_range] using hsum') (by simpa using h 0)]
  simp_rw [Nat.Iio_eq_range, sub_sub, sub_right_inj, hsum'.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  conv in fun k ↦ x ^ (k + 1 + 1) * _ =>
    ext k
    rw [pow_add, pow_add, mul_assoc (x ^ k), mul_comm (x ^ k),
      ← pow_add x 1 1, one_add_one_eq_two, mul_assoc (x ^ 2)]
  simp [hsum.tsum_mul_left, powMulProdOneSubPow]

name: tprod_one_sub_pow_eq_powMulProdOneSubPow
statement:
theorem tprod_one_sub_pow_eq_powMulProdOneSubPow (j : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : IsTopologicallyNilpotent x)
    (hsum : ∀ k, Summable (powMulProdOneSubPow k · x))
    (h : ∀ k, Multipliable (fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + k + 1))) :
    ∏' n, (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
      (-1) ^ k * (x ^ (k * (3 * k + 1) / 2) - x ^ ((k + 1) * (3 * k + 2) / 2))
      + (-1) ^ (j + 1) * x ^ ((j + 1) * (3 * j + 4) / 2) * ∑' n, powMulProdOneSubPow j n x
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    simp [tprod_one_sub_pow_eq_powMulProdOneSubPow_zero hsum h, powMulProdOneSubPow,
      ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [ih, tsum_powMulProdOneSubPow _ hx hsum h, Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1)]
    have h (n) : (n + 1 + 1) * (3 * (n + 1) + 2) / 2 =
        (n + 1) * (3 * n + 4) / 2 + (2 * n + 3) := by
      rw [← Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by simp)]
      ring_nf
    simp_rw [h]
    have h (n) : (n + 1 + 1) * (3 * (n + 1) + 4) / 2 =
        (n + 1) * (3 * n + 4) / 2 + (3 * n + 5) := by
      rw [← Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by simp)]
      ring_nf
    simp_rw [h]
    ring_nf

name: tendsto_order_pow_mul_prod_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem tendsto_order_pow_mul_prod_one_sub_pow (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ (X ^ ((k + 1) * n) *
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 - X ^ (k + i + 1)) : R⟦X⟧).order) atTop (𝓝 ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R using Subsingleton.eq_zero (α := R⟦X⟧)
  refine ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt.mpr fun n ↦ eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨n + 1, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  grw [← le_order_mul, order_X_pow]
  refine lt_add_of_lt_of_nonneg ?_ (by simp)
  norm_cast
  grind

name: tendsto_order_neg_X_pow
statement:
theorem tendsto_order_neg_X_pow (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (-(X : R⟦X⟧) ^ (i + k + 1)).order) atTop (𝓝 ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R using Subsingleton.eq_zero (α := R⟦X⟧)
  simp_rw [order_neg, order_X_pow, add_assoc]
  exact ENat.tendsto_natCast_nhds_top.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat _)

name: summable_pow_mul_prod_one_sub_pow
statement:

theorem coeff_pentagonalSeries_pentagonal (k : ℤ) :

name: coeff_pentagonalSeries_eq_zero_iff

theorem coeff_pentagonalSeries_eq_zero_iff [Nontrivial R] {n : ℕ} :

name: coeff_pentagonalSeries_mul_eq_extend
statement:
theorem coeff_pentagonalSeries_mul_eq_extend (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) :
    (pentagonalSeries R).coeff n * f n =
      Function.extend pentagonal (fun k ↦ k.negOnePow * f (pentagonal k)) 0 n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n ∈ Set.range pentagonal
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hn
    simp [pentagonal_injective.extend_apply, -Int.coe_negOnePow]
  · rw [Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ (by simpa using hn)]
    simp [coeff_pentagonalSeries_eq_zero R hn]

name: hasSum_pentagonalSeries
statement:
theorem hasSum_pentagonalSeries :
    HasSum (fun k : ℤ ↦ (Int.negOnePow k : R⟦X⟧) * X ^ pentagonal k) (pentagonalSeries R)
proof:
:= by
  suffices HasSum ((fun n ↦ C ((pentagonalSeries R).coeff n) * X ^ n) ∘ pentagonal)
      (pentagonalSeries R) by
    convert this
    simp
  rw [pentagonal_injective.hasSum_iff fun n hn ↦ by simp [coeff_pentagonalSeries_eq_zero R hn]]
  simpa [monomial_eq_C_mul_X_pow] using (pentagonalSeries R).hasSum_of_monomials_self

name: pentagonalSeries_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem pentagonalSeries_eq_tsum [T2Space R] :
    pentagonalSeries R = ∑' k, (Int.negOnePow k : R⟦X⟧) * X ^ pentagonal k

name: hasSum_pow_pentagonal_sub_pentagonalSeries
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_pentagonal_sub_pentagonalSeries :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ ↦ (-1) ^ k * (X ^ pentagonal (-k) - X ^ pentagonal (k + 1)))
      (pentagonalSeries R)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_pentagonalSeries R
  rw [← neg_injective.hasSum_iff (fun x hx ↦ by absurd hx; use -x; simp)] at h
  convert h.nat_add_neg_add_one using 2 with k
  simp_rw [Function.comp_apply, neg_neg, Int.negOnePow_add]
  simp
  ring

name: pentagonalSeries_eq_tsum_pow_pentagonal_sub
statement:
theorem pentagonalSeries_eq_tsum_pow_pentagonal_sub [T2Space R] :
    pentagonalSeries R = ∑' (k : ℕ), (-1) ^ k * (X ^ pentagonal (-k) - X ^ pentagonal (k + 1))

name: tprod_one_sub_X_pow'
statement:
private theorem tprod_one_sub_X_pow' [IsTopologicalRing R] [T2Space R] :
    ∏' n, (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : R⟦X⟧) = pentagonalSeries R
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [pentagonalSeries_eq_tsum_pow_pentagonal_sub]
  refine Pentagonal.tprod_one_sub_pow ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [IsTopologicallyNilpotent, tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
    refine fun d ↦ tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const fun i (hi : i ≥ d + 1) ↦ ?_
    grind
  · exact Pentagonal.summable_pow_mul_prod_one_sub_pow R
  · exact Pentagonal.multipliable_one_sub_X_pow R
  · exact (hasSum_pow_pentagonal_sub_pentagonalSeries R).summable
  · rw [tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
    refine fun n ↦ tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const fun k (hk : k ≥ n) ↦ ?_
    rw [map_zero]
    apply coeff_of_lt_order
    grw [← le_order_mul, ← le_order_mul]
    refine (lt_add_of_lt_of_nonneg (lt_add_of_nonneg_of_lt (by simp) ?_) (by simp))
    rw [order_X_pow, Nat.cast_lt, ← Nat.add_one_le_iff, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by simp)]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul <;> linarith

name: coeff_prod_one_sub_X_pow_eventually_eq
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_one_sub_X_pow_eventually_eq (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ s in atTop, (∏ n ∈ s, (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : R⟦X⟧)).coeff n = (pentagonalSeries R).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace R := ⊥
  have : DiscreteTopology R := ⟨rfl⟩
  have h := (multipliable_one_sub_X_pow R).hasProd
  rw [tprod_one_sub_X_pow' R, HasProd, tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto] at h
  simpa using h n

name: hasProd_one_sub_X_pow
statement:
theorem hasProd_one_sub_X_pow :
    HasProd (fun n ↦ (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : R⟦X⟧)) (pentagonalSeries R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasProd, tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
  intro n
  apply tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq
  simpa using coeff_prod_one_sub_X_pow_eventually_eq R n

name: pow_mul_prod_bound
statement:
lemma pow_mul_prod_bound (k n : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    ‖x ^ ((k + 1) * n) * ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), (1 - x ^ (k + i + 1))‖ ≤
      ‖x‖ ^ ((k + 1) * n) * ∏' i, (1 + ‖x‖ ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  grw [norm_mul_le, Finset.norm_prod_le, norm_pow_le]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by simp)
  trans ∏ i ∈ Ico (k + 1) (n + 1 + (k + 1)), (1 + ‖x‖ ^ i)
  · rw [prod_Ico_eq_prod_range, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    gcongr
    grw [norm_sub_le, norm_one, norm_pow_le, add_right_comm]
  have : Multipliable (1 + ‖x‖ ^ ·) := multipliable_one_add_of_summable (by simpa using hx)
  exact this.prod_le_tprod_of_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ by positivity) (by simp)

name: summable_norm_pow_mul_prod
statement:
lemma summable_norm_pow_mul_prod (k : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    Summable fun n ↦ ‖x ^ ((k + 1) * n) * ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), (1 - x ^ (k + i + 1))‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (Summable.mul_right _ ?_).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
    (pow_mul_prod_bound k · hx)
  simp_rw [pow_mul]
  apply summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by simp)
  exact (pow_lt_one_iff_of_nonneg (by simp) (by simp)).mpr hx

name: tsum_pow_mul_prod_bound
statement:
lemma tsum_pow_mul_prod_bound (k : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    ‖∑' n, x ^ ((k + 1) * n) * ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), (1 - x ^ (k + i + 1))‖ ≤
      (1 - ‖x‖)⁻¹ * ∏' i, (1 + ‖x‖ ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  refine tsum_of_norm_bounded (g := fun n ↦ ‖x‖ ^ n * ∏' i, (1 + ‖x‖ ^ i)) ?_ fun n ↦ ?_
  · rw [← tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by simp) hx]
    exact (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by simp) hx).hasSum.mul_right _
  · apply (pow_mul_prod_bound k n hx).trans
    gcongr ?_ * ?_
    · exact tprod_nonneg fun _ ↦ by positivity
    · grind [mul_comm, pow_mul, pow_le_of_le_one (by simp) (pow_le_one₀ (by simp) hx.le)]

name: multipliable_one_sub_pow_add
statement:
lemma multipliable_one_sub_pow_add [CompleteSpace R] (k : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    Multipliable (fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply multipliable_one_sub_of_summable
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun n ↦ norm_pow_le _ _)
  simp_rw [pow_add]
  exact ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by simp) hx).mul_right _).mul_right _

name: eulerFunction_def
statement:
theorem eulerFunction_def (x : R) :
    eulerFunction x = ∑' n, (PowerSeries.pentagonalSeries R).coeff n * x ^ n

name: eulerFunction_eq_tsum_pentagonal
statement:
theorem eulerFunction_eq_tsum_pentagonal (x : R) :
    eulerFunction x = ∑' k, k.negOnePow * x ^ pentagonal k

name: hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonalSeries
statement:
theorem hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonalSeries {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ (PowerSeries.pentagonalSeries R).coeff n * x ^ n) (eulerFunction x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Summable.hasSum_iff ?_).mpr rfl
  refine (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg x) hx).of_norm_bounded fun n ↦ ?_
  by_cases hn : n ∈ Set.range pentagonal
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hn
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_pentagonalSeries_pentagonal, Int.coe_negOnePow]
    grw [norm_mul_le, norm_pow_le, norm_pow_le]
    simp
  · simp [PowerSeries.coeff_pentagonalSeries_eq_zero R hn]

name: hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonal
statement:
theorem hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonal {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k ↦ k.negOnePow * x ^ pentagonal k) (eulerFunction x)

name: hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonal_pair
statement:
theorem hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonal_pair {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ ↦ (-1) ^ k * (x ^ pentagonal (-k) - x ^ pentagonal (k + 1)))
      (eulerFunction x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonal hx
  rw [← neg_injective.hasSum_iff (by simp [neg_involutive.surjective.range_eq])] at h
  convert h.nat_add_neg_add_one with k
  simp [-Int.coe_negOnePow, Int.negOnePow_add, Int.coe_negOnePow_natCast]
  ring

name: eulerFunction_eq_tsum_pentagonal_pair
statement:
theorem eulerFunction_eq_tsum_pentagonal_pair {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    eulerFunction x = ∑' k : ℕ, (-1) ^ k * (x ^ pentagonal (-k) - x ^ pentagonal (k + 1))

name: eulerFunction_eq_tprod
statement:
theorem eulerFunction_eq_tprod {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    eulerFunction x = ∏' n : ℕ, (1 - x ^ (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerFunction_eq_tsum_pentagonal_pair hx]
  refine (Pentagonal.tprod_one_sub_pow ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
  · exact tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one hx
  · exact fun k ↦ (Pentagonal.summable_norm_pow_mul_prod k hx).of_norm
  · exact (Pentagonal.multipliable_one_sub_pow_add · hx)
  · exact (hasSum_eulerFunction_pentagonal_pair hx).summable
  · apply Tendsto.zero_mul_isBoundedUnder_le
    · refine isBoundedUnder_le_mul_tendsto_zero ⟨1, by simp⟩ ?_
      apply (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one hx).comp
      rw [tendsto_atTop_atTop]
      exact fun k ↦ ⟨k, fun n hn ↦ hn.trans (by grind)⟩
    · exact isBoundedUnder_of ⟨_, fun k ↦ Pentagonal.tsum_pow_mul_prod_bound k hx⟩

name: hasProd_eulerFunction
statement:
theorem hasProd_eulerFunction {x : R} (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    HasProd (fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + 1)) (eulerFunction x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Multipliable.hasProd_iff ?_).mpr (eulerFunction_eq_tprod hx).symm
  simpa using Pentagonal.multipliable_one_sub_pow_add 0 hx

name: le_of_mem_parts
statement:
@[grind →]
theorem le_of_mem_parts {n : ℕ} {p : Partition n} {m : ℕ} (h : m ∈ p.parts) : m ≤ n

name: ofComposition_surj
statement: theorem ofComposition_surj {n : ℕ} : Function.Surjective (ofComposition n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩
  induction b using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ b => ?_
  exact ⟨⟨b, hb₁, by simpa using hb₂⟩, Partition.ext rfl⟩

name: ofSym_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofSym_map (e : σ ≃ τ) (s : Sym σ n) :
    ofSym (s.map e) = ofSym s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofSym, Sym.val_eq_coe, Sym.coe_map, mk.injEq]
  rw [Multiset.dedup_map_of_injective e.injective]
  simp only [map_map, Function.comp_apply]
  congr; funext i
  rw [← Multiset.count_map_eq_count' e _ e.injective]

name: toFinsuppAntidiag_injective
statement: theorem toFinsuppAntidiag_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (toFinsuppAntidiag (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold toFinsuppAntidiag
  intro p q h
  rw [Finsupp.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨hfinset, hcount⟩ := h
  rw [Nat.Partition.ext_iff, Multiset.ext]
  intro m
  obtain rfl | h0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m
  · grind [Multiset.count_eq_zero]
  · exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right h0 <| funext_iff.mp hcount m

name: toFinsuppAntidiag_mem_finsuppAntidiag
statement:
theorem toFinsuppAntidiag_mem_finsuppAntidiag {n : ℕ} (p : Partition n) :
    p.toFinsuppAntidiag ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 n).finsuppAntidiag n
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.parts.toFinset ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 n := by
    grind
  suffices ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Multiset.count m p.parts * m = n by simpa [toFinsuppAntidiag, hp]
  convert! ← p.parts_sum
  rw [Finset.sum_multiset_count]
  apply Finset.sum_subset hp
  suffices ∀ (x : ℕ), 1 ≤ x → x ≤ n → x ∉ p.parts → x ∉ p.parts ∨ x = 0 by simpa
  grind

name: indiscrete_parts
statement: @[simp] lemma indiscrete_parts {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (indiscrete n).parts = {n}

name: partition_zero_parts
statement: @[simp] lemma partition_zero_parts (p : Partition 0) : p.parts = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_forall_notMem fun _ h => (p.parts_pos h).ne' <| sum_eq_zero_iff.1 p.parts_sum _ h

name: partition_one_parts
statement: @[simp] lemma partition_one_parts (p : Partition 1) : p.parts = {1}
proof:
:= by
  have h : p.parts = replicate (card p.parts) 1 := eq_replicate_card.2 fun x hx =>
    ((le_sum_of_mem hx).trans_eq p.parts_sum).antisymm (p.parts_pos hx)
  have h' : card p.parts = 1 := by simpa using (congrArg sum h.symm).trans p.parts_sum
  rw [h, h', replicate_one]

name: ofSym_one

name: countRestricted_two
statement: theorem countRestricted_two (n : ℕ) : countRestricted n 2 = distincts n
proof:
:= by

  rw [Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one]
  grind [Multiset.count_eq_zero]

name: partitionWithPartEquiv_apply_parts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem partitionWithPartEquiv_apply_parts {n a : ℕ} (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (ha : a ≤ n)

name: coeff_genFun
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_genFun (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    (genFun f).coeff n = ∑ p : n.Partition, p.parts.toFinsupp.prod f

name: tendsto_order_genFun_term_atTop_nhds_top
statement:
theorem tendsto_order_genFun_term_atTop_nhds_top (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) (i : ℕ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun j ↦ (f (i + 1) (j + 1) • (X : R⟦X⟧) ^ ((i + 1) * (j + 1))).order)
    Filter.atTop (nhds ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  refine ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt.mpr (fun n ↦ Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩)
  intro m hm
  grw [PowerSeries.smul_eq_C_mul, ← le_order_mul]
  refine lt_add_of_nonneg_of_lt (by simp) ?_
  nontriviality R using Subsingleton.eq_zero (α := R⟦X⟧)
  rw [order_X_pow]
  norm_cast
  grind

name: summable_genFun_term
statement:
theorem summable_genFun_term (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) (i : ℕ) :
    Summable fun j ↦ f (i + 1) (j + 1) • (X : R⟦X⟧) ^ ((i + 1) * (j + 1))

name: summable_genFun_term'
statement:
theorem summable_genFun_term' (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    Summable fun j ↦ f i (j + 1) • (X : R⟦X⟧) ^ (i * (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero hi
  apply summable_genFun_term

name: aux_dvd_of_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem aux_dvd_of_coeff_ne_zero {f : ℕ → ℕ → R} {d : ℕ} {s : Finset ℕ} (hs0 : 0 ∉ s)
    {g : ℕ →₀ ℕ} (hg : g ∈ s.finsuppAntidiag d)
    (hprod : ∀ i ∈ s, (coeff (g i)) (1 + ∑' j, f i (j + 1) • X ^ (i * (j + 1))) ≠ (0 : R)) (x : ℕ) :
    x ∣ g x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s
  · specialize hprod x hx
    contrapose hprod
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hs0 (h ▸ hx)
    rw [map_add, (summable_genFun_term' f hx0).map_tsum _ (WithPiTopology.continuous_coeff _ _)]
    rw [show (0 : R) = 0 + ∑' (i : ℕ), 0 by simp]
    congrm (?_ + ∑' (i : ℕ), ?_)
    · suffices g x ≠ 0 by simp [this]
      contrapose hprod
      simp [hprod]
    · rw [map_smul, coeff_X_pow]
      apply smul_eq_zero_of_right
      suffices g x ≠ x * (i + 1) by simp [this]
      contrapose hprod
      simp [hprod]
  · suffices g x = 0 by simp [this]
    contrapose! hx
    exact mem_of_subset (mem_finsuppAntidiag.mp hg).2 <| by simpa using hx

name: aux_prod_coeff_eq_zero_of_notMem_range
statement:
private theorem aux_prod_coeff_eq_zero_of_notMem_range (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) {d : ℕ} {s : Finset ℕ}
    (hs0 : 0 ∉ s) {g : ℕ →₀ ℕ} (hg : g ∈ s.finsuppAntidiag d)
    (hg' : g ∉ Set.range (toFinsuppAntidiag (n := d))) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (coeff (g i)) (1 + ∑' j, f i (j + 1) • X ^ (i * (j + 1)) : R⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ i ∈ s, (coeff (g i)) ((1 : R⟦X⟧) + ∑' j, f i (j + 1) • X ^ (i * (j + 1))) = 0 by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hi'⟩ := this
    apply prod_eq_zero hi hi'
  contrapose! hg' with hprod
  rw [Set.mem_range]
  have hgne0 (i : ℕ) : g i ≠ 0 ↔ i ≠ 0 ∧ i ≤ g i := by
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, by grind⟩
    · contrapose hs0 with rfl
      exact mem_of_subset (mem_finsuppAntidiag.mp hg).2 (by simpa using h)
    · exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) <| aux_dvd_of_coeff_ne_zero hs0 hg hprod _
  refine ⟨Nat.Partition.mk (Finsupp.mk g.support (fun i ↦ g i / i) ?_).toMultiset ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hgne0
  · suffices ∀ i, g i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 0 by simpa [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    exact fun i h ↦ ((hgne0 i).mp h).1
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_finsuppAntidiag.mp hg
    refine Eq.trans ?_ h1
    suffices ∑ x ∈ g.support, g x / x * x = ∑ x ∈ s, g x by simpa [Finsupp.sum]
    apply sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff h2 (by simp)
    exact fun x hx ↦ Nat.div_mul_cancel <| aux_dvd_of_coeff_ne_zero hs0 hg hprod x
  · ext x
    simpa [toFinsuppAntidiag] using Nat.div_mul_cancel <| aux_dvd_of_coeff_ne_zero hs0 hg hprod x

name: aux_prod_f_eq_prod_coeff
statement:
private theorem aux_prod_f_eq_prod_coeff (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) {n : ℕ} (p : Partition n) {s : Finset ℕ}
    (hs : Icc 1 n ⊆ s) (hs0 : 0 ∉ s) :
    p.parts.toFinsupp.prod f =
    ∏ i ∈ s, coeff (p.toFinsuppAntidiag i) (1 + ∑' j, f i (j + 1) • X ^ (i * (j + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Finsupp.prod, Multiset.toFinsupp_support, Multiset.toFinsupp_apply]
  apply prod_subset_one_on_sdiff
  · grind
  · intro x hx
    rw [mem_sdiff, Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hx
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hs0 (h ▸ hx.1)
    have hsum := (summable_genFun_term' f hx0).map_tsum _
      (WithPiTopology.continuous_constantCoeff R)
    simp [toFinsuppAntidiag, hsum, hx.2, hx0]
  · intro i hi
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hi
    have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := (p.parts_pos hi).ne.symm
    rw [map_add, (summable_genFun_term' f hi0).map_tsum _ (WithPiTopology.continuous_coeff _ _)]
    suffices f i (Multiset.count i p.parts) =
        ∑' j, if Multiset.count i p.parts * i = i * (j + 1) then f i (j + 1) else 0 by
      simpa [toFinsuppAntidiag, hi, hi0, coeff_X_pow]
    rw [tsum_eq_single (Multiset.count i p.parts - 1) ?_]
    · rw [mul_comm]
      simp [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Multiset.one_le_count_iff_mem.mpr hi)]
    intro b hb
    suffices Multiset.count i p.parts * i ≠ i * (b + 1) by simp [this]
    rw [mul_comm i, (mul_left_inj' (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt (p.parts_pos hi))).ne]
    grind

name: hasProd_genFun
statement:
theorem hasProd_genFun (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) :
    HasProd (fun i ↦ 1 + ∑' j, f (i + 1) (j + 1) • X ^ ((i + 1) * (j + 1))) (genFun f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasProd, WithPiTopology.tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
  refine fun d ↦ tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (fun s (hs : s ≥ range d) ↦ ?_)
  have : ∏ i ∈ s, ((1 : R⟦X⟧) + ∑' j, f (i + 1) (j + 1) • X ^ ((i + 1) * (j + 1)))
      = ∏ i ∈ s.map (addRightEmbedding 1), (1 + ∑' j, f i (j + 1) • X ^ (i * (j + 1))) := by simp
  rw [this]
  have hs : Icc 1 d ⊆ s.map (addRightEmbedding 1) := by
    intro i
    suffices 1 ≤ i → i ≤ d → ∃ a ∈ s, a + 1 = i by simpa
    intro h1 h2
    refine ⟨i - 1, mem_of_subset hs ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind
  rw [coeff_genFun, coeff_prod]
  refine (sum_of_injOn toFinsuppAntidiag (toFinsuppAntidiag_injective d).injOn ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
  · intro p _
    exact mem_of_subset (finsuppAntidiag_mono hs _) p.toFinsuppAntidiag_mem_finsuppAntidiag
  · exact fun g hg hg' ↦ aux_prod_coeff_eq_zero_of_notMem_range f (by simp) hg (by simpa using hg')
  · exact fun p _ ↦ aux_prod_f_eq_prod_coeff f p hs (by simp)

name: multipliable_genFun
statement:
theorem multipliable_genFun (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) :
    Multipliable fun i ↦ (1 : R⟦X⟧) + ∑' j, f (i + 1) (j + 1) • X ^ ((i + 1) * (j + 1))

name: genFun_eq_tprod
statement:
theorem genFun_eq_tprod (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) :
    genFun f = ∏' i, (1 + ∑' j, f (i + 1) (j + 1) • X ^ ((i + 1) * (j + 1)))

name: hasProd_powerSeriesMk_card_restricted
statement:
theorem hasProd_powerSeriesMk_card_restricted [IsTopologicalSemiring R]
    (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    HasProd (fun i ↦ if p (i + 1) then ∑' j : ℕ, X ^ ((i + 1) * j) else 1)
    (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ (#(restricted n p) : R))
proof:
:= by
  convert! hasProd_genFun (fun i c ↦ if p i then (1 : R) else 0) using 1
  · ext1 i
    split_ifs
    · rw [tsum_eq_zero_add' ?_]
      · simp
      simp_rw [pow_mul, pow_add]
      apply Summable.mul_right
      exact summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero (by simp)
    · simp
  · simp_rw [genFun, restricted, card_filter, Finsupp.prod, prod_boole]
    simp

name: multipliable_powerSeriesMk_card_restricted
statement:
theorem multipliable_powerSeriesMk_card_restricted [IsTopologicalSemiring R]
    (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Multipliable (fun i ↦ if p (i + 1) then ∑' j : ℕ, (X ^ ((i + 1) * j) : R⟦X⟧) else 1)

name: powerSeriesMk_card_restricted_eq_tprod
statement:
theorem powerSeriesMk_card_restricted_eq_tprod [IsTopologicalSemiring R]
    (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ (#(restricted n p) : R)) =
    ∏' i, if p (i + 1) then ∑' j : ℕ, X ^ ((i + 1) * j) else 1

name: hasProd_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted
statement:
theorem hasProd_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    HasProd (fun i ↦ ∑ j ∈ range m, X ^ ((i + 1) * j))
    (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ (#(countRestricted n m) : R))
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R using Subsingleton.eq_one (α := R⟦X⟧)
  convert! hasProd_genFun (fun i c ↦ if c < m then (1 : R) else 0) using 1
  · ext1 i
    rw [sum_range_eq_add_Ico _ hm, sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
    congrm $(by simp) + ?_
    trans ∑ k ∈ range (m - 1), (if k + 1 < m then (1 : R) else 0) • X ^ ((i + 1) * (k + 1))
    · refine sum_congr rfl fun b hn ↦ ?_
      rw [add_comm 1 b]
      have : b + 1 < m := by grind
      simp [this]
    · exact (tsum_eq_sum (fun b hb ↦ smul_eq_zero_of_left (by simpa using hb) _)).symm
  · simp_rw [genFun, countRestricted, card_filter, Finsupp.prod, prod_boole]
    simp

name: multipliable_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted
statement:
theorem multipliable_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted (m : ℕ) :
    Multipliable fun i ↦ ∑ j ∈ range m, (X ^ ((i + 1) * j) : R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · simpa using multipliable_of_exists_eq_zero ⟨0, rfl⟩
  · exact (hasProd_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted R hm).multipliable

name: powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted_eq_tprod
statement:
theorem powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted_eq_tprod {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ (#(countRestricted n m) : R)) =
    ∏' i, ∑ j ∈ range m, X ^ ((i + 1) * j)

name: aux_mul_one_sub_X_pow
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [← (multipliable_powerSeriesMk_card_restricted R (¬ m ∣ ·)).tprod_mul
    (multipliable_one_sub_X_pow _)]
  simp_rw [ite_not, ite_mul, pow_mul]
  conv in fun b ↦ _ =>
    ext b
    rw [tsum_pow_mul_one_sub_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero (by simp)]
  refine tprod_eq_tprod_of_ne_one_bij (fun i ↦ (i.val + 1) * m - 1) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro a b h
    rw [tsub_left_inj (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith), mul_left_inj' (hm.ne.symm), add_left_inj] at h
    exact SetCoe.ext h
  · suffices ∀ (i : ℕ), m ∣ i + 1 → ∃ j ≠ 0, j * m - 1 = i by simpa
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := dvd_def.mp hi
    refine ⟨j, by grind, Nat.sub_eq_of_eq_add ?_⟩
    rw [hj, mul_comm m j]
  · intro i
    have : (i + 1) * m - 1 + 1 = (i + 1) * m := by grind
    simp [this, pow_mul]

name: powerSeriesMk_card_restricted_eq_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted
statement:
theorem powerSeriesMk_card_restricted_eq_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ (#(restricted n (¬ m ∣ ·)) : R)) =
    PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ (#(countRestricted n m) : R)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  let _ : TopologicalSpace R := ⊥
  have _ : DiscreteTopology R := ⟨rfl⟩
  rw [powerSeriesMk_card_restricted_eq_tprod R (¬ m ∣ ·)]
  rw [powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted_eq_tprod R hm]
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (tprod_one_sub_X_pow_ne_zero R)
  rw [aux_mul_one_sub_X_pow R hm]
  rw [← (multipliable_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted R m).tprod_mul
    (multipliable_one_sub_X_pow _)]
  exact tprod_congr (fun i ↦ by simp_rw [pow_mul, geom_sum_mul_neg])

name: card_restricted_eq_card_countRestricted
statement:
theorem card_restricted_eq_card_countRestricted (n : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    #(restricted n (¬ m ∣ ·)) = #(countRestricted n m)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using PowerSeries.ext_iff.mp
    (powerSeriesMk_card_restricted_eq_powerSeriesMk_card_countRestricted ℤ hm) n

name: card_odds_eq_card_distincts
statement: theorem card_odds_eq_card_distincts (n : ℕ) : #(odds n) = #(distincts n)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← countRestricted_two, odds, even_iff_two_dvd]
  exact card_restricted_eq_card_countRestricted n (by norm_num)
